## Bitchill s04

- Record: `premier-bitchill-s04-2026`
- Source: [curated-events.json](sources/curated-events.json)
- Starts: 2026-10-01T09:00:00-06:00
- Description: Source-backed
- Original page: <https://thebitcoindistrict.com/bitchill/>

### About the event

network, learn & leisue - bitcoin retreat comes back with season 4!

It's not a conference. It's not a business trip.It's a one-week tropical reset with Bitcoiners from around the world - diving, tennis, open mics, barbecues, workshops, and sunset beers... all in the most Bitcoin-friendly jurisdiction on Earth - Próspera on Roatan.

Coliving with fellow Bitcoiners in one of the world's most exciting experiments - Próspera special economic zone.

Activities to fill your days: diving, sailing, yoga, sports, BBQ nights, pool parties.

Community stage: open mic, lightning talks and debates about the future of Bitcoin and freedom.

Island exploration - hidden beaches, local food spots, and off-the-map adventures.

A soft landing into Próspera - meet residents, explore business opportunities, and find out what's up there.

Freedom to chill - no rigid agenda. The week has a rhythm, but plenty of space for serendipity.

curious about Próspera digital nomads & entrepreneurs creators, builders & free spirits who go with the flow

party-tourists complainers and freeloaders s****ners and control freaks people allergic to new ideas

Every Bitchill is different, but every is full of activities, networking, tourism, education and chill. Agenda of the upcoming retreat is shaped at published at the Bitchill Plan page.Find below, what type of activities are usually arranged during Bitchill:

Wellness: breathwork workshops, meditation sessions, cold plunge, yoga, longevity clinic visit

From the US: Direct flights from Houston, Miami, Atlanta, Dallas.

From Europe: Via US hubs or San Salvador (San Pedro Sula or Tegucigalpa).

To Plan B (San Salvador): Commercial flights through SAP ($350) or direct charter to Roatán arranged (700,000 sat)

Come for as long as you want! Monthly options are also available.Feel free to find accomodation on your own.

Bitchill is not your typical Bitcoin conference or networking trip. It's a week or longer Bitcoin retreat in the Caribbean, designed for builders, creators, and free spirits who want to recharge while connecting with like-minded people. Instead of endless panels in hotel ballrooms, you'll spend your days diving in crystal-clear waters, joining open mic sessions, playing tennis or golf, and sharing barbecues and beers at sunset.

At the same time, Bitchill gives you a soft landing into Próspera, the world's most Bitcoin-friendly jurisdiction, where you'll meet residents, explore business opportunities, and see firsthand how life on Roatán blends tropical ease with frontier innovation.

Tickets are priced in Bitcoin (sats) and give you access to the full Bitchill experience.The base ticket (200,000 sats) covers:

- Selected group activities - BBQ nights, pool parties, yoga sessions, open mic talks, and intro experiences
- Full logistical support - we help arrange travel, pickups, and make sure your stay is smooth
- Community integration - meet residents, explore Próspera, and get introduced to the Bitcoin District

Accommodation is not included in the base ticket, so you can choose the housing that best fits your vibe and budget. Prices are for one full week:

- Studio: 90,000 sats/night - private, spacious, ideal for couples

Staying longer? Many participants extend their visit and turn Bitchill into a month-long immersion in Caribbean life and Próspera's Bitcoin-first community. We can help arrange that too.

- Daily meals (except special group events like welcome brunch or BBQ nights)
- Optional extras such as premium tours or diving certifications

Bitchill is non-profit - every satoshi collected (and often a few more) goes directly into covering accommodation, activities, and event costs.

Próspera is a special economic zone on Roatán, Honduras, built as a hub for innovation, entrepreneurship, and freedom. It's one of the first places on Earth where Bitcoin is recognized as legal tender, and where you can set up a business, pay taxes, and live fully on a Bitcoin standard.

During Bitchill, you'll meet residents of the zone, tour the facilities, and learn about opportunities ranging from Caribbean real estate to Bitcoin-friendly company incorporation. Many attendees come away seeing not just a retreat, but a glimpse into what a freer future could look like.

Roatán itself is a tropical paradise: white sand beaches, world-class diving, and a relaxed Caribbean vibe. Unlike mainland Honduras, it's safe and designed for international visitors, with a growing expat and Bitcoin community.

Bitchill isn't just a vacation - it's your entry point into the Bitcoin District in Próspera. This is where Bitcoiners are building a neighborhood and an ecosystem powered by freedom and Bitcoin. You'll meet locals, see opportunities in residency, business, and real estate, and experience firsthand what it means to live free on Bitcoin in a pioneering jurisdiction.

January is one of the best months to be on Roatán. It sits right after the rainy season and just as the island shifts into its clearest, breeziest, most comfortable period.

- Very little rain - you might get a short shower, but it's quick and refreshing
- Excellent diving conditions - January typically brings clear water and calmer seas

In short: perfect tropical winter escape. Warm, sunny, and reliable - without the unpredictable downpours of late fall.

If rain happens, it's usually a brief shower that clears the air and opens up beautiful sunsets. All outdoor activities (beach fires, boat trips, tennis, snorkeling) run normally this time of year.

Meals are self-organized, giving you the freedom to explore the island's food scene. Roatán has everything from local Honduran street food like baleadas to fresh seafood grills and high-end Caribbean restaurants. Many places in Próspera accept Bitcoin payments via Lightning, while USD cash is widely accepted elsewhere. Group meals are part of the program, too.

Roatán (RTB) has direct international flights from Houston, Miami, Atlanta, Denver, Belize and Guatemala City. Plus great domestic connection in San Pedro Sula.

We'll be there with pickups, transfers, and local guidance so you never feel lost.

Yes. Most participants are digital nomads or entrepreneurs, so reliable internet is a must. Coliving spaces have solid WiFi, and we also provide SIM backups and Starlink.

There are coworking sessions at the Bitcoin Center in Próspera, but you're always free to work from your villa terrace, the café, or anywhere else.

Roatán is a Caribbean island that welcomes thousands of international tourists every year. It's much safer than mainland Honduras, with a strong expat community and infrastructure designed for visitors.

That said, it's still a developing country: you'll want to be mindful like anywhere else in Latin America. We'll guide you on the do's and don'ts, and you'll feel comfortable moving around.

Both. Bitchill is about freedom, Bitcoin, and community, but it's also about sunbeds, cocktails, and beach barbecues. You'll leave with a tan, new friends, and fresh ideas for building a freer future.

The week is designed to reset your mind and spirit while also giving you exposure to one of the most exciting experiments in governance and Bitcoin adoption anywhere in the world.

### August 17-22, 2026

Week-long builder-first event for people who want to build and launch real Bitcoin projects. Hackathon X workshops X vibes

### every month

Onboarding weekend with workshops, island exploration, networking dinners, accommodation, transportation, and food.

### any time

Come to Roatán anytime, or bring your team for a retreat! We'll tailor and organize your visit for a seamless experience.

### A place to live free

Join us for business opportunities, networking, events, networking, sovereign lifestyle and a free life.

## Edge City India 2026

- Record: `curated-edge-city-india-2026`
- Source: [curated-events.json](sources/curated-events.json)
- Starts: 2026-10-11
- Description: Source-backed
- Original page: <https://www.edgecity.live/india26>

### About the event

Edge City India is a three-week popup village in Mandrem, North Goa, from October 11 to November 1, 2026. Founders, researchers, engineers and creators live and work around The Circle's beach-facing coworking hub. The program includes coworking, talks, workshops, salons and demo days.

The first week, October 11 to 17, focuses on new urbanism, energy, food systems and education. October 18 to 24 covers longevity and consciousness. The final week, October 25 to November 1, focuses on deep tech, AI, decentralized technologies, governance, policy and hackathons.

The announced Web3-related programs include Cross Margin Labs' Aqua0 DeFi residency, Hacker House Goa with 2:47PM Studio from October 28 to 31, and an October 30 Project Odin workshop with the Ethereum Foundation Funding Coordination team on sustainable funding for open-source software and digital infrastructure. Light DAO and SingularityNET also host a residency. These programs sit within the wider village rather than replacing its full date range.

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. Accepted applicants receive a ticket-purchase link, and payment confirms their place. Tickets include village programming, coworking and community activities, but not accommodation or most meals. Joining a residency is optional. Tickets are non-refundable; the organizer allows date changes or transfers to another attendee. Daily clock times are not confirmed for the village as a whole.

## EDCON 2026

- Record: `premier-edcon-2026`
- Source: [curated-events.json](sources/curated-events.json)
- Starts: 2026-10-17T09:00:00+08:00
- Description: Source-backed

### About the event

EDCON 2026 takes place on October 17 and 18 at Menara KEN TTDI, Level 2, in Kuala Lumpur. The published program includes Ethereum talks, lightning sessions, panels and hands-on workshops. Doors open at 09:30 each day and sessions begin at 10:00. All times are local to Kuala Lumpur.

Saturday covers practical read privacy with Steffen Kux, AI's social impacts with Bing of Lodestar, parallel execution, shared liquidity and the intersection of traditional finance and DeFi. Afternoon sessions include verified wallet simulation, AI-assisted security triage and an Etherscan Flow workshop with Harith, followed by a student blockchain-club panel.

Sunday includes Arbitrum builder support, decentralized social networks, sovereign AI and a Partitioned Binary Tree talk by Ashraf of Nethermind. Suji Yan discusses social protocols, WenKang covers offchain components for dApps, and Nic leads a build-with-AI tools workshop. The day closes with a White Paper Reading Club from 16:00 to 18:00.

Tickets are linked from the organizer's website to its Luma registration page. Check the published agenda for the final order of sessions.

## Field Station Rajasthan 2026

- Record: `curated-field-station-rajasthan-2026`
- Source: [curated-events.json](sources/curated-events.json)
- Starts: 2026-10-23
- Description: Source-backed
- Original page: <https://logos.co/field-station>

### About the event

Logos and Zu-Grama run Field Station at Dhun, a 500-acre regenerative site in Rajasthan, from October 23 to 31, 2026. The residency brings scientists, engineers, cryptographers, developers and community organizers together to build prototypes. The organizer's page specifies the October dates; the Devcon 8 calendar supplies the 2026 year. No daily start or finish time has been confirmed.

The program selects 30 residents. Scholarships cover eight nights of accommodation, food and drinks, on-site activities and the closing summit on October 30. Applicants can request domestic travel assistance. Rooms are shared, with five to seven people in single-sex rooms. The published application window was September 11 to 26.

Participants choose among the Logos Civic Prize, Logos Sovereignty and Privacy, Zu-Grama d/acc, and a non-builder track for activists, community organizers and artists. Technical work includes privacy-preserving blockchain, decentralized governance, censorship-resistant storage and secure payments. Creatives, designers and testers can also apply.

The schedule includes stand-ups, mentoring, dedicated build time, workshops and demos. Residents present prototypes at the closing summit. The strongest Logos-track prototypes are eligible for milestone-based grant funding. Applicants are asked to install Logos Basecamp, add its blockchain module and note the block height; an existing demo or prototype is helpful but not required.

### About the event

Web3Privacy Now hosts Ethereum Cypherpunk Congress #3 at Yashwantrao Chavan Centre in Nariman Point, Mumbai, on November 2, 2026, from 10:00 to 19:00 IST. Registration is free through Luma. The event brings together digital-rights advocates, free and open-source software contributors, cryptographers, developers, researchers, artists and legal practitioners. Its 2026 theme, The Ancestral Fork, examines inherited technological and social assumptions about privacy and digital autonomy, with participation from the Global South.

### Topics and participation formats

The 2026 program themes cover open-source AI and shared AI resources; responses to internet censorship using tools such as mesh networks and cross-border digital currencies; community-led interactive experiences; and privacy and data-protection questions around Aadhaar, UPI and DigiLocker. Other themes address accessible privacy for inexpensive phones and nontechnical users, and sustainable funding for privacy technology and free software.

The speaker announcement also identifies confidential computation, encrypted mempools, secure messaging, privacy-preserving identity, self-hosted nodes, stealth-address wallets, Kohaku wallet privacy and alternatives to centralized collaboration software as areas of work represented at the event. These are subject areas, not a timed session schedule.

The registration page describes a track where privacy-hackathon developers discuss their experience and an activation track proposing demonstrations of Fileverse, Rotki, Fluidkey, Radicle and GnosisVPN.

## Devcon 2026

- Record: `premier-devcon-2026`
- Source: [curated-events.json](sources/curated-events.json)
- Starts: 2026-11-03
- Description: Source-backed
- Original page: <https://devcon.org/>

### About the event

The Ethereum Foundation hosts Devcon 8 at Jio World Centre in Mumbai's Bandra Kurla Complex from November 3 to 6, 2026. The four-day conference is for developers, researchers, open-source contributors, designers, artists and community organizers working on Ethereum and decentralized systems. Curious beginners are welcome as well as experienced contributors.

### The 2026 program

Devcon has nine tracks:

- Core Protocol covers Ethereum research, its roadmap, consensus and staking, including the protocol's longer-term development.
- Privacy & Consent examines digital identity, self-sovereign identity and consent, alongside the effects of these systems on the communities using them.
- Security focuses on threat modeling, formal verification and operational security.
- Futures Worth Building considers coordination, public goods and open source, and how builders, communities and artists can influence technological choices.
- Users, Builders & Agents addresses wallets, account abstraction and user experience, with attention to security and privacy for people and agents using Ethereum.
- Rights, Freedoms & Governance uses case studies to examine human rights, DAOs and digital self-governance, including where these tools have failed.
- Applied Cryptography looks at practical uses of zero-knowledge proofs, multiparty computation and fully homomorphic encryption.
- Permissionless Networks covers peer-to-peer infrastructure, censorship resistance and connectivity under hostile network conditions.
- Open & Verifiable Stack examines open hardware, firmware and software, and how to verify the systems beneath an application.

Published session formats include five-minute lightning talks with two minutes for questions, 20-minute talks with five minutes for questions, 25-minute AMAs, fireside chats or roundtables, and hour-long hands-on workshops. Community hubs provide topic-focused educational spaces alongside coworking, art, music and interactive experiences. Announced speakers include Vitalik Buterin, Audrey Tang, Justin Drake, Roger Dingledine, Sandeep Nailwal, Hart Montgomery, Zachary Williamson and Fatemeh Fannizadeh. These tracks and formats describe the program; they are not a day-by-day session timetable.

### Tickets and attendance

General-admission tickets are sold in limited-quantity waves with purchase windows. The homepage currently lists US$499 when paying in ETH and US$999 in fiat, including 18% GST. Standard inclusions are four-day access, catering, hot drinks and event merchandise, with exceptions for some ticket types. Current availability and inclusions should be checked in the official ticket shop.

Community discounts require eligibility verification and a self-claimed discount code. They cover qualifying Indian residents and Ethereum or open-source contributors and participants. Review-based applications include student and Sanctuary Tech Builder tickets; approved applicants receive a voucher to purchase a ticket. The student route requires enrollment in an accredited degree program and relevant academic or community involvement. Short courses, bootcamps and online-only programs do not qualify. The FAQ lists October 23 as the final student application deadline, with responses by October 30.

General-admission tickets are transferable, can be purchased for someone else and allow entry with a QR code. Orders are limited to two tickets. Discounted tickets are non-transferable, must be claimed by the attendee and require ID at registration. Attendees under 16 must come with a parent or guardian who also holds a Devcon ticket.

The venue is accessible to attendees with disabilities. Sessions will be recorded and streamed on the organizer's YouTube channel. Devcon overlaps with Diwali travel, and the official travel guide includes accommodation and transport information.

## Zcash Presents: FREE SOCIETY HACKATHON

- Record: `luma-evt-b6kmwqzyuuetkip`
- Source: [curated-events.json](sources/curated-events.json)
- Starts: 2026-11-04T05:30:00.000Z
- Description: Source-backed
- Original page: <https://luma.com/freesocietyhackathon>

### About the event

WebZero Events and Zcash host Free Society Hackathon at True Tramm Trunk BKC in Mumbai on 4 and 5 November 2026, during Devcon. The organizers are selecting 75 in-person builders to develop working products using Zcash, with an Agentic Commerce track from Bitrefill.

### Who can take part

Engineers, developers, product people, marketers and founders can apply, including people without a technical background or prior Zcash experience. The program starts with a tooling walkthrough, and mentors from Zcash projects provide workshops and one-to-one guidance throughout the build day.

Teams can have one to four people. Bring a team or find teammates at the venue. A project can enter both tracks if it meets each track's requirements.

### Tracks and prizes

The organizers advertise USD 5,000 in cash prizes. The published breakdown includes USD 4,800 in competition awards and USD 200 in conditional follow-up bonuses:

- The Zcash Privacy track awards USD 1,300 to the top project, two second prizes of USD 300 each and two third prizes of USD 200 each, totaling USD 2,300 across five projects.
- The Bitrefill Agentic Commerce track requires projects to use Bitrefill. It offers USD 1,000 for the most innovative project, USD 800 for second place, USD 600 for third and USD 100 for the best feedback, totaling USD 2,500.

Both USD 300 Privacy track winners are also named Zcash Ecosystem Prize winners. Each can earn a further USD 100 by agreeing on a milestone relevant to their submission and delivering it publicly. Those two milestone-dependent bonuses account for the remaining USD 200 in the advertised total.

### Schedule

All times are IST (Asia/Kolkata). Luma lists the event from 11:00 on Wednesday 4 November to 15:00 on Thursday 5 November 2026.

Wednesday 4 November is the hack day:

- 11:00: welcome and tooling walkthrough.
- 11:30: building begins, with workshops and mentors.
- Midnight at the end of hack day, listed as 00:00: submissions close.

Judges score every project overnight and select the teams that will demo on stage.

Thursday 5 November is demo day:

- 11:00: top teams announced.
- 12:00: demos and winners announced on stage.

### Food and facilities

Breakfast, lunch and dinner on hack day, plus an afterparty, are included. The venue provides hacking areas, fast internet and group seating. The organizers also advertise merchandise and describe the location as a short tuk-tuk ride from the main Devcon venue.

### After the hackathon

Winning teams will be paired with an ecosystem partner to agree, deliver and publicly share one small milestone within 30 days, with mentorship and support. The organizers say the same milestone-based follow-up is open to builders who do not win.

### Registration and venue

The Hacker Pass is free, but registration requires host approval. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis for the 75 selected places. Participants must be in Mumbai in person on Wednesday 4 November; remote participation is not available.

The public venue is True Tramm Trunk BKC, G2-B, Ground Floor, Trade Centre Bkc, opposite MTNL, G Block, MMRDA Area, Bandra Kurla Complex, Bandra East, Mumbai, Maharashtra 400098, India.

Cosmoverse's Hong Kong Digital Asset Summit takes place at Grand Hyatt Hong Kong on November 5 and 6, 2026. It brings together financial institutions, policymakers and blockchain infrastructure teams to discuss digital assets in regulated markets.

The program covers tokenization, payments, custody, settlement and sovereign blockchain infrastructure through institutional roundtables, fireside interviews, debates and technical briefings. Closed-door roundtables follow the Chatham House Rule and prohibit phones and cameras.

The Summit Pass covers both summit days with coffee breaks and lunch. Executive options add a VIP dinner, VC soirée, investor networking and lounge access; a hotel package is also available. Business Day on November 4 is invitation-only and is not automatically included in a summit or hotel booking.

## ETHGlobal Mumbai 2026

- Record: `premier-ethmumbai-2026`
- Source: [curated-events.json](sources/curated-events.json)
- Starts: 2026-11-05
- Description: Source-backed
- Original page: <https://ethglobal.com/events/mumbai>

### About the event

ETHGlobal Mumbai is an in-person hackathon from November 5 to 7, 2026, at Jio World Convention Centre, G Block, Bandra Kurla Complex, Bandra East, Mumbai. The program combines project building with technical mentorship, workshops and feedback sessions.

### Participation and project tracks

Applications are assessed individually. Hackers may work solo or in teams of up to five, but every member must be accepted and confirm their own place. The organizer's public registration data lists November 3 at 23:59 IST as the application deadline.

Accepted hackers confirm attendance with an ETH commitment stake. For an in-person event, its return requires official check-in, physical attendance and a project submission before the deadline; incomplete projects can still qualify for the stake return. ETHGlobal says returns normally take up to four weeks after the event. Applicants unable to stake because of financial constraints can contact the organizer about alternatives.

There are three ways to build:

- Classic / From Scratch: Project-specific code, designs and assets must begin during the hackathon. Public libraries and starter kits are allowed.
- Extend Open Source: Teams add substantive new work to an existing open-source codebase and identify what predates the event.
- Ship a Feature: Teams add new functionality to an existing product, including a private or commercial product. New parts submitted through the continuity tracks must remain open source, and partner-prize eligibility depends on the relevant track rules.

Teams must disclose pre-existing work in writing to ETHGlobal, document it in their submission and maintain a meaningful version-control history. AI tools are allowed with attribution: submissions should identify AI-assisted code or assets, retain meaningful human contributions and include the specifications, prompts and planning files used in spec-driven workflows.

Event Discord channels support announcements, team formation and mentorship. During the hackathon, mentors help with technical problems and project feedback. Participants under 18 need a separately submitted parent or guardian agreement. In-person attendees must check in and wear their event wristband throughout the event.

### Submission and judging

Projects are due through the Hacker Dashboard by November 7, 2026, at 09:00 IST; late submissions are not accepted. The submission includes a title, description and repository or equivalent project files, with new work distinguished from reused material. An optional demo video must be two to four minutes long and at least 720p. The organizer's video rules prohibit sped-up recordings, mobile-phone recordings, AI voiceovers and music-and-text-only explanations.

Teams can choose finalist judging plus partner prizes, or partner prizes only. They may select up to three partner prize programs; multiple tracks from one partner count as one program. Finalist judging requires a live presentation with four minutes for the demo and three minutes for questions. Judges consider technical difficulty, originality, practical completeness, usability and the project's distinctive qualities. The detailed judging guide says partners assess submitted materials and that booth presentations are optional for feedback. Partner winners are announced during the closing ceremony.

### Announced partner awards

The prize page lists World at US$12,500; ENS at US$10,000; 1inch at US$7,000; Definitive and Chainlink at US$5,000 each; and 0G, Uniswap Foundation, Arc, Hedera, Arkiv, Whitechain and Ethereum Foundation at US$15,000 each. These are announced partner prize allocations, with awards subject to each partner's requirements. Most partners have not yet published their detailed criteria.

1inch has published an Aqua application challenge for a DeFi position demonstrated through test scripts or a user interface. Its main US$5,000 pool is split into US$2,500, US$1,500 and US$1,000 awards. A separate continuity-track pool offers US$1,500 and US$500. Entries must use official Aqua/SwapVM contracts, demonstrate onchain token transfers in the final demo and provide a proper Git history; local forks and modified SwapVM redeployments are allowed. Projects using SwapVM receive additional judging consideration.

Definitive offers US$2,500 for a social trading application using Flash advanced orders and a separate US$2,500 continuity-track award for a creative Flash integration. Examples include copy trading, shared signals, agent-operated products, multi-agent workflows and voice or chat trading interfaces. Both challenges require a working trading flow through Flash API or Flash MCP advanced orders and onchain execution in the final demo. Entrants must also share a short product video on Discord and X, tagging @DefinitiveFi on X. The continuity award considers originality, technical creativity and the quality of the demonstration.

The [Mumbai submission guide](https://ethglobal.com/events/mumbai/info/details), [partner prize requirements](https://ethglobal.com/events/mumbai/prizes) and [ETHGlobal rules](https://ethglobal.com/rules) give the participation and award conditions.

## Unchained Summit India 2026

- Record: `premier-unchained-summit-india-2026`
- Source: [curated-events.json](sources/curated-events.json)
- Starts: 2026-11-05
- Description: Source-backed
- Original page: <https://unchainedsummit.com/india>

### About the event

Aeternum organizes Unchained Summit India on November 5 and 6, 2026, at Courtyard by Marriott Mumbai International Airport in Andheri East. The conference is for institutional finance teams, investors, founders, developers, exchanges, policymakers and advisers working with digital assets and Web3.

### Two-day program

November 5 focuses on markets, finance and digital assets. Its announced topics are regulation and policy, tokenization and real-world assets, trading and markets, institutional adoption, stablecoins and payments, wealth and portfolio management, capital markets, and custody, liquidity and prime services.

November 6 focuses on Web3 infrastructure and emerging technology. Its announced subjects are AI and agentic systems, DeFi, blockchain scaling and infrastructure, security and digital trust, staking and network economics, consumer Web3 applications, emerging technologies, and interoperability and chain abstraction.

Across the program, the organizer's topic descriptions also cover India's digital-asset regulation, taxation and compliance; tokenized funds, securities and commodities; payment rails for settlement, remittances, treasury and commerce; machine payments and decentralized intelligence; and enterprise blockchain uses in settlement, trade, identity, data and tokenization.

### Announced speakers

The current India roster includes:

- S B Seker, Head of APAC at Binance; Praneeth Srikanti, Partner at Ethereal Ventures; and Prabal Banerjee, Co-Founder of Avail.
- Sanat Rao, Chief Investment Officer at Monarq Asset Management; Sumit Gupta, Co-Founder of CoinDCX; and Ashish Singhal, Co-Founder of CoinSwitch.
- Dilip Chenoy, Chairperson of Bharat Web3 Association; Roshan Prabhakar, Head of Product for India at Coinbase; Rajagopal Menon, Vice President at WazirX; and Saumya Saxena, Global Builder Lead at Base.
- Aishwary Gupta, Global Head of Business at Polygon Labs; Kunaal Patel, Head of Institutional for Asia and MENA at Ondo Finance; Haley Lowy, Chief of Staff at SingularityNET; and Dinesh Dahiya, Vice President at OpenZeppelin.
- Punit Agarwal, Founder and CEO of KoinX; Jaideep Reddy, Partner at Trilegal; and Uttam Singh, Senior Developer Relations Engineer at Alchemy.

The organizer maintains the [full India speaker roster](https://unchainedsummit.com/india/speakers).

### Unchained Pitch Challenge

The Pitch Challenge takes place on November 5 within the summit. It accepts applications from Web3 startups under five years old, including protocols, DeFi projects, tokenized real-world asset projects and cross-chain tools. Teams may be at any funding stage. Applications should demonstrate product or technical strength, together with traction or an innovative roadmap.

Applicants submit a pitch deck for advisory-panel review. Only selected finalists are invited to pitch on stage, and winners are announced during the summit. The organizer describes press exposure and potential investor introductions as benefits; the page does not promise investment or a cash award.

The [pitch application page](https://unchainedsummit.com/india/pitch-competition/) contains conflicting cutoffs: its timeline says applications close October 25, with finalist selection on October 30, while its application callout says October 30. Applicants should confirm the cutoff with the organizer rather than rely on the later date.

### Tickets and attendance

Early-bird tickets are listed at US$149 for Standard and US$229 for VIP through October 26, 2026, with tax included. Standard includes conference sessions, networking and exhibition areas, lunch and coffee breaks. VIP adds access to the VIP and speaker lounge. The published last-chance prices are US$199 and US$299 respectively.

Only registered ticket holders may attend the summit and its networking events, and payment secures the booking. Registration may remain available until the first day if capacity allows. The FAQ specifies prior written authorization 90 days before the summit for ticket substitutions. The event is conducted in English without translation services, and the organizer encourages business-formal or smart-casual dress.

Personal audio/video recording is permitted. Publishing or transmitting recordings requires permission, with an exception for clips under one minute used in blogging or press coverage.

The venue address is C.T.S. No. 215, Andheri Kurla Road, Andheri East, Mumbai, Maharashtra 400059.

<p>Kenny is Co-Chairman and Co-Founder of KainoQ Capital, a private investment firm seeding founders of innovations in Asia. He co-founded KainoQ Capital with two veteran investors and scientists from Two Sigma and Goldman Sachs.<br /></p><p>Kenny is also currently a Board Member of Two Sigma Asia. He was formerly Two Sigma Asia's CEO and Chairman of Two Sigma China. Two Sigma is one of world's largest hedge funds. Two Sigma China is the second largest global hedge fund in China.<br /></p><p>Earlier in his career, Kenny was Global Partner of McKinsey &amp; Company and a co-leader of its Asia Financial Institutional Practice.

Kenny was one of the fastest rising partners ever of McKinsey, elected as a global partner six years from his start as an analyst.<br /></p><p>Kenny has a few public roles. He is a Member of the Board of Advisors of The Wharton School,The School's most senior board and was formerly Chairman of the Executive Board of the Wharton School in Asia. He is Vice-Chairman and Trustee of the Asia Pacific Council of The Nature Conservancy. He is Co-Founder and Co-Chairman of Melo Foundation, one of the largest youth empowerment NGOs in Asia. </p><p>Kenny graduated with a finance degree from the Wharton School of the University of Pennsylvania and a law degree from Oxford University.

He was the first ever Chinese to be awarded the Joseph Wharton Scholarship. He is a best-selling published author in China with his recent book "Choices" reaching No.4 in e-book sales in China in 2023.

CoinDesk's Consensus Miami 2027 is a three-day gathering for participants in crypto, finance, technology and policy. Its announced themes cover crypto at scale, institutional integration and agentic commerce. The current program highlights include a fireside conversation with CZ, a keynote by Michael Saylor, a fireside conversation with Chairman Selig and a session on crypto payment rails and open protocols for agentic commerce. Consult the official program for updated times and speaker details.

Vivek Raman is the Co-Founder and CEO of Etherealize, where he is building the global settlement network for tokenized assets on Ethereum. Etherealize is the only company ever funded by the Ethereum Foundation to serve as its institutional arm, and is backed by Paradigm, Electric Capital, and Vitalik Buterin. Prior to founding Etherealize, Vivek spent fifteen years on Wall Street and in digital assets. He traded high-yield bonds, distressed credit, leveraged loans, and credit default swaps at Morgan Stanley, UBS, Deutsche Bank, and Nomura.

He went on to serve as Managing Director and Head of Digital Assets at BitOoda, a regulated digital asset investment bank, and built a real estate portfolio of 100+ homes and land parcels - where the industry's inefficiency drove his interest in blockchain. In June 2025, Vivek testified before the U.S. House Financial Services Committee in support of the CLARITY Act, making the case that decentralized blockchain networks represent critical infrastructure for the next generation of American capital markets. He has also engaged directly with the SEC's Crypto Task Force and serves on the CFTC's Industry Advisory Committee on the regulatory framework for tokenized assets.

At Etherealize, Vivek has assembled a team of over thirty spanning Wall Street veterans and Ethereum's most accomplished engineers and has raised $40 million to bring institutional assets fully on-chain. He is a graduate of Yale University, where he studied economics.

### About the event

The Bridge Between TradFi and Digital Assets. The Institutional Summit for Digital Assets. Paris, July 6-7, 2027.

### What it is

Signal Week is the summit for the institutional digital-assets sector, set in Paris. It succeeds seven years of Paris Blockchain Week as its elevation for the decade ahead: where Paris Blockchain Week built credibility as Europe's leading institutional digital asset conference, Signal Week positions it for the decade ahead.

### Audience

The organizer inherits an audience with more than 70% C-suite or investment decision-makers, 36,000-plus facilitated networking meetings, $50 trillion-plus in assets under management represented, and 389 government officials and policymakers. It is built for banking and financial services, asset management, enterprise, digital-asset native firms, traditional finance, infrastructure providers and family offices.

### Speakers

Past stages have hosted Changpeng Zhao (Binance), Jeremy Allaire (Circle), Lily Liu (Solana Foundation), Silvio Micali (Algorand), Charles Hoskinson, Joseph Lubin (ConsenSys), Tim Draper, Jan Van Eck (VanEck), Yoni Assia (eToro) and Arianna Simpson (a16z), alongside French ministers Anne Le Henanff, Clara Chappaz and Marina Ferrari. Featured faces for 2027 include Adam Back, Nikhil Sharma (BlackRock), Kara Kennedy (JP Morgan), Amy Oldenburg (Morgan Stanley), Ben Slavin (BNY), Christian Rau (Mastercard) and Daniel Seifert (Coinbase).

### Participation

Participants span digital-asset native builders, TradFi and fintech institutions deploying at scale, AI-for-finance providers and ecosystem partners. Founding partnerships for Signal Week 2027 are open.

### About the event

Bitcoin Asia returns to Hong Kong on 26-27 August 2027, with the organisers describing it as the meeting point where the exchanges, builders, allocators and the wider Bitcoin community across Asia come together under one roof. ## Passes The 2027 General Admission pass is listed at $69 and covers two-day access to the Main Stage and Side Stage sessions, the Expo Hall, the Art Gallery hosting Asia's largest Bitcoin digital art showcase, and the official event app for planning the agenda.

The General Admission Plus pass is $129 and adds the Deal Flow Zone for one-to-one business meetings, in-app meeting-table booking, BTC+ networking app access, priority Main Stage seating and a dedicated check-in desk. The Whale Pass is $1,499 and includes backstage deep sessions with speakers, all-inclusive food and drinks, access to Whale Night side events and the after-party, The Deep private lounge, priority seating and a VIP gift bag. Groups and companies can request a tailored package.

## Past speakers Previous editions featured CZ, Balaji Srinivasan (CEO and founder, Network School), Dr Hon Johnny Ng and Kit Chong MH (Hong Kong Legislative Council), David Bailey (CEO and chairman, Nakamoto Inc.), Simon Gerovich (CEO, Metaplanet), Justin Sun (advisor, WBTC), Aj Scaramucci (founder and CEO, Treasure Trove), Jack Kong (founder and board member, Nano Labs and Hong Kong Cyberport), Bonnie Chang (founder and host, Bonnie Blockchain) and Bilal Bin Saqib (chairman, Pakistan Virtual Assets Regulatory Authority). Bitcoin Asia is published by BTC Inc., a subsidiary of Nakamoto Inc. (NASDAQ: NAKA).

## Get Tech Vibes. Get Connected. Get Funded.

- Record: `discovery-evt-MRAfeaIFhOGrtMv`
- Source: [verified-discovery.json](sources/verified-discovery.json)
- Starts: 2026-11-11T00:00:00.000Z
- Description: Source-backed
- Original page: <https://luma.com/lqr28m0r>

### About the event

## Get Tech Vibes. Get Connected. Get Funded. Free to attend, happy hour prices all night, and a free beer for the first guests through the door. Arrive before 6 PM. Vancouver's founders, angel investors, creators, and Web3 builders in one room. Hear from two serial founders with multiple exits, meet angel investors, and keep the night going with a live DJ. What to expect: - 5-6 PM: Doors + networking. Grab your free beer and appetizers early arrivals and meet founders, investors, and operators. - 6-7 PM: Founder AMA2 (starts sharply at 6). Real stories and straight answers from Hussein Hallak and Mike Nabavi, with angel investors on hand. Bring your questions.

- 7 PM-close: Live DJ + networking. Keep the conversations going. On stage: Hussein Hallak is the author of the Amazon bestseller, The Dark Art of Life Mastery, and a serial entrepreneur with two exits and 22 businesses built across Damascus, Dubai and Vancouver. His first tech company was acqui-hired by Spacetoon, the Disney of the Middle East. He co-founded CreativeArab, the world's first and largest online marketplace of Middle Eastern art, built award-winning creative agencies, and led product, sales and strategy teams serving brands like P&G, Unilever, Universal and Disney.

He was General Manager and Head Mentor of Launch Academy, Vancouver's largest startup hub, whose 6,500+ founders have gone on to raise over $2.5 billion. He spent two seasons on the tech panel of Our City with Kirk LaPointe on RoundHouse Radio, and was tech lead on MBC's No. 1 morning show, watched by 40 million viewers. Today he is founder and CEO of Next Decentrum and editor of The Streetlight on Substack. Mike Nabavi, six-time founder. He sold his first company, started in university, after growing it past 35 people. He drafted the business plan behind Guest-Tek's TSX IPO, consulted at Deloitte, ran a tech startup for a decade before exiting, and has since backed numerous startups.

His payments venture LavaPay had a pipeline nearing $9M a month when its banks shut it down, which led to Omnieon, infrastructure for federated finance. Today he works as an interim or fractional executive for early-stage and owner-operated companies. Ask Mike anything, including what he got wrong. Who should come: founders looking to raise, investors looking for deal flow, and operators and creators building in Vancouver. Register to save your spot, and arrive early: capacity is limited and the free keg of beer goes to early guest arrivals.

Presented by The Art Party (AV, sound, live DJs) - The Basement (160 capacity) - Hastings Crossing BIA - Vancouver News Livestream with support from Impresario Partners, a consulting and VC firm, (this event will be livestreamed to 10,000+ viewers) - Micro Media Solutions for photography - Canadian Allied Services for financial advice. ## Bringing new audiences into the Hastings corridor. Hastings Crossing BIA is an organization that takes a leadership role in managing change and shaping a more resilient, inclusive and sustainable local economy here in the Downtown Eastside.

Through collaboration with its business members, grassroots, government, private sector and non-profit partners we bridge the needs of local businesses with the capacity of community focused organizations to foster a vibrant, healthy and diverse area for all - whether you're here every day or just for the afternoon. This event brings new energy to the Hastings corridor and supports the Hastings Crossing BIA's work to grow local business and entrepreneurship pathways. More info: https://gettechvibes.

Not your bunker, not your Christmas party!** Es wird wieder Zeit für ein physisches Treffen der OnchainAustria Community! Nach einem weiteren wilden Jahr voller Kursachterbahnen, Hacks, Scams, AI-Paranoia und Crypto-Chaos ziehen wir uns gemeinsam in den Bunker zurück und lassen das Jahr bei einem gemütlichen Get-together ausklingen. Passend zum Motto **BUNKER MODE** treffen wir uns in der ehemaligen *Bunkerei*, heute **Schankwirtschaft im Augarten**, direkt neben dem Wiener Flakturm. Eine passendere Location hätten wir wohl kaum finden können.

Drinks, gute Gespräche und jede Menge Crypto-Talk - von Bitcoin und Ethereum über DeFi bis zu Self Custody, Hardware Wallets und der Frage, wie paranoid man 2026 eigentlich schon sein muss. Egal ob alter onchainaustria-Hase oder zum ersten Mal dabei: Alle Crypto-Interessierten sind herzlich willkommen! ** Wann:** Mittwoch, 18. November 2026 ** Wo:** Schankwirtschaft im Augarten (ehemals Bunkerei), Wien - direkt neben dem Flakturm ** Motto:** BUNKER MODE Wir freuen uns auf einen gemütlichen Abend mit euch! **Stay safe. ## Bitfest 2026

- Record: `curated-bitfest-2026-11-19`
- Source: [verified-discovery.json](sources/verified-discovery.json)
- Starts: 2026-11-19
- Description: Source-backed
- Original page: <https://bitfest.uk/>

### About the event

Bitfest 2026 - The UK's Largest Bitcoin Festival | Manchester Bitfest 2026 - The UK's Largest Bitcoin Festival - About Us - Events - Bitflix - Nostrshire - Hackathon - nPub Dub - Bitfest - Pepe.X - NME Concert - Sunday Social - FULL AGENDA - Get Tickets - Partners - Collaborate - Media - Cinematics - Blog - Gallery - Media Kit - FAQ - Join Us 19 - 22 NOVEMBER 2026 PENDULUM HOTEL, MANCHESTER WHAT IS BITFEST? Bitfest is the UK's flagship Bitcoin festival. The 2026 edition is a four-day Bitcoin festival in Manchester, taking place from 19-22 November 2026.

It brings together Bitcoiners, builders, communities, artists, families and newcomers for talks, workshops, an expo, art, cinema, gaming, live music, Nostr and freedom technology. So... is it a conference? Well, yes and no. Bitfest is a space where people from all walks of life can come together for a weekend powered by Bitcoiners. It's about community as much as it is about technology: a place to connect, learn, explore, and actually experience Bitcoin culture in action. While talks and panels are part of the programme, Bitfest goes far beyond a traditional conference - incorporating talks, discussions and hands-on workshops covering not just Bitcoin, but other freedom-adjacent topics.

Our inaugural event, Bitfest 2025, featured 5 events and 8 themed zones across 3 days, with 60+ speakers and artists, all hosted across multiple nearby venues. And now Bitfest is back for 2026. Bigger, louder and with even more to explore! This year's programme brings together a staggering 8 events and 9 zones, creating an even bigger celebration of Bitcoin, freedom technology, creativity and the communities building the future. Bitfest is designed for everyone - whether you're deep in the space or just getting started. It's family-friendly too and so bring the kids along! Day 0 also features Nostrshire, the UK's first full-scale conference dedicated entirely to Nostr.

EVENTS Bitfest isn't just one event - it's a whole weekend of them. From Nostr and Bitcoin conferences to live music, internet culture, social events and everything in between, each event has its own character, community and reason to be here. Explore the events that make up Bitfest 2026. THERE'S MORE TO EXPLORE ZONES Across the festival you'll find nine themed zones, each bringing a different side of Bitcoin and freedom technology to life. From talks and hands-on workshops to gaming, music, art, business and a place for the kids, there's plenty to explore beyond the main stage.

CONFERENCE TALKS & PANELS Hear from leading Bitcoin professionals, builders and people advocating for Bitcoin and Nostr. WORKSHOP / HACK ZONE DIY Build, learn and collaborate across two days of workshops, unconference sessions and the Bitfest 2026 Hackathon. Explore the Hackathon EXHIBITION PROJECT AND BUSINESS EXPO Discover and catch up with the latest projects and businesses building on Bitcoin. GALLERY BY PEPE.X BITCOIN ART EXHIBITION A visual celebration of Bitcoin culture, digital art, memes and creative experiments, bringing the weird, wonderful and wildly creative side of the internet into the real world.

FREEDOM FEST FREEDOM & SOVEREIGNTY TECH Explore privacy, digital rights, civil liberties and freedom technology through Freedom Fest - a distinct event running alongside Bitfest on Saturday. FREEDOM FEST GAMING GAMES & COMPETITIONS Enter the gaming zone to discover Bitcoin-powered games and participate in competitive gaming sessions. MUSIC NEW MUSIC ECONOMY & VALUEVERSE Entertainment led by musicians utilising New Music Economy tooling in the Valueverse. NETWORKING DRINKS, FOOD & BANTER Mix and mingle networking zones in both the Pendulum Café during the day and The Shack NQ in the evening.

KIDS BITCOIN JUNIORS A safe, supervised space for kids to play, create and have fun, with DBS-checked staff so parents can leave them safely and catch a talk, explore the festival or grab a bit of peace and quiet. PRE-PARTY BITFLIX & PRE-EVENT RECEPTION 4:30pm - 1am - 19 NOVEMBER - PENDULUM HOTEL/THE TAP HOUSE Kick off the Bitfest weekend with The Six Billion Dollar Man, Eugene Jarecki's award-winning documentary exploring Julian Assange, WikiLeaks and the price of truth. Fittingly, when traditional gatekeepers blocked the film, it found a route to audiences through the Bitcoin community.

Full Bitfest ticket holders can then join our exclusive pre-event drinks reception to meet fellow Bitcoiners and get the weekend started. HACKATHON 20-21 NOVEMBER - MOMENTUM SUITE BUILD SOMETHING BITFEST HACK ZONE + HACKATHON More than 24 hours of building across Nostrshire + Bitfest. The Bitfest Hack Zone combines an open-format Bitcoin & Nostr Hackathon with participant-led workshops, demos, talks and unconference sessions. Bring an idea. Find a team. Join a build. Or just come and learn.

2 DAYS Friday + Saturday 24+ HOURS From kick-off to submission OPEN FORMAT Bitcoin and/or Nostr Supported by EXPLORE THE HACK ZONE DAY 0 NOSTRSHIRE 9am - 6pm - 20 NOVEMBER - PENDULUM HOTEL Nostrshire is the UK's first full-scale Nostr conference, bringing together builders, developers, creatives and enthusiasts under one roof, all in one day. We would have added freedom fighters to the list, but we would say that all these people are on the cutting edge of freedom, privacy and decentralisation technology. With 5 events and 8 zones Bitfest was created to be a bastion of Bitcoin education, culture and community for the UK. Bitcoiners together strong! Read More 2025 GALLERY Check out some of the action from Bitfest 2025. SEE MORE FAQ What is Bitfest? Bitfest is the UK's flagship Bitcoin festival, bringing together Bitcoin, Nostr, freedom technology, music, art, culture, workshops, gaming, businesses and communities for one packed long weekend in Manchester. When is Bitfest 2026? Bitfest 2026 runs from 19-22 November 2026, with different events taking place across the long weekend. Where is Bitfest?

Bitfest's main venue is The Pendulum Hotel in Manchester, with events taking place at nearby venues throughout the weekend. Do I need to know about Bitcoin to attend? Absolutely not. Bitfest is for everyone - from people who have been running nodes for years to people who have only just heard about Bitcoin. Come curious, ask questions and get involved. How do I get to Bitfest? Driving From the North - M6 / M61 Follow the M6/M61 towards Manchester, then join the M60 following signs for Stretford. Take M60 Junction 12 and join the M602 towards Salford/Manchester. At the end of the M602, follow the A57 towards Manchester.

Continue onto the A57(M) Mancunian Way and take the second exit, then immediately follow the slip road signed University/Sackville Street. The Pendulum is on Sackville Street. From the South & Midlands - M6 Follow the M6 north and leave at Junction 19, taking the A556 towards Manchester. At the Bowdon roundabout, take the third exit onto the M56 towards Manchester Airport/Manchester. Continue to the end of the M56 and follow the A5103 towards Manchester. At the roundabout beneath the road, take the third exit following A57(M) / Sheffield signs, then take the second exit up the ramp onto the A57(M).

Take the next exit signed University and immediately fork left onto the slip road for University/Sackville Street. The Pendulum is ahead on Sackville Street. From London - M40 / M42 / M6 Follow the M40 north, then the M42/M6 towards Manchester. Continue on the M6 north and leave at Junction 19, then follow the South & Midlands directions above via the A556 and M56. From Manchester Airport - M56 Take the M56 towards Manchester. At the end of the motorway, continue onto the A5103 towards Manchester and follow the same route as above: take the third exit at the roundabout following A57(M) / Sheffield, then the second exit onto the A57(M).

Take the next exit signed University and follow the slip road for University/Sackville Street. Public Transport From Manchester Piccadilly: The Pendulum is around a 10-15 minute walk from Manchester Piccadilly station, or a short taxi ride. From Manchester Oxford Road: The Pendulum is only a few minutes' walk from Manchester Oxford Road station. From Manchester Airport: Direct trains run from Manchester Airport to Manchester Piccadilly, normally taking around 20 minutes. From Piccadilly, The Pendulum is a short walk or taxi ride. Manchester is also well connected by rail from cities across the UK, including London, Birmingham, Leeds, Liverpool and Sheffield. Is there parking nearby? Yes.

There are several car parks within walking distance of The Pendulum, including NCP Circle Square on Oxford Road, which is just a couple of minutes from the hotel. We'll add further details, including any Bitfest/Pendulum parking discounts or codes, here once confirmed. What does my ticket include? There are several ticket options depending on how much of the festival you want to experience. A Full Bitfest Ticket gives you access across the main festival programme and includes the exclusive Bitflix Pre-Event Reception. Can I buy a One Day Pass? Yes.

A One Day Pass can be used for Nostrshire on 20 November or Bitfest on 21 November, and includes access to all zones and the relevant afterparty. What is Bitflix? Bitflix is our Bitcoin Film Zone, returning this year as a pre-festival event. It kicks off the festival with a screening of The Six Billion Dollar Man, followed by the Bitflix Pre-Event Reception. It's a chance to start the weekend with a great film, good conversation and the wider Bitfest community. Who can attend the Bitflix Pre-Event Reception? The Pre-Event Reception is an exclusive benefit for Full Bitfest Ticket holders. One Day Pass and Afterparty-only tickets do not include access to the reception.

Are children welcome at Bitfest? Yes. Bitfest is family-friendly, and children are welcome. For ticketing purposes, a child is anyone under 16. Can I leave my children in the Kids Zone? Yes. The Kids Zone is a supervised play space for children during the festival where they can play safely while parents enjoy the event. It is not intended as a formal childcare or day-care service. The team are DBS checked and appropriate safeguarding procedures are in place. Where can I see the full agenda? The full agenda, including timings, speakers, workshops, performances and other programme details, will be published separately as we get closer to the festival. Can I pay for my ticket with Bitcoin?

Yes. Bitfest tickets are available to purchase in Bitcoin or fiat. I've never been to a Bitcoin event before. Will I fit in? Definitely. Bitfest is deliberately broader than a traditional Bitcoin conference. Whether you're a hardcore Bitcoiner, a Nostr user, a builder, artist, musician, entrepreneur, parent or simply curious about what all the fuss is about, you're welcome. Are there any discount codes for accommodation? Yes. We've secured a discounted accommodation rate at The Pendulum Hotel, our main venue in Manchester city centre - Sackville Street, about a 5-minute walk from Piccadilly Station. Book at the Bitfest rate using code BITFEST - Book now.

If the Pendulum is full, there are several other hotels within a few minutes' walk of the venue. The closest are the ibis Manchester Centre (Princess Street) and the Maldron Hotel Manchester City Centre, both on Charles Street. Also nearby: Motel One Manchester-Piccadilly, Premier Inn Manchester City (Piccadilly), Travelodge Manchester Piccadilly and Malmaison Manchester. We're still confirming rates and discount codes with other local hotels - anything we secure will be added here. I have a different question. How can I get in contact? Complete the form below and we'll be in touch as soon as possible.

## Global Bitcoin Circular Economies Summit 2026

- Record: `curated-global-bitcoin-circular-economies-summit-2026-11-19`
- Source: [verified-discovery.json](sources/verified-discovery.json)
- Starts: 2026-11-19
- Description: Source-backed
- Original page: <https://www.bitcoinbeach.com/summit-blog/bitcoin-circular-economies-summit-2026>

### About the event

## Bitcoin Circular Economies Summit 2026 Two years ago, the Bitcoin Circular Economies Summit was a closed room. Leaders from circular economies around the world, comparing notes, figuring out together what actually works when you try to make Bitcoin a daily medium of exchange instead of a speculative bet. Quiet work. The kind nobody tweets about while it's happening. On November 19-20, 2026, the Global Bitcoin Circular Economies Summit becomes a public conference for the first time, and it's happening in El Zonte. Not San Salvador. Not a hotel ballroom somewhere convenient.

El Zonte, the same stretch of sand where this whole story started, where people were paying for pupusas and surfboards in sats years before anyone outside the country had heard of Bitcoin Beach. It's the first conference of its kind this town has ever hosted. And there's really only one thing it could be about: Bitcoin is money, and the circular economies are the proof. ## Two Years of Building Toward This For two Summits, the focus was internal. Builders talking to builders. Communities in El Salvador, Africa, Southeast Asia, Latin America, comparing what worked, what failed, what scaled. It turned into a real global conversation, even if most people never saw it happen.

The 2026 edition finally opens that conversation to everyone who's been curious from the outside. Leaders, merchants, educators, developers, and honestly, anyone who wants to see what Bitcoin adoption looks like when it's not a headline but a Tuesday afternoon at a market stall. ## What Two Days Actually Look Like This isn't a stage with slides and a Q&A at the end.

It's workshops, panels, and fireside chats built around the questions that actually define where Bitcoin adoption goes next: ● Bitcoin is money: the case from on-the-ground reality● Circular economies: what's working, what's scaling, what's next● Bitcoin for merchants: practical adoption at the point of sale● Education: onboarding the next million users● Adoption: pathways from curiosity to daily use● Tools: the infrastructure powering real-world Bitcoin commerce Every session wraps before sunset. This is El Zonte, after all, and nobody organizing this event forgot that the ocean is right there.

## Who's Already Confirmed The lineup is still growing, but a few names are already locked in, and they set the tone for what this Summit is actually about: ● Jeremy Almond (@jeremyalmond), Co-Founder & CEO of Paystand● Alexandra Navarro (@alex_navarro0), also from Paystand● Gerardo Linares (@GR_Linares1), driving Bitcoin adoption through education and real-world circular economies with Bitcoin Berlin SV and Bitcoin La Laguna● Evelyn Lemus (@Evelynlemus2906), building and educating communities through the same two projects Not a single one of them is on this list because of a headline they made.

They're here because they took Bitcoin out of theory and put it directly into the hands of people who never had financial access before. That's the thread running through this whole event. ## A Beach, Not a Backdrop Come for the panels, but stay for the reason this movement exists in the first place. You're going to hear it straight from the people who built it: why Bitcoin is money, why it matters for the people who've been failed by every other financial system, and why freedom and fairness aren't abstract words when you've watched them play out in a small coastal town.

And between sessions, there's still surf if you want it, there's still that particular warmth of Bitcoin Country that doesn't translate to a conference center anywhere else. This isn't a Bitcoin summit that happens to be near a beach. It only makes sense on this one.

## November in El Salvador Is Getting Busy This isn't even the only Bitcoin event on the calendar this month, and that alone says something about where this country is right now: ● November 10 - Bitcoin Capital Summit● November 11-12 - Bitcoin Historico, San Salvador● November 18-19 - EmTech AI Conference● November 19-20 - Global Bitcoin Circular Economies Summit, El Zonte Four events, one month, in a country that used to make headlines for very different reasons. Now it's builders, educators, and investors filling flights to come see what's actually being built here. ## We're Genuinely Looking Forward to This One Every year this Summit has been a working session behind closed doors.

This year, for the first time, everyone gets to be in the room, and that shift feels like a real milestone, not just for the event but for the movement it represents. El Zonte earned this. The people who built circular economies from nothing, in El Salvador and around the world, earned a stage. Seats are limited, and this is the first time El Zonte has hosted anything like it. If you want to hear, in their own words, why Bitcoin is money, this is the place to be.

## Bitcoin - Was unser Geld morgen wert ist

- Record: `mu-316585521`

### About the event

**Die 7. Females Fit for Finance-Edition hosted by Sara Bratke & Marika Cieslinski** **Thema**: Lerne mit Margot Richter über die Kryptowährung "Bitcoin" und wie du zu deiner finanziellen Souveränität beitragen kannst **Über das Event** Die Möglichkeiten zu investieren und einen Wertspeicher zu finden, sind heute vielfältig und die Flut an Informationen kann schnell überfordern. Aktien, ETFs, Gold, Immobilien und dann gibt es da auch noch Kryptowährungen wie Bitcoin. Margot Richter zeigt, warum Bitcoin für sie ein spannendes Werkzeug ist, um sich als Frau mit finanzieller Unabhängigkeit, Inflation, Altersvorsorge und langfristigem Werterhalt auseinanderzusetzen.

Das Event ist kostenlos (wir freuen uns über freiwillige Spenden). **Inhalt des Impuls-Vortrags** Bevor wir uns Bitcoin genauer ansehen, lohnt sich ein Blick auf etwas, das wir täglich verwenden, aber selten hinterfragen: unser Geldsystem. Margot gibt eine kurze Einführung, wie unser heutiges Geld eigentlich funktioniert, wer es beeinflusst und was das für den Wert unseres Geldes in Zukunft bedeutet. Darauf aufbauend führt Margot verständlich in die Welt von Bitcoin ein. Sie erklärt, was Bitcoin ist, was Bitcoin zum souveränen Wertspeicher machen kann und welche Vorteile und Möglichkeiten Bitcoin gegenüber anderen Investments bietet.

Der Vortrag richtet sich an Frauen, die bisher wenig oder gar keine Berührung mit Bitcoin hatten und das Thema besser verstehen möchten. **Über Margot Richter** Margot beschäftigt sich seit 2020 intensiv mit Bitcoin, Finanz-und Wirtschaftsthemen. Sie gibt hierzu Einsteigerkurse via der Bildungsplatform "Bitucation", organisiert Bitcoin Veranstaltungen für Frauen und ist in der deutschsprachigen Bitcoin Community sehr engagiert. Sie gründete außerdem den "Bitcoin Book Club". Als ausgebildete Wanderinstruktorin leitet sie ebenfalls Wanderungen in Österreich. Margot arbeitet als selbstständige Physiotherapeutin in Wien. Vernetze dich mit Margot: \- Webseite Bitucation [www.bitucation.

com](http://www.bitucation.com/) \- instagram @maggie_rahel \- Telegram @makeitorange96 \- Telegram Gruppe Buchclub [https://t.me/bitcoinbookclub](https://t.me/bitcoinbookclub) \- Telegram Gruppe Wanderungen @21 Million steps to go \- Margots Webseite [www.physiorichter.com](http://www.physiorichter.com/) **Ablauf des Abends** 18:15 Uhr - Ankommen & Netzwerken: bitte kommt rechtzeitig vor Beginn des Vortrages, damit das Ephata-Team genügend Zeit hat, euch kulinarisch zu versorgen.

\~ 19:00 Uhr - Impulsvortrag von Margot Richter Interaktive Q&A-Session Austausch und Diskussion unter den Teilnehmerinnen **Anmeldung** Die Veranstaltung ist kostenlos, wir freuen uns über eine freiwillige Kulturspende vor Ort, um unsere Kosten zu decken. Bitte meldet euch über Meetup an - sollte das nicht funktionieren, gerne per E-Mail an femalesfinance@gmx.net. Wir freuen uns auf einen inspirierenden Abend voller Aha-Momente und finanzieller Souveränität!

₿ Marika & Sara von Females Fit for Finance **Hinweis zu Fotos und Videos** Wir weisen darauf hin, dass am Veranstaltungsort Fotos und Videos angefertigt und zum Zweck der Veranstaltungsdokumentation im Internet und in Drucksorten veröffentlicht werden.

Please RSVP as space will be limited. **When you arrive:** * Someone will be at the main door to greet you and let you in. If this is your first time at one of our meetups, we have a few simple guidelines to enhance everyone's experience: * our meetups and events have a simple and singular focus: **Bitcoin**. All of our topics and discussions will be centered around Bitcoin, the global monetary network, and bitcoin, the reserve asset. ### About the event

Arbitrum hosts Founder House Singapore from October 23 to 25, 2026, in collaboration with Robinhood Chain. This application-only, three-day program is for solo founders and teams with an existing product, prototype or business that can use Arbitrum. It follows a separate online Buildathon held from September 14 to October 4.

Selected teams receive product, technical, go-to-market and fundraising guidance, workshops on Arbitrum tooling, and feedback from mentors and ecosystem participants. Come with an existing project to build a new feature or test a product assumption. Areas of interest include payments, stablecoins, tokenization, DeFi, AI agents, privacy applications and developer infrastructure.

## Money in Motion: The Future of Cross-Border Payments

- Record: `ibw-luma-evt-YVm4KRLRsBEK4un`
- Source: [ibw-side-events.json](sources/ibw-side-events.json)
- Starts: 2026-10-30T11:30:00.000Z
- Description: Source-backed
- Original page: <https://luma.com/z10bdk0l>

### About the event

The infrastructure powering global payments is undergoing a fundamental shift.

Digital assets, emerging financial technologies, and evolving regulatory frameworks are creating new possibilities for how money moves across borders. As traditional financial systems converge with digital asset infrastructure, new opportunities and challenges are emerging for businesses, financial institutions, and investors.

Beyond the promise of faster and more efficient transactions, important questions remain. How can innovation operate within existing regulatory frameworks? What does it take to build reliable, scalable cross-border payment infrastructure? And where do the most compelling opportunities lie for founders and investors?

LedgerPe Labs and Chambers of Rachana Rautray invite you to Money in Motion, an exclusive industry gathering exploring the intersection of regulation, financial infrastructure, digital assets, and venture capital.

The evening will feature a focused industry discussion followed by an opportunity to connect with fellow founders, investors, and professionals shaping the future of global finance.

### The Conversation

One Panel. Multiple Perspectives.

The discussion will explore four interconnected themes:

Regulation & Compliance

Understanding the evolving regulatory landscape for cross-border payments, with a focus on India-UAE corridors, digital asset frameworks, and the responsibilities of financial intermediaries.

Infrastructure & Execution

Examining the practical challenges of building reliable cross-border payment systems, including liquidity, settlement, banking partnerships, interoperability, and operational resilience.

Investment & Opportunities

Exploring emerging business models, opportunities for innovation, and what makes financial infrastructure companies commercially sustainable, scalable, and attractive to investors.

The Road Ahead

Discussing the future of institutional adoption, the convergence of digital assets and traditional finance, and the next generation of global payment infrastructure.

### Evening Agenda

5:00 PM - 6:00 PM | Panel Discussion & Audience Q&A

A moderated conversation exploring the regulatory, technological, and commercial realities of cross-border payments.

6:00 PM - 7:00 PM | Networking & Refreshments

Continue the conversation over refreshments and connect with founders, investors, fintech executives, and professionals working across financial services and digital assets.

### Event Details

Date: Friday, 30 October 2026

Time: 5:00 PM - 7:00 PM IST

Venue: Spotlight Strategic Partners, Andheri East, Mumbai

Format: Industry Panel & Networking

Community Partner: Spotlight Strategic Partners

An evening bringing together the people building, enabling, and investing in the future of cross-border finance.

Limited seats. Registration is subject to approval.

## IBW Future Asset Forum 2026

- Record: `ibw-official-future-asset-forum-2026`
- Source: [ibw-side-events.json](sources/ibw-side-events.json)
- Starts: 2026-11-01
- Description: Source-backed
- Original page: <https://indiablockchainweek.com/future-asset-forum>

### About the event

Hashed Emergent and Mugafi convene Future Asset Forum at Fairmont Mumbai on November 1 and 2, 2026, within India Blockchain Week. The invitation-only forum examines ownership and financing in sports, entertainment and media as AI changes production, localization and distribution. The page lists a 09:00 IST start and describes cross-registration with the Institutional Forum.

### Working program

The organizers plan 18 sessions and have published twelve working titles across four parts:

- Asset value: the financial limits of buying only successful titles; the different underwriting problems of franchises, catalogues and production slates; and the legal and commercial treatment of voice and likeness rights.
- Ownership and financing: debt-based participation, institutional investment in US leagues and Indian franchises, and financial instruments that could support these assets in India.
- Connecting the assets: a live look at disconnected fan datasets, the wider economics of a stadium event, and Indian law concerning provenance.
- Production and demand: AI's effect on production budgets, the business of physical venues and live attendance, and prospective buyers of these assets in 2031.

The proposed discussion format asks each panelist to commit in writing to sharing one previously unpublished figure in the room, off the record. Speaker names are published after the organizers receive written confirmation.

### Participation

Seats are allocated by participant category rather than sold as public tickets. The intended allocation is 40% rights holders and media operators, 20% AI and technology companies, 20% capital providers and family offices, 10% distribution and platforms, and 10% policy, legal and press participants. These are the organizers' allocation targets.

The planned participants include studio principals, franchise and league heads, catalogue owners, personality-rights lawyers, streaming and exhibition operators, venue and live-event businesses, ticketing and payments teams, fan-data platforms, AI companies, structured-finance specialists, insurers and institutional capital providers.

The [forum page](https://indiablockchainweek.com/future-asset-forum#apply) links applications for partners, sponsors and speakers. The stated process is an application followed by a 30-minute conversation about objectives and category fit, then a tailored proposal within a week. Partnership formats include keynote participation, panels or masterclasses, roundtables or workshops, and demonstrations on the partner floor; availability and pricing are by inquiry.

## IBW Institutional Forum

- Record: `ibw-official-ibw-institutional-forum-11-02`
- Source: [ibw-side-events.json](sources/ibw-side-events.json)
- Starts: 2026-11-01
- Description: Source-backed
- Original page: <https://www.indiablockchainweek.com/institutional-forum>
- Original page: <https://indiablockchainweek.com/institutional-forum/apply>

### About the event

Hashed Emergent convenes the IBW Institutional Forum at Fairmont Mumbai on November 1 and 2, 2026. This invitation-only, closed-door forum is a dedicated room within India Blockchain Week Conference, planned for 100 to 120 senior leaders. The format combines keynotes, expert panels and fireside conversations about institutional blockchain adoption.

The intended participants include Indian banks, NBFCs, payments and capital-markets firms, global financial institutions, enterprise technology and tokenization teams, regulators and policy advisers. The organizer seeks C-suite and director-level participants, including heads of digital assets or blockchain, technology and digital officers, payments and settlement leaders, and treasury and capital-markets product heads.

### Discussion areas

- CBDCs and programmable money: conditional disbursements, offline payments and moving the programmable rupee beyond pilots.
- Tokenization and real-world assets: fractional equities, tokenized funds, custody, infrastructure and applicable rules.
- Trade finance and settlement: letters of credit, e-way bills and cross-border settlement on shared systems.
- Capital-markets infrastructure: DLT-based covenant monitoring and regulatory sandbox pilots.
- Institutional DLT: production systems used by enterprise technology providers across Indian institutions.
- AI and blockchain: autonomous agents and verifiable onchain infrastructure.

Discussions follow the Chatham House Rule. Participants may use information from the room without identifying the speaker or their organization.

Attendance requires selection by the programming team. The [delegate application](https://indiablockchainweek.com/institutional-forum/apply) reserves seats for IBW2026 Priority, VIP and Executive VIP pass holders and asks applicants to buy their pass first. The team reviews each application and confirms participation by email. A qualifying pass does not itself secure a forum seat.

## DeFi Security Summit 2026

- Record: `ibw-official-defi-security-summit-day-1-11-01`
