## Can Regulated, Tokenized Assets Trade on Open Onchain Markets? Live Demo & Panel at Hong Kong Fintech Week

- Record: `luma-crypto-FLpxXn0aRE2igwO`
- Source: [luma-crypto-events.json](sources/luma-crypto-events.json)
- Starts: 2026-11-03T08:00:00.000Z
- Description: Source-backed
- Original page: <https://luma.com/tokenized-assets-open-markets-hong-kong>

### About the event

Can Regulated, Tokenized Assets Trade on Open Onchain Markets? is a closed-door session co-hosted by OpenZeppelin and Ethereum Institutional during Hong Kong Fintech Week, limited to 30 senior participants from banks, market infrastructure, and regulated asset issuers.

Bringing regulated assets onto open onchain markets raises real questions for institutions, from who enforces eligibility rules to how investor data stays protected, and there are good reasons most activity still runs on permissioned platforms.

This session explores what is technically possible today and where the open questions remain. Through a live walkthrough of a tokenized money market fund trading on an open onchain market, we'll look at how identity checks can run at every trade without personal data onchain, how a transfer agent can freeze an investor and have the market respect it on the next trade, and how a jurisdiction can be switched off while everyone else keeps trading.

A panel of industry experts then debates who should hold the keys when regulated assets meet open markets, and what it takes for institutions to go live. We close with a drinks reception.

Previous OpenZeppelin institutional events drew senior guests from firms including J.P. Morgan, Citi, UBS, Morgan Stanley, Bank of America, BNY, Fidelity, Mastercard, Deloitte, and more.

### Agenda

16:00 - 16:30

Doors open and welcome coffee

16:30 - 17:00

Live demo - Freeze, Block, Trade: A Regulated Fund on an Open Market (Bram Hoogenkamp, Product Manager, OpenZeppelin)

17:00 - 17:40

Panel: Who Holds the Keys? Control, Compliance and Open Markets (Panelists to be announced)

17:40 - 19:00

Drinks reception and networking

### About us

OpenZeppelin (https://www.openzeppelin.com/) is the security standard for onchain finance. Since 2015, its industry-standard smart contracts library has powered $37 trillion in value transferred, alongside 900+ security engagements for leading institutions, blockchain networks, and protocols including DTCC, Fidelity Digital Assets, WisdomTree, Aave, the Canton Foundation and the Ethereum Foundation. Learn more at openzeppelin.com (https://openzeppelin.com).

Ethereum Institutional (https://ethereuminstitutional.org/) is an independent non-profit accelerating institutional adoption of Ethereum, its L2s and the wider ecosystem. Founded in 2026 with anchor funding from BitMine, SharpLink, Joseph Lubin and Mihai Alisie, it helps institutions move from requirements to live onchain deployments. Learn more at ethereuminstitutional.org (https://ethereuminstitutional.org).

Event Photography

We'll be capturing photos and videos throughout the event. By attending, you agree that we may use event content (including your image) in our marketing materials, social media, and future promotions. If you prefer not to be photographed, please let us know at check-in.

稳定币产品正从试点走向规模化运营。上线之前，团队需要厘清三个问题：产品适用何种牌照，哪些管控措施经得起审计，一旦出现故障，损失由谁承担。三位嘉宾将分别围绕这三个问题展开分享。

君合（JunHe）：解读香港稳定币支付涉及的法律与牌照要点。

## From Yield Bearing Stablecoins, Digital Asset Custodians to Layer 1 protocols: Opportunities at the Intersection of Web3 & TradFi

- Record: `luma-crypto-DqOeGl4izFiC1WT`

### About the event

Join Nara, Hex Trust and XDC Network during Hong Kong FinTech Week to explore opportunities at the intersection of Web3 and traditional finance, covering yield-bearing stablecoins, digital asset custody and Layer 1 protocols.

Connect with industry leaders for an insightful panel discussion and networking.

Agenda | 4 November 2026 | HKT

- 10:00-10:30 AM: Registration & Networking
- 10:30-11:15 AM: Panel Discussion with 3 panelists and a moderator
- 11:15 AM-12:00 PM: Networking

### About Nara

Nara is a PayFi protocol offering a yield-bearing synthetic dollar backed by short-term financing against payment and receivables flows. Stablecoin payments are moving faster than the liquidity infrastructure around them. Stablecoins can settle near-instantly, but many payment companies still need to bridge delays between fiat collection, on/off-ramp conversion, local payout settlement, and stablecoin funding. That timing gap creates working-capital demand. Nara is the liquidity layer for the stablecoin economy because our goal is not simply to produce yield; our goal is to finance useful payment activity with transparent risk allocation.

### About Hex Trust

Hex Trust is a fully-licensed and regulated financial institution for digital assets. It offers a full suite of Markets services, OTC trading, Custody, Staking and Investment Solutions to builders, investors, and service providers. Hex Trust have a global presence with offices in Singapore, Hong Kong, and Dubai.

The mission is to unlock ownership in decentralized markets, with a vision to secure the permissionless future.

### About XDC Network

XDC Network is an enterprise-grade Layer 1 blockchain designed to support trade finance, payments, and the tokenization of real-world assets. Its EVM-compatible infrastructure provides fast settlement, low transaction costs, and energy-efficient performance, enabling institutions, businesses, and developers to build scalable blockchain solutions. Learn more at xinfin.org (https://xinfin.org).

We look forward to welcoming you for a morning of insightful discussions, meaningful connections and new opportunities at the intersection of Web3 and traditional finance.

## RWA 2.0:从资产上链到金融机会触达

### About the event

一、活動背景

Openvault 將於 2026 年 11 月 4 日 聯合 Techub News 在香港灣仔舉辦主題活動 「RWA 2.0：從資產上鏈到金融機會觸達」。

香港金融科技周 x StartmeupHK 是亞洲規模最大、影響力最廣的金融科技旗艦盛會。2026 年，兩大盛事進一步合流，以「Fintech Nexus：Bridging the World, Building the Future」為主題，圍繞 AI+、Finance+、Go Global 三大引擎展開，匯聚來自全球 120+ 經濟體的 45,000+ 行業領袖、1,000+ 演講嘉賓、800+ 贊助商／參展商／初創企業，以及 30+ 內地與國際貿易代表團。主論壇於 11 月 2-3 日在香港會議展覽中心舉行，隨後一週延伸至全港多個場地及粵港澳大灣區，舉辦數百場社區與周邊活動。

在金融科技週數百場周邊活動之中，「RWA 2.0」聚焦其中最接近落地的一段賽道：資產完成上鏈之後，金融機會如何真正觸達市場。

───────────────────────────

二、主題闡釋：為什麼是 RWA 2.0

過去兩年，RWA 完成了從概念驗證到批量發行的第一步。政府數字債券、代幣化基金、私募信貸等項目相繼落地，香港的監管框架與沙盒機制亦逐步成型。

資產上鏈解決的是「發行」問題。 債券、基金、私募信貸、商業地產等傳統資產透過代幣化進入鏈上世界，獲得了可分割、可編程、可跨境流轉的新形態。

但發行不等於流動性，上鏈不等於被配置。 分銷渠道能否打通持牌體系？專業投資者如何在合規框架下完成認購與轉讓？二級市場的深度從何而來？這些「最後一公里」的問題，決定 RWA 是停留在技術敘事，還是成為真實的資產類別。

這正是 RWA 2.0 的命題：從「能發行」走向「有人買」。 活動將匯聚資產發行方、資產管理機構、持牌交易平台與合規專業人士，圍繞分銷機制、流動性建設與投資者觸達路徑，分享一線實踐與監管觀察。

───────────────────────────

三、活動信息

- 日期與時間：2026 年 11 月 4 日（星期三）14:00 - 18:00
- 地點：香港灣仔
- 主辦：Openvault ｜ 聯合主辦：Techub News

Co-hosted by Blockchain for Good Alliance and Finoverse, Web3 Career Connect brings together university students, fresh graduates and industry professionals for an open conversation about careers in the evolving Web3 ecosystem.

Hear directly from people working in the industry, explore different career paths and get practical insights into the skills and mindset companies are looking for when hiring young talent.

Head of Talent Acquisition, KuCoin

- Kris Fok

Head of Finoverse Ventures, Finoverse

### About the event

Global Access for Institutional Network - GAIN Edition 5 by Liminal Custody is pleased to invite you to an invite-only banking forum, held in partnership with the Middle East Stablecoin Association (MESA). It brings together banks, regulators, and advisers who are building digital asset capabilities today.

Banks know why they need these capabilities. The harder step is moving from mandate to live implementation. This session focuses on practitioners who have made that move. No vendor pitches. Just what works and what doesn't.

This curated gathering is designed for senior decision-makers seeking:

- Clarity on where banks see the strongest commercial opportunities across custody, stablecoins and cross-border payments, and tokenisation.
- Insight into build-vs-buy, governance, technology, risk and compliance approvals, and operational readiness.
- Direct dialogue with regulators, advisers, and bank practitioners shaping the region's market.

  Co-Founder & CEO @ Thiqwave | Co-Chair, Infrastructure Committee, MESA | LinkedIn (https://www.linkedin.com/in/lukasz-dec/)

  Associate Vice President Digital Assets @ RAKBANK| LinkedIn (https://www.linkedin.com/in/abubakar6725/)

### Agenda

  Attendees arrive. Light refreshments served.
- 10 min | Welcome & Event Introduction
  Ilinca Cartoflea frames the session: practitioners talking about what works and what doesn't.
- 35 min | Fireside: The Opportunity - Why Now and Where Are Banks Moving?
  Dr. Bhaskar Dasgupta on the strategic context.
  - Where are banks seeing the strongest commercial opportunities?
  - What has changed in regulation and technology to make implementation viable?

  Open floor for questions from the room

  Informal conversation. The Liminal team is available for one-to-one discussions.

### Krexa Agents Showdown

The Cursor for trading. Now put your agent to the test.

Krexa lets you turn any trading idea into an AI agent. Choose an existing trading strategy or deploy your own custom strategy, then let your agent trade across venues and markets, from crypto and stocks to prediction markets.

Now, it's time to see whose strategy comes out on top.

Welcome to Krexa Agents Showdown, a competition where AI trading agents go head-to-head on Krexa. Deploy your strategy, compete against other participants, and climb the leaderboard by generating the highest profit.

No real money at stake. Just your strategy against everyone else's.

### How It Works

1. Choose Your Strategy

Start with an existing trading strategy on Krexa or bring your own custom strategy. Build your approach around how you think the markets will move.

2. Deploy Your Agent

Put your strategy to work. Your AI agent can trade across supported venues and markets, including crypto, stocks, and prediction markets.

3. Trade With Krexa Cash

Your agent trades using Krexa Cash, Krexa's simulated trading funds. Experiment with strategies and compete without risking real trading capital.

4. Climb the Leaderboard

Your agent's performance is measured by profit and loss (PnL). Generate the highest profit and claim your spot at the top.

### Prize Pool: $600

Three spots. One leaderboard. Make them count.

1st Place: $300

2nd Place: $200

3rd Place: $100

### Who Can Participate?

Anyone, anywhere.

Whether you're a trader, an AI builder, a developer, or someone curious about autonomous trading, you're welcome. You don't need to build everything from scratch. Start with an existing strategy or deploy your own.

Free to enter. Open worldwide. No real trading capital required.

### Competition Details

- Entry fee: Free
- Trading funds: Krexa Cash (simulated funds)
- Markets: Crypto, stocks, prediction markets, and other markets supported by Krexa
- Strategies: Existing strategies or custom strategies
- Leaderboard: Ranked by profit and loss (PnL)
- Duration: Multiple days; exact dates to be announced
- Total prize pool: $600

### How to Participate

Join the Krexa Discord to get competition updates and instructions on how to participate.

Join Discord: https://discord.gg/BermYSwseM

### The Showdown Begins

Every participant has a strategy. Every agent gets its shot.

Deploy yours. Trade with Krexa Cash. Beat the leaderboard.

Let's see whose agent wins.

Payments don't break at the ledger. They break in the last mile, where money meets a real user, a real bank, a real edge case.

### About the event

Superteam is a network of operators, devs & grantees working on promising Solana projects.

Simply put, it is a gated Slack Workspace for those who satisfy the membership criteria. There's no treasury, take-rate/commissions, or token sale. From its inception, Superteam has chosen to be a collective of sovereigns over a sovereign collective. Any revenue generated is captured by the individual members or teams that self-organize and win a bounty, and secure a grant or venture funding for their ideas.

The community is the product. And members have exclusive access to the product.

Our community call is the one time every week when Superteam India members get together to,

- celebrate wins

### Hong Kong FinTech Week 2026 | Exclusive Industry Salon

Shaping the Next Chapter of Global Finance

The global financial landscape is undergoing a profound transformation. As digital assets become increasingly integrated into institutional markets, investment, trading, and financial infrastructure are entering a new era of innovation.

At the forefront of this evolution, Hong Kong continues to strengthen its position as a global financial hub. As of May 2026, 13 virtual asset trading platforms had been licensed by the Securities and Futures Commission (SFC). Meanwhile, Hong Kong FinTech Week 2026 is expected to convene over 45,000 industry leaders from more than 120 economies, underscoring the city's growing influence in global financial innovation.

As traditional finance and digital assets converge, the industry is moving beyond market exploration toward institutional adoption and real-world implementation.

Against this backdrop, Interlace and QingShi Securities will co-host an exclusive, invitation-only industry salon during Hong Kong FinTech Week 2026. Bringing together 50-60 senior financial executives, institutional investors, and industry leaders, the event will explore emerging opportunities at the intersection of traditional finance, digital assets, and fintech.

### Key Discussion Themes

- Brokerage × Digital Assets | Unlocking new opportunities in institutional financial services
- On-Chain Assets | Asset tokenization and the future of investment infrastructure
- Fintech × Financial Services | Building the next generation of financial infrastructure
- Institutional Adoption & Execution | Turning market opportunities into real-world business applications

### Event Details

Date: November 6, 2026 | Hong Kong FinTech Week

Time: 14:00-18:00 HKT

Location: Hong Kong | Venue details shared upon confirmation Format: Invitation-Only Executive Salon

Limited availability. All registrations are subject to approval.

https://www.interlace.money/

Interlace is building stablecoin banking infrastructure that connects on-chain assets with real-world financial rails. We help businesses use stablecoins as seamlessly as fiat for cross-border payments, card issuing, global accounts, treasury management, and payment acquiring. (8M+ cards issued, trusted by 20,000+ businesses).

## London Workshop: Vaults in Practice – How Financial Institutions Capture Onchain Yield

- Record: `luma-crypto-futrlVtSKm5AC1e`
- Source: [luma-crypto-events.json](sources/luma-crypto-events.json)
- Starts: 2026-11-09T16:00:00.000Z
- Description: Source-backed
- Original page: <https://luma.com/cwufkzk1>

### About the event

This workshop provides a structured, case-study-driven deep dive into onchain vaults as the key primitive of DeFi and tokenized capital markets, led by Steakhouse Financial.

Starting from familiar concepts such as funds and ETFs, the session explains how vaults represent the next step in the evolution of asset management - combining programmable execution, non-custodial design, and real-time risk management. Participants will gain a practical understanding of how vaults work, how they differ from traditional investment vehicles, and why they are increasingly adopted by institutions.

The discussion then moves from fundamentals into live production environments, examining how vaults are deployed, operated, and integrated today. This includes institutional use cases such as platform integrations, as well as operational and compliance considerations when running vault strategies in regulated contexts.

From there, the workshop explores where vault management is expanding next, using concrete production case studies curated and operated by Steakhouse Financial:

- RWA as collateral (Fasanara mF-ONE)
- Fixed-term lending and yield structuring via Pendle
- Leveraged vault strategies (Steakhouse High Yield Turbo)

By the end of the session, attendees will have a clear, example-driven understanding of how vaults are used in practice today, and how the frontier of vault management is shaping the next generation of institutional onchain products.

### About Steakhouse Financial

Steakhouse Financial is the leading curator on DeFi Money Markets (Morpho, Kamino), building earn products for the future of the stablecoin economy. Steakhouse Financial operates at the intersection of real world assets, protocol design, and data-driven DeFi portfolio management. They aspire to empower the world with institutional-grade DeFi tools to raise, manage and distribute the capital they need to make a difference.

For questions, please contact: mail@blockstories.io

### About the event

Who carries the regulatory risk when money moves onchain? How are sanctions reshaping the digital assets landscape?

The night before Digital Assets Summit London, Range and Fieldfisher are hosting an evening for those shaping how digital assets are transforming financial services.

We're bringing together senior finance, treasury, compliance, risk and legal leaders working across stablecoins, digital assets and fiat for an exclusive event.

Galiya Martirosova, a member of Fieldfisher's Sanctions Group, and Farheen Ishtiaq-Stansfeld, from Fieldfisher's Commercial Crime team, join Range for a fireside discussion on sanctions and financial crime risk as institutions start moving value on stablecoin rails, and the governance questions that come with it.

After questions from the room, an evening drinks reception will follow. The conversation will respect the Chatham House Rule and will not be recorded. No slides, no pitches, no panels.

Please bring photo ID. Fieldfisher's visitor procedure requires it for entry, and guests without it cannot be admitted.

Spots are limited. Register now.

### About Fieldfisher

Fieldfisher is an enterprising European law firm built around people. It has market-leading practices in four key sectors of energy and natural resources, technology, financial services and life sciences. Fieldfisher helps clients keep pace with an unpredictable and continually evolving world, with a sector-diverse team of specialist dispute resolution lawyers on hand to assist with conflicts, whatever the size or subject matter. The firm's network spans over 2,200 people across 28 international offices in 14 countries, all of which offer clients highly commercial, pragmatic advice.

Fieldfisher advises businesses across the digital assets ecosystem on navigating an evolving regulatory landscape, managing risk and disputes, and capitalising on new opportunities in financial technology.

For more information: https://www.fieldfisher.com/

### About Range

Range is the leading stablecoin treasury and risk management platform for financial institutions, trusted by the Solana Foundation, Circle, Stellar, Squads, and more. We provide the compliance, risk, and routing systems required to manage and move digital assets safely across blockchains.

Used by fintechs, asset issuers, and custodians, our platform acts as the system of record for digital asset treasuries, aggregating balances, transactions, and counterparties across wallets, custodians, exchanges, and blockchains.

Whether you're building programmable treasuries or privacy flows, Range helps ensure they're safe, compliant, and ready for scale.

Learn more at range.org (https://range.org).

### About the event

Convergence is a curated evening soirée during Das London 2026, hosted by OpenZeppelin for the leaders bringing traditional finance onchain.

Finance is moving onchain. Tokenized funds, stablecoins, digital custody, and onchain settlement are becoming part of institutional infrastructure, and the people building that shift rarely get a room of their own at a conference of 10,000.

This evening is that room: banks, asset managers, payment networks, capital markets infrastructure, fintechs and neobanks, alongside the teams securing and powering their move onchain. Real conversations, away from the noise of the conference floor.

## bitcoin++'s Insider Edition 「bitcoin++'s Insider Edition」は、ビットコインの技術カンファレンス「bitcoin++」が発信するWebマガジンです。世界各地でビットコインをつくる開発者・技術者たちの仕事にスポットを当て、bitcoin++のコミュニティ内外で起きていることを伝えています。 今回のミートアップは、そのInsider Editionの名を冠して東京で開催します。 bitcoin++'s Insider Edition is the web magazine of bitcoin++, the technical Bitcoin conference series. It showcases the work of Bitcoin builders and tech talent around the world, with stories from across the bitcoin++ community and beyond. This Tokyo meetup is held under the Insider Edition name. Web: insider.btcpp.dev (https://insider.btcpp.

dev/) X: @btcinsider__ (https://x.com/btcinsider__) English below↓ ## ビットコインビルダーと過ごす、東京の夜 Arkプロトコルの実装「Bark」を開発する Second の Matthew Vuk さんたちの来日に合わせ、日本のビットコイン開発者 Joe Miyamoto さんをお迎えして、Tokyo Bitcoin Base（TBB）で開催します。 【イベント概要】 日時：2026年11月11日（水）19:00〜21:30（予定） 会場：Tokyo Bitcoin Base 参加費：無料 言語：英語 ゲスト：Matthew Vuk（Second）、Joe Miyamoto ほか こんな方におすすめ - ビットコインの開発やプロトコルに関わっている、または興味がある方 - ビットコインのスケーリング技術について、つくっている本人から話を聞きたい方 - 海外のビットコイン開発者と交流したい方 【タイムテーブル】 詳細は後日お知らせします。 ※プログラムや内容は予告なく変更になる場合があります。 【ゲストについて】 Matthew Vuk（Second／Researcher） Arkプロトコルの実装「Bark」を開発するSecondのリサーチャーです。カナダのウィルフリッド・ローリエ大学でビットコインクラブを立ち上げ、大学生向けのビットコイン開発者教育にも取り組んできました。bitcoin++などの技術カンファレンスにも登壇しています。2026年には、アフリカのモバイルマネーをArkで決済する取り組みにも関わっています。 Joe Miyamoto（ビットコイン開発者） バイオインフォマティクスの研究者からビットコイン開発者に転身し、国内外の暗号資産取引所で開発に携わってきました。.

NETでライトニングネットワークを扱うライブラリ「DotNetLightning」や、ライトニングのLoop機能を汎用化した「NLoop」の開発者です。Bitcoin Tokyo 2024では技術ワークショップを担当し、パネルのモデレーターも務めました。 Andrei（ビットコイン開発者） ## A Tokyo Evening with Bitcoin Builders Matthew Vuk of Second, the team building Bark (an implementation of the Ark protocol), and other builders are coming to Tokyo. To mark the occasion, Tokyo Bitcoin Base (TBB) is hosting this event with them and Japanese Bitcoin developer Joe Miyamoto.

【Event Overview】 Date & Time: Wednesday, November 11, 2026, 19:00-21:30 (tentative) Venue: Tokyo Bitcoin Base Admission: Free Language: English Guests: Matthew Vuk (Second), Joe Miyamoto, and more Recommended For - Anyone working on or interested in Bitcoin development and protocols - Anyone who wants to hear about Bitcoin scaling from the people building it - Anyone who wants to connect with Bitcoin developers from abroad 【Schedule】 Details will be announced soon. ※ Event details are subject to change without prior notice. 【About the Guests】 Matthew Vuk (Researcher, Second) Matthew is a researcher at Second, the team behind Bark, an implementation of the Ark protocol.

He founded the Bitcoin club at Wilfrid Laurier University in Canada and has worked on onboarding university students into Bitcoin development. He speaks at technical conferences such as bitcoin++, and in 2026 helped bring Ark-based settlement to mobile-money systems in Africa. Joe Miyamoto (Bitcoin Developer) Joe moved from bioinformatics research into Bitcoin development, and has worked as a developer at both domestic and international cryptocurrency exchanges. He is the creator of DotNetLightning, a library for working with the Lightning Network on.NET, and NLoop, a generic implementation of Lightning Loop. At Bitcoin Tokyo 2024 he ran a technical workshop and moderated panel sessions.

### About the event

Fireblocks and Linum Labs are bringing together a select group of the Fireblocks community for an afternoon of focused conversation at The Vineyard, at the foot of Table Mountain, followed by drinks and bites. Moving money across Africa is still slow, expensive and fragmented. FX friction, multi-day settlement and layered intermediary fees hold back trade, remittances and treasury operations across the continent. This roundtable is a private forum for our key partners and customers to ask whether stablecoins and digital assets can fix it, and what it would take to make that work in practice. What we'll explore - The real cost of cross-border payments and FX across African corridors - Where stablecoins and digital assets are already improving speed and settlement - Regulatory, liquidity and on/off-ramp realities - What institutions need to move from pilots to production The format - 4:00 PM: Presentation - Afterwards: Drinks and bites, to continue the conversation

This is why Midas created The Clearing House, a curated event series for the architects of onchain financial markets. We bring together the primary sources for an invite-only session focused on the real advancement of tokenisation, lending and asset management.

No fluff, no wasted time, just the conversations that move the needle. ## Invitation Only To ensure a high-signal environment, this is a private event. Attendance is strictly limited and accessible only to approved guests. ## Who Will Be There? ## Whitepaper Reading Club × Open Note Labs November Edition: Uniswap v4 Hooks For November's edition of Whitepaper Reading Club, we're partnering with Open Note Labs (https://on-labs.org/)to dive into Uniswap v4 Hooks and the expanding design space they enable. Uniswap v4 introduces hooks: customizable smart contracts that execute at specific points in a liquidity pool's lifecycle. By allowing developers to extend pool behavior without modifying the underlying protocol, hooks open up new possibilities for automated market makers, liquidity management, and onchain financial applications.

We'll explore the architecture behind Uniswap v4, how hooks work, and what this new levels can be unlocked for the future of programmable finance. Discussion topics include: - Hooks and the Uniswap v4 architecture - Dynamic fees, custom accounting, and liquidity management - New mechanisms for market making and onchain trading - Emerging applications and design possibilities enabled by hooks Reading: Uniswap v4 Core Whitepaper (https://app.uniswap.org/whitepaper-v4.pdf) ## Moderator: Ryan Hall Ryan has been at Chainlink working on their smart contract since 2018. He then lea smart contract development at Lagrange and now at Polymarket.

He's one of the best engineers that I know and knows Solidity like the back of his hand :) ## About Whitepaper Reading Club We are a community of founders, researchers, and builders across Singapore, Malaysia, San Francisco, Bangkok, New York, Lagos, Taipei, and Hong Kong. ## Bitcoin on Sui: Getting Started with Hashi

- Record: `luma-crypto-M0D3pED64DdvZ74`
- Source: [luma-crypto-events.json](sources/luma-crypto-events.json)
- Starts: 2026-11-12T11:00:00.000Z
- Description: Source-backed
- Original page: <https://luma.com/ticfmzzo>

### About the event

Bitcoin is the largest pool of idle capital in crypto, and most of it never moves, because using it anywhere else has meant handing it to a custodian or a wrapped-token bridge. Hashi is Sui's answer. Your BTC stays on Bitcoin, held at an address controlled jointly by Hashi's validator committee, which signs with threshold MPC, and an independent guardian layer. Against it, hBTC is minted on Sui and works across Sui apps. Burn the hBTC and the BTC is released back on Bitcoin. Hashi is now live on Sui mainnet in a phased rollout, partners first, backed by more than $500 million in commitments from over 20 partners including Anchorage Digital. In early November about 9.

6 hBTC had been minted onchain, and you can watch that number grow. This session explains how Hashi works under the hood and gets you building with it. We read the live mainnet deployment directly: the Hashi object, the deposit and withdrawal queues, the committee and the hBTC supply. Then we use the Hashi TypeScript SDK on testnet with Bitcoin signet to run the full user journey: generate a personal Bitcoin deposit address for a Sui account, send signet BTC to it, follow the deposit through committee approval until hBTC is minted, and request a withdrawal back to Bitcoin. You build hBTC Desk, a small app that runs the testnet round trip and shows the live mainnet numbers beside it.

What You'll Learn - How Hashi keeps BTC on Bitcoin: per-account deposit addresses, joint control by the validator committee and the guardian layer, threshold MPC signing, and how hBTC is minted and burned - What is live today: reading the mainnet package, the deposit and withdrawal queues and the hBTC supply with GraphQL, and what a phased rollout means for builders - The SDK: @mysten/hashi, generating a deposit address, submitting a deposit, tracking its status, and requesting or cancelling a withdrawal - Building on hBTC: using it like any other Sui coin in your own Move code and programmable transactions, with 8 decimals and integer base units from end to end - Honest limits: the SDK is pre-1.

0 and not yet wired to mainnet, deposits wait for Bitcoin confirmations and a time delay, and how to show pending states so nobody pays twice - How to ship hBTC Desk: deposit signet BTC, watch hBTC arrive on Sui testnet, withdraw back to a Bitcoin address, and compare it with the live mainnet numbers Who Should Attend - DeFi builders who want Bitcoin as collateral in lending, trading or vaults - Wallet and payments teams that want to hold and move BTC inside Sui apps - Developers who joined the bridging and CCTP sessions and want the Bitcoin side of the story - Bitcoin holders curious how BTC can be used on another chain without giving up custody to a single company What to Bring - Laptop with Node.

js 22+ and pnpm, and the latest @mysten/sui and @mysten/hashi - A Sui testnet wallet - A Bitcoin wallet that supports signet, such as Sparrow. We share a signet faucet in class - Basic TypeScript. No Bitcoin scripting required Join us at SuiHub to learn, build, and connect with fellow developers pushing the boundaries of the Sui ecosystem.

## Race Against the Machine: AI, Quantum and the Future of Bitcoin

- Record: `luma-crypto-MEbXp19ZPmMKn0A`
- Source: [luma-crypto-events.json](sources/luma-crypto-events.json)
- Starts: 2026-11-12T16:00:00.000Z
- Description: Source-backed
- Original page: <https://luma.com/j8ks5br9>

### Intro

Almost everything we trust online, from banking and web traffic to messaging and digital identity, rests on public-key cryptography. Two threats are now calling that very foundation into question. Quantum computers could break today's signatures and key exchange, with the hardware required shrinking steadily. AI could reach the same result with breakthroughs in mathematics, and it is already helping quantum attacks along by optimizing the circuits behind them.

The synergy between them is unmistakable, and even the post-quantum schemes meant to replace today's cryptography may not be safe either. With finance and the internet facing a long, fragmented migration, the stakes are highest where cryptography protects value directly. Cryptocurrencies add their own exposure: public keys sit on a public ledger, assets are bearer instruments, and theft is irreversible. Given Bitcoin's history, the challenge is particularly acute: every serious option (do nothing, freeze, force a deadline) violates a principle the Bitcoin community cares about, and the work must start before the threat is visible.

Join us at this interdisciplinary event where AI, quantum and Bitcoin experts come together in a novel panel to discuss the technical foundations of this challenge and its potential solutions.

### Program

17:00 Arrival

17:30 Intro

17:35 Keynote 1: Quantum

17:55 Keynote 2: Bitcoin

18:15 Q&A

19:00 Networking

### Speakers

Wadim Wormsbecher:

> Theoretical physicist turned tech innovator. With a PhD from Humboldt-Universität zu Berlin and a background developing AI products, Wadim now works at Bundesdruckerei focusing on applied cybersecurity in the era of Quantum and AI. His focus goes beyond hardware. AI-driven discoveries and algorithmic improvements can reduce the resources needed to challenge today's cryptography. Understanding these shifts is essential to assessing quantum threats and making informed security decisions.

>

> https://www.linkedin.com/in/wadimwormsbecher/

Fabian Jahr:

> Fabian Jahr has contributed to Bitcoin Core since 2019 and currently works on it full-time with a grant from Brink. He reviews critical changes to Bitcoin Core, develops ASMap for a more decentralized peer-to-peer network, and researches protocol upgrades. With the support of the Human Rights Foundation, he published a report on how Cross-Input Signature Aggregation could change Bitcoin, and he is now turning it into a soft fork proposal with BIPs 458 to 460.

>

> https://fjahr.com/ https://brink.dev/

Manuel Moran:

> Over the past 12 years, Manuel has built software across research, media, and both traditional and decentralized finance. His path has run from software engineering, through data science and machine learning, to AI engineering, where he now owns end-to-end agentic workflows. At the ephesto consultancy he collaborates with experts in design, strategy, finance, and law to help organizations stay competitive as AI redefines what it takes to be successful.

>

> https://ephesto.com/

This event is organized by Leap Quantum Technology Hub as part of the Thursday Gathering by Venture Café Berlin.

https://leap.berlin/ https://venturecafeberlin.org/

## Whitepaper Reading SF - Defi Topics: No Place to Hide & Active Liquidity On Chain

- Record: `luma-crypto-bDcxH60c9qvNp0x`
- Source: [luma-crypto-events.json](sources/luma-crypto-events.json)
- Starts: 2026-11-13T01:30:00.000Z
- Description: Source-backed
- Original page: <https://luma.com/snrgc7jo>

### About the event

Discussion Topics As more trading moves through private RPCs and protected submission channels, the question is how much safety those protections actually buy. No Place to Hide examines three years of activity across six chains and finds sandwich attacks against supposedly protected transactions on four of them. The exposure comes from order-flow auctions, validators, applications, reorgs, and even an RPC bug. We'll ask what "protected" should mean when keeping a trade out of the public mempool still leaves multiple ways for attackers to see it coming, and whether protection can hold without securing the full path from wallet to execution.

We'll also cover Active Liquidity On Chain, a study of proprietary AMMs across Solana, Base, and Monad. These venues let a single operator supply inventory and update prices without waiting for a trade, helping them avoid the stale quotes that arbitrageurs exploit in passive AMMs. The paper finds better prices for flow used as a proxy for retail trading, alongside pricing that varies by counterparty and evidence of quotes that worsen at execution. The core discussion is whether tighter spreads justify opaque pricing rules, and how aggregators should route trades when the price they see may differ from the price users receive.

Reading Overview - No Place to Hide: Where private transaction protections fail, and what it takes to secure the full path from wallet to execution. - Active Liquidity On Chain: How proprietary AMMs improve pricing, and the trade-offs around transparency, routing, and execution quality. Full Documents - No Place to Hide (https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.28115) - Active Liquidity On Chain (https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38056) Format - 10 minutes of silent reading to start. - Discussion first, with no panels. - Bring questions - technical depth is welcomed. - Short notes and key takeaways shared after the session.

About Whitepaper Reading Club Whitepaper Reading Club is a community of 800 builders, founders, and researchers across Singapore, Malaysia, San Francisco, Lagos, Bangkok, and New York. The community meets in person every month to discuss the latest blockchain projects. The club creates detailed, easy-to-understand summaries for each paper and has held more than 70 sessions since June 2023, covering topics from Account Abstraction, Parallel Chains, and EIPs to the Bitcoin ecosystem and AI × crypto. It is ecosystem-agnostic and not for profit, with a strong focus on projects with technical, product, or social innovations.

Dimes, our community partner, connects builders with the people, resources, and support to turn ideas into reality. Our host venue, localhost, is Dimes' co-working and event space in downtown San Francisco, created for builders to meet, share ideas, and connect. We're excited to host this event with Whitepaper Reading Club.

## About This Event TSC Summit East Coast brings the Trusted Smart Chain community together in Fort Lauderdale for a weekend of connection, education, and an inside look at what's ahead. Node owners, founding community members, and prospective members are invited to join us for two days centered around Trusted Smart Chain, including where the ecosystem stands today, the continued development of Nova DAO governance, and the future of native RWA+ issuance on TSC. The weekend begins Friday evening with a waterfront Welcome Dinner hosted by T7X.

On Saturday, attendees will hear directly from members of the Founding Team during a full day of TSC overview sessions, updates, and discussions, beginning with morning coffee and continuing through the afternoon with lunch provided. One registration includes access to both Friday and Saturday events. There is a separate registration for the VIP Titan + event. utm_campaign=301742827) ## What This Summit Is About Capital Markets, Rebuilt Trusted Smart Chain is a Layer 1 blockchain engineered to support the tokenization of Real-World Assets (RWA+), creating infrastructure designed to serve institutions and individuals alike. Community Governance Nova DAO brings decentralized governance to the TSC ecosystem, giving participating node owners and community members a voice in the continued development and direction of the network.

## What to Expect Friday Checkin begins at 5:30 Dinner 6:00 PM - 8:00 PM Welcome Dinner hosted by T7X Ocean View Terrace Saturday Check in begins at 9:00 AM Doors Open & Morning Coffee Caribbean IV-V 10:00 AM - 5:00 PM TSC Overview Sessions Caribbean IV-V 12:00 PM Lunch Caribbean IV-V ## Attire Friday Welcome Dinner: Hawaiian shirts encouraged. Come ready for a relaxed, waterfront evening. Saturday Summit: Business casual. Florida weather in November is typically warm, so we recommend dressing accordingly. ## Photography & Media Notice Photography, video, and audio may be captured throughout the weekend.

By attending, guests acknowledge that event media may be used for future promotional, marketing, and community-related purposes. Full terms also live at tscsummit.com/terms (https://tscsummit.com/terms).

### About the event

Not Your Keys, Not Your Cheese: Wallet and Security for Solana at Breakpoint Unlimited pizza and drinks for all, inside the Breakpoint venue. Stay in the main Olympia building... and spend the afternoon with leaders in wallets, security and monitoring. No guest list, just turn up. Juno takes up to 450 standing, so drop in any time between 12:00 and 17:00 on Breakpoint's opening day. Hosted by Blockaid: Blockaid is the onchain security platform for monitoring, detecting and responding to onchain and offchain threats. Ledger: Ledger's main activity is the security of digital assets. It designs and markets hardware and software for managing and securing crypto assets.

Utila: Utila helps organisations of all sizes securely manage and build on stablecoins and digital assets. It is an institutional MPC wallet provider for stablecoin payments, custody, treasury, trading and tokenisation. OtterSec: OtterSec works with leading teams across multiple blockchains to provide a holistic and collaborative approach to security. It has secured more than $36B in onchain value and audited more than 120 projects. Olympix: Olympix is an pre-audit smart contract testing platform that secures more than $155B in assets across customers such as Circle, Aave, Securitize, and Ethena. It allows teams to surface audit level findings and what audits and AI miss during development.

The venue Juno, Olympia: Juno is the UK's biggest Italian restaurant, run by Incipio Group in the Grade II listed National Hall at Olympia. Grab a slice, find a seat out of the rain, and meet the people keeping Solana's wallets and users safe. See you there.

### About the event

## ¡La Casa de Satoshi cumple dos años! ¿Quieres pagar con Bitcoin? Encontrarás las instrucciones al final de esta página. Para celebrarlo, estamos preparando el evento más grande que hemos organizado hasta ahora: un domingo completo dedicado a la comunidad Bitcoin de México, a las personas que la hacen posible y a los proyectos que están construyendo su futuro. Para esta celebración nos hemos aliado con Rodrigo Coutiño, reconocido autor de libros best seller como MoneyCoach, InvestorCoach y BusinessCoach, para presentar el lanzamiento oficial de su nueva obra: BitcoinCoach.

El domingo 15 de noviembre de 2026 reuniremos en La Casa de Satoshi a emprendedores, comunidades, empresas, educadores y bitcoiners de todo el país. Será una celebración de todo lo que hemos construido juntos durante estos dos años y, al mismo tiempo, el comienzo de una nueva etapa para La Casa de Satoshi. ## Durante el evento tendremos: El lanzamiento oficial de BitcoinCoach, presentado por su autor, Rodrigo Coutiño. Después de la presentación, Rodrigo convivirá con la comunidad y firmará ejemplares del libro. Lightning pitches de proyectos y empresas Bitcoin en México. Hasta diez participantes tendrán entre dos y tres minutos para compartir lo que están construyendo.

La historia de La Casa de Satoshi y un anuncio especial sobre su futuro, presentado por Santiago Varela Belmont junto con el equipo de la Casa. ₿ Un anuncio especial de Aureo, presentado por Gustavo Flores Echaiz, seguido del arranque oficial de la fiesta. Una gran parrillada para celebrar el aniversario. Música, convivencia y muchas oportunidades para conocer a las personas que están impulsando Bitcoin en México. ## ¿Qué incluye tu boleto? Un ejemplar de BitcoinCoach de Rodrigo Coutiño, con un precio habitual de $389 MXN en Amazon. Conoce el libro aquí (https://investor.com.mx/bitcoincoach/). Acceso a todas las presentaciones y actividades del programa. Parrillada y bebidas.

Si ya has venido a alguna de nuestras fiestas, sabes que se pone bueno. ¡La fiesta de aniversario de La Casa de Satoshi! Maciej Cepnik será el maestro de ceremonias. Este encuentro es para toda la comunidad: quienes han estado con nosotros desde el comienzo, quienes se han sumado durante estos dos años y quienes visitarán La Casa de Satoshi por primera vez. Queremos reunir en un mismo lugar a la comunidad Bitcoin más grande de México para celebrar lo que ya existe, descubrir nuevos proyectos y compartir todo lo que viene. Las empresas, startups y proyectos participantes se anunciarán próximamente.

## Programa preliminar 12:00 p. m. | Apertura de puertas y recepción Registro, convivencia y recepción de asistentes. ¡Llega temprano! Tendremos sorpresas, libros y mucho más para quienes nos acompañen desde el inicio. 1:00-1:30 p. m. | Lanzamiento oficial de BitcoinCoach Presentación del nuevo libro con su autor, Rodrigo Coutiño. 1:30-2:00 p. m. | Lightning pitches Hasta diez presentaciones de proyectos, empresas y comunidades que trabajan con Bitcoin en México. Cada participante tendrá entre dos y tres minutos, con breves intervenciones entre las presentaciones.

2:00-2:15 p. m. | La historia y el futuro de La Casa de Satoshi Celebración de los dos años, presentación del equipo y anuncio especial de Santiago Varela Belmont sobre la nueva etapa de La Casa de Satoshi. 2:15-2:30 p. m. | Anuncio especial de Aureo y arranque de la fiesta Presentación de Gustavo Flores Echaiz y apertura oficial de la celebración. A partir de las 2:30 p. m. | Parrillada y fiesta de aniversario Firma de libros y fotografías con Rodrigo Coutiño, música, comida, convivencia y networking con la comunidad. 7:00 p. m. | Cierre del evento Los horarios son aproximados y podrán ajustarse conforme confirmemos a los proyectos, empresas e invitados participantes.

La Casa de Satoshi, Ciudad de México Domingo 15 de noviembre de 2026 Puertas abiertas desde las 12:00 p. m. Inicio del programa a la 1:00 p. m. Ven a celebrar con nosotros dos años de encuentros, aprendizaje, amistad y construcción comunitaria. ¡Nos vemos en la gran fiesta de aniversario de La Casa de Satoshi! ₿ ## ¿Quieres pagar con Bitcoin? Haz clic en el botón de boletos con Bitcoin y completa tu registro. Después recibirás un correo de maciej@aureobitcoin.com con las instrucciones para realizar tu pago con Bitcoin. Si quieres aprovechar el descuento por pagar con Bitcoin, pero todavía no tienes, visita aureobitcoin.com (https://aureobitcoin.com) para comprar tus primeros bitcoins.

## Patrocinado por Aureo Este evento es patrocinado por Aureobitcoin.com (https://www.aureobitcoin.com/es), la plataforma Bitcoin de México para personas, empresas y patrimonios. Aureo facilita la compra y venta de Bitcoin con precios transparentes y custodia bajo el control de cada usuario. También ofrece soluciones especializadas para tesorerías empresariales, operaciones OTC y gestión patrimonial, acompañadas de atención personalizada e investigación enfocada en el mercado mexicano.

You're invited to a private dinner hosted by Privy & Bridge. Join a select group of leaders across fintech, payments and web3 for an intimate evening of great food and thoughtful conversation. Please confirm your attendance by Nov 12. ---- Stripe (https://stripe.com/) brings together fiat and stablecoin infrastructure on one platform, making it easier for businesses to build, launch, and scale global financial products. This includes Privy's embedded wallet infrastructure and Bridge's stablecoin orchestration capabilities, enabling businesses to hold, move, and spend money across traditional and blockchain rails. Visa (https://www.visa.co.

uk/) is a global leader in digital payments, connecting consumers, businesses and financial institutions across more than 200 countries and territories. Open Standard (https://joinopenstandard.com/)is the company behind Open USD (OUSD). Its mission is to build internet-native money, enabling all businesses to move money on infrastructure that's cheaper, faster, more global and more programmable.

Over 200 financial institutions, fintechs, banks, and global businesses have signed up to add OUSD to their platforms and benefit from low fees, shared rewards, and representative governance. Open Standard was started in 2026 and its founding partners include Coinbase, Mastercard, Shopify, Stripe, and Visa.

### About the event

Join us at Solana Fitness Zone at Breakpoint London 2026 for a Group Reiki Experience led by Jennifer, Canadian Certified Counsellor and Reiki Master, from Echo Alignment for founders + builders, hosted by Solana Foundation (https://solana.org/) x OFFLINE (https://x.com/getofflinexyz?utm_source=luma).

What's reiki? A Japanese relaxation practice where a practitioner uses gentle, light touch or hovering hands to promote calm and balance. Stocks, treasuries, perps, prediction markets, memecoins and AI traders are all heading on-chain at once, the inflection point is here. So we've done the sensible thing and taken over a pub. ## ¿Qué aporta una Blockchain regulada? - Encuentro #139 SuperPioneros

- Record: `luma-crypto-4aQg4F5ApsIZFHS`
- Source: [luma-crypto-events.json](sources/luma-crypto-events.json)
- Starts: 2026-11-16T16:30:00.000Z
- Description: Source-backed
- Original page: <https://luma.com/9na7snow>

### About the event

SuperPioneros - Encuentro #139

Lunes 16 de noviembre - 17:30h

Madrid Innovation Lab - Madrid

Durante años hemos hablado de las posibilidades de Blockchain. Pero ahora que empresas, instituciones y desarrolladores empiezan a construir soluciones reales, surge una nueva pregunta:

¿Qué aporta realmente una Blockchain regulada frente a otras infraestructuras?

El próximo 16 de noviembre celebramos nuestro Encuentro #139 de SuperPioneros, donde reuniremos a empresas, instituciones, emprendedores y builders para debatir sobre el papel de las nuevas infraestructuras Blockchain L1 reguladas y las oportunidades que abren para el ecosistema.

Y lo haremos junto a ISBE, la iniciativa de Alastria para impulsar una infraestructura Blockchain pública permisionada, diseñada para facilitar el desarrollo de casos de uso empresariales.

### LOS PROTAGONISTAS

Contaremos con:

Miguel Calero, Director Ejecutivo de ISBE, quien compartirá la visión del proyecto, su evolución y las oportunidades que ofrece a empresas y desarrolladores.

José Luis Cáceres, CEO de NWC10 y SuperPioneros, quien conducirá el encuentro y conectará el debate con los desafíos y oportunidades de nuestra Comunidad.

Próximamente anunciaremos nuevos invitados y empresas con casos de uso reales.

### ¿DE QUÉ HABLAREMOS?

Queremos abrir una conversación que vaya más allá de la tecnología.

Blockchain regulada vs. otras infraestructuras. ¿Qué ventajas ofrece realmente y cuándo tiene sentido utilizarla?

Empresas e instituciones. ¿Qué necesitan para adoptar Blockchain con confianza y seguridad jurídica?

Tokenización y nuevos modelos de negocio. ¿Qué oportunidades aparecen para sectores como finanzas, inmobiliario, energía o industria?

Casos de uso reales. ¿Qué están construyendo las empresas y qué barreras encuentran para llevar sus proyectos a producción?

Talento y oportunidades. ¿Cómo conectar a las empresas que necesitan soluciones con los builders capaces de desarrollarlas?

No queremos únicamente escuchar presentaciones.

Queremos generar debate, compartir experiencias y descubrir qué podemos construir juntos.

### DEL DEBATE A LA CONSTRUCCIÓN

Con Bit2Me como desafío número 1 de SuperPioneros, seguimos impulsando una Comunidad de más de 80.000 innovadores que conecta talento, empresas, instituciones e inversores alrededor de la IA, Blockchain, Web3 y las tecnologías emergentes.

A través de nuestros desafíos 444, queremos ayudar a que las empresas encuentren dentro de la Comunidad los recursos, conocimientos y conexiones necesarios para avanzar hacia sus objetivos durante los próximos cuatro meses.

Y este encuentro representa una oportunidad para conectar infraestructuras como ISBE con empresas que tienen necesidades reales y builders que quieren construir soluciones.

Porque el futuro de Blockchain no dependerá únicamente de la tecnología.

Dependerá de los problemas que seamos capaces de resolver con ella.

Lunes 16 de noviembre de 2026

17:30h

Madrid Innovation Lab - Madrid

¿Qué aporta una Blockchain regulada?

El 16 de noviembre abrimos el debate.

¡GANAS DE VEROS!

### About the event

What if your 3D printer could do more than manufacture objects? What if it could mine Bitcoin at the same time? Join us for a preview of Proof of Print (https://www.proof-of-print.com/), a new 3D printer that combines the power of 3D printing and Bitcoin mining. As well as a filament dryer that similarly uses its heating element to mine Bitcoin. Come see the technology in action, meet others across the 3D printing and Bitcoin communities, and discover the possibilities of combining physical manufacturing with decentralized computing!

### About the event

About Event Digital infrastructure and agentic systems are moving from pilot to production across financial services, and retail and wealth customers are where the impact shows up first. What banks offer, how it's priced and personalised, and how customers are served are all being redesigned. Some institutions are rebuilding around these capabilities while others are still running proofs of concept, and the gap is widening. This panel brings together builders across digital banking and blockchain infrastructure to unpack what's working, what's holding others back, and what customers can expect next.

On the agenda: - How banks and fintechs are deploying AI in retail and wealth, beyond the pilot stage - From product shelf to personalised portfolio: how agentic systems change what gets offered, and to whom - The adoption divide: why some institutions are moving faster, and what's driving the gap - AI, blockchain and tokenisation: how they work together today, and where that's heading - What it means to be a bank when more of the customer relationship is handled by intelligent systems Speakers: - Dwaipayan Sadhu, CEO, Trust Bank - Thomas Zhu, Founder & CEO, AlloyX - Adeline Kim, Group Country Manager, Regional SEA and SVP, Global Clients Asia Pacific, Visa - Nick Woodruff, Head of Venture Building, SC Ventures (Moderator) This panel is one of several sessions at SC Ventures Lab Crawl, a full-day event.

About Event For corporates and institutions, slow money is costly. Cross-border settlement takes days, large tickets don't fit faster rails, and liquidity is tied up in buffers and pre-funding. AI agents, tokenised assets and programmable money are starting to change how value moves across markets. This panel brings together leaders in emerging payments and digital infrastructure to look at what's live today, what's scaling next, and how the institutional banking model may need to adapt.

On the agenda: - 24/7 money, 9-to-5 institutions: what happens to liquidity and treasury operations when value settles in minutes, at any hour - Stablecoins, tokenised deposits and tokenised money market funds: which instruments will carry which flows - Programmable money: when treasury and trade rules (release on delivery, sweep above a threshold) are written into the settlement itself - AI agents in treasury: from forecasting cash positions to initiating and settling transactions within set limits - What stays a bank's job: balance sheet, credit, trust and compliance in an automated, always-on market Speakers: - Mark Willis, Managing Director, Head of Emerging Payments, Standard Chartered - Ying-Ying Tan, Global Head of Securities Services and Digital Assets, Standard Chartered - More speakers to be announced - Harald Eltvedt, Operating Partner, SC Ventures (Moderator) This panel is one of several sessions at SC Ventures Lab Crawl, a full-day event.

## SC Ventures Lab Crawl Panel 4: Policy Rewiring: When AI Moves Money

- Record: `luma-crypto-omFX3gMHWVKnFST`
- Source: [luma-crypto-events.json](sources/luma-crypto-events.json)
- Starts: 2026-11-17T05:30:00.000Z
- Description: Source-backed
- Original page: <https://luma.com/obk2oqvj>

### About the event

About Event AI agents are no longer just recommending payments. With stablecoins and programmable rails, they can initiate and settle them too. That raises questions existing rules weren't written for. What should an agent be allowed to do on its own, when does a human need to approve, and who is accountable when something goes wrong? This session brings together banking, blockchain and regulatory perspectives to look at the permissions, oversight and safeguards needed before agents can be trusted to move real value.

On the agenda: - From recommend to execute: what changes when an AI agent can actually move money - Delegated authority: spending limits, approved counterparties and the thresholds that should trigger human approval - Know your agent: how agents are identified, authenticated and tied back to the person or business they act for - When things go wrong: liability for errors, fraud or a compromised agent, and what happens when a stablecoin transaction can't be reversed - Compliance by design: building sanctions screening, AML checks and audit trails into the transaction itself - Are current rules fit for purpose, or does agentic finance need a new rulebook?

Speakers: - Rohan Juneja, Product Director, Digital Assets, Standard Chartered Bank - Aishwary Gupta, Global Head of Business, Polygon - Grace Chong, Head, Financial Services Regulation, Drew & Napier - Kenneth Bok, Director, Digital Assets, SC Ventures (Moderator) This panel is one of several sessions at SC Ventures Lab Crawl, a full-day event. Subscribe to our calendar to see the full lineup and RSVP: https://luma.

### About the event

Two-Part Programme for Private Bankers and Family Office Practitioners in Asia Format: Two sessions of 90 minutes each The programme moves from "what's changing" to "what to do about it." Singapore and Hong Kong are the anchors, as the main booking centres and family office hubs for this audience, with Japan, the Gulf and other markets brought in where they matter to Asian clients. ## Part 1: The Global Tokenisation Landscape Title: From Pilot to Production: Markets, Infrastructure and Regulation in 2026 and beyond Tokenisation is moving from pilot projects into regulated commercial activity across several jurisdictions, marking an important inflection point for digital assets in 2026.

With Singapore and Hong Kong serving as key financial and family office hubs in Asia, developments in tokenised real-world assets, stablecoins and financial market infrastructure are creating new opportunities and considerations for financial institutions, private bankers, family offices and investors. RHTLaw Asia invites you to join our industry and legal experts as we examine the global tokenisation landscape, focusing on the transition from experimentation to commercial implementation, and the regulatory, market and legal developments shaping its future. ## Key Discussion Topics 1.

Global Policy Developments: The Industry View An examination of regulatory and policy developments across the United States, Singapore, Hong Kong and the UAE, including stablecoin legislation, tokenised securities and the growing need for cross-border regulatory recognition and interoperable standards. 2. Market and Infrastructure Reality Check A closer look at the rise of tokenised securities and institutional products, including tokenised investment funds and private credit. The discussion will examine infrastructure choices, public versus permissioned blockchains, settlement systems, interoperability risks and the liquidity challenges facing tokenised private assets.

3. Legal Implications for Investors Tokenisation does not change the underlying legal character of an asset. We will examine the distinction between tokens representing direct ownership rights and synthetic exposure, together with the legal considerations and potential risks for issuers and investors. 4. Panel Discussion and Q&A An interactive discussion bringing together industry and legal perspectives on the opportunities and challenges of tokenisation, and what these developments mean for the future of digital assets in Asia.

## Coming Up: Part 2 - Tokenised Assets: The Investor's Playbook From Insight to Action: Access, Ownership, Risk and Legacy 3 December 2026 | 3:00 pm - 5:00 pm Building on the global developments covered in Part 1, the second session will focus on how private investors and family offices can participate in tokenised assets, including product structures, custody arrangements, investor protection, legal ownership, tax considerations and succession planning. From understanding what's changing to exploring what to do about it. We look forward to welcoming you.

About Event Geopolitical shifts are changing how capital, goods, data and talent move around the world. As markets fragment, new trade corridors are opening, cross-border commerce is changing shape, and traditional models of trade finance and financial intermediation are under pressure. This panel looks at how data, intelligent agents and new financing models can improve efficiency, visibility and trust across borders. It also covers how financial institutions, technology providers and policymakers can help businesses manage more complex trade ecosystems and build more resilient, connected economies.

On the agenda: - Trade in a fragmented world: how geopolitics is redrawing trade corridors, and what that means for businesses and their financing - AI in trade finance: using data and intelligent agents to speed up documentation, credit decisions and risk assessment - Unlocking working capital: alternative financing models for suppliers and SMEs that traditional trade finance struggles to reach - Digital assets on the trade rails: where tokenisation and stablecoins can improve cross-border settlement and liquidity - Building trust across borders: data sharing, visibility and compliance when counterparties sit in different regulatory regimes - Funding regional connectivity: who finances the infrastructure behind the next generation of trade corridors Speakers: - Amelia Ng, CEO, Olea - Rachel Qiu, COO, HashKey - Madhivanan Periannan, CEO, TASConnect - Megha Gupta, Portfolio Management, SC Ventures (Moderator) This panel is one of several sessions at SC Ventures Lab Crawl, a full-day event.

## Hyperliquidとオンチェーンファイナンスの歴史

- Record: `luma-crypto-yMTLSDFnA7KsGZH`

### About the event

English follows Japanese 「あたらしい経済」と「KudasaiJP」が共同運営する企業向けWeb3コミュニティ「Web3 Business Hub（WBH）」では、Web3ビジネスの発展に参考となるセミナーを毎月開催しています。 11月のテーマは「Hyperliquidとオンチェーンファイナンスの歴史」です。 ブロックチェーンを活用した金融サービスは、BitcoinやEthereumの登場を経て、DEX、レンディング、ステーブルコイン、デリバティブなど、さまざまな領域へと発展してきました。特に2020年のDeFi Summer以降、スマートコントラクトによる金融機能の実装が急速に進み、従来の金融機関や中央集権的な取引所を介さない、新しい金融市場の可能性が示されてきました。 その進化を象徴するプロジェクトの一つが、オンチェーンのデリバティブ取引を中心に成長してきた Hyperliquid です。独自のLayer 1ブロックチェーン上で、高速な取引処理とオンチェーンのオーダーブックを実現し、従来の中央集権型取引所（CEX）に近い取引体験を提供することで、分散型金融の新たな可能性を切り拓いています。さらに、HyperEVMによるアプリケーションの拡張など、単なる取引プラットフォームを超えた金融エコシステムへの発展も注目されています。 一方で、オンチェーン金融の発展には、流動性の確保、価格形成、セキュリティ、分散性、ガバナンス、規制対応など、さまざまな課題も存在します。DeFiはこれまでの歴史の中で何を実現し、何を課題として残してきたのでしょうか。そしてHyperliquidのような新しいプラットフォームは、従来の金融市場や暗号資産取引所のあり方をどこまで変えるのでしょうか。 今回のWeb3 Business Hubでは、DeFiの誕生からDeFi Summer、DEXやオンチェーンデリバティブの進化、そしてHyperliquidの成長に至るまで、オンチェーン金融の歴史を振り返ります。あわせて、Hyperliquidの仕組みや成長の背景、既存の金融サービスとの違い、今後の事業機会と課題についても整理します。 金融サービスは、どこまでオンチェーンで実現できるのか。 Hyperliquidを通じて、オンチェーン金融の現在地と、金融機関・Web3事業者・一般企業にとっての新たな可能性を、ゲストの藤田氏と参加者の皆さまと一緒に考えます。 藤田拓也氏プロフィール Hyperliquid Japan 技術渉外 / SubEtha Founder 筑波大学社会工学類卒。HashHubでブロックチェーンエンジニアとして経験を積み、MycelやHiveFiなどのWeb3プロジェクトに参画。クロスチェーン、DeFi、AI×ブロックチェーン領域の開発に携わり、ETHGlobal、HackAtom、Colosseumなどのハッカソンで受賞。Cosmos JapanのAdminとしてコミュニティ運営に携わり、現在はHyperliquid JapanのAdmin・技術渉外として活動。自ら立ち上げたAIエージェント向けプライバシー決済プロトコル「SubEtha」では、代表としてプロダクト開発を進めている。 セミナー概要 Hyperliquidとオンチェーンファイナンスの歴史 日時：2026年11月18日（水）19:00 開場／19:30 開始（20:30〜ネットワーキング、21:30 イベント終了予定） 会場：幻冬舎3号館 3F セミナールーム (https://www.

gentosha.co.

jp/company/access/) 〒151-0051 東京都渋谷区千駄ケ谷4-8-1 3F 登壇者：藤田拓也（Hyperliquid Japan 技術渉外 / SubEtha Founder）/ 脇田洋平（Kudasai 取締役）/ 設楽 悠介（幻冬舎 あたらしい経済 編集長） 参加方法 WBH会員の方は「WBH会員向けチケット」よりご登録ください。 一般の方（抽選制）は「一般チケット（抽選）」をご選択のうえ、お申し込みください。 ※一般チケットに当選された方は、Lumaの承認をもって参加確定となります（11/18 17:00までにお申し込みください）。チケットが承認されない方は落選となります。ご了承ください。 --- 個人情報の取り扱い お申し込み時にご提供いただいた情報は、WBH、あたらしい経済、Kudasai関連のご案内等に限って利用させていただきます。法令および社内規定に基づき適切に管理いたします。 --- 「Web3 Business Hub（WBH）」について「あたらしい経済」と「KudasaiJP」が共同運営する、企業向けWeb3コミュニティです。現在以下の会員限定コンテンツを企業様にご提供しております。ぜひご参加ください。 [実施内容] ・イベント開催（毎月1回以上/リアル or オンライン） ・ネットワーキングイベント開催（四半期毎/リアル） ・スポットコンサルティング機会の提供（毎月/指定日に参加いただける方） ・会員限定レポートの配信（毎月1本以上） ・「あたらしい経済」実施企画（記事・ポッドキャスト・YouTube）へ参加の優先案内（都度） ・「KudasaiJP」実施企画への参加の優先案内（都度） ▶ WBHの詳細・入会はこちら https://www.

neweconomy.jp/wbh (https://www.neweconomy.jp/wbh) ▶WBHの過去のイベントやレポート https://www.neweconomy.jp/features/wbh ---- The "Web3 Business Hub (WBH)", a corporate-focused Web3 community jointly operated by Atarashii Keizai and KudasaiJP, hosts monthly seminars designed to provide practical insights for advancing Web3 business initiatives. The theme for October is "Hyperliquid and the History of Onchain Finance" Blockchain-based financial services have evolved significantly since the emergence of Bitcoin and Ethereum, expanding into various areas such as decentralized exchanges (DEXs), lending, stablecoins, and derivatives.

In particular, since DeFi Summer in 2020, the rapid development of smart contract-based financial applications has demonstrated the potential for new financial markets that operate without relying on traditional financial intermediaries or centralized exchanges. One of the projects representing this evolution is Hyperliquid, which has gained significant attention through its focus on on-chain derivatives trading. Built on its own Layer 1 blockchain, Hyperliquid combines high-speed transaction processing with an on-chain order book, offering a trading experience comparable to that of centralized exchanges (CEXs) while exploring new possibilities for decentralized finance.

With the expansion of its ecosystem through HyperEVM, Hyperliquid is also evolving beyond a trading platform into a broader on-chain financial ecosystem. At the same time, the development of on-chain finance continues to face challenges, including liquidity, price discovery, security, decentralization, governance, and regulatory compliance. What has DeFi achieved throughout its history, and what challenges remain unresolved? To what extent can emerging platforms such as Hyperliquid transform traditional financial markets and the role of cryptocurrency exchanges?

For this edition of Web3 Business Hub, we will explore the history of on-chain finance, from the early days of DeFi and DeFi Summer to the evolution of DEXs and on-chain derivatives, culminating in the rise of Hyperliquid. We will also examine Hyperliquid's architecture, the factors behind its growth, how it differs from traditional financial services, and the opportunities and challenges that lie ahead. How much of the financial system can ultimately move on-chain? Through the lens of Hyperliquid, we will explore the current state and future potential of on-chain finance, as well as the new opportunities it may create for financial institutions, Web3 businesses, and enterprises.

Seminar Overview Hyperliquid and the History of Onchain Finance - Date & Time: November 18, 2026 (Wed) Doors open 19:00 Start 19:30 Networking from 20:30 Event ends around 21:30 - Venue: Gentosha Building No.3, 3F Seminar Room 4-8-1 Sendagaya, Shibuya-ku, Tokyo 151-0051 - Speakers:] - Fujita Takuya(HyperliquidJP / SubEtha Founder) - Dr. Pudding (Director, Kudasai) - Yusuke Shitara (Editor-in-Chief, Atarashii Keizai) How to Participate - WBH Members: Please register via the "WBH Member Ticket." - General Applicants (Lottery): Please apply via the "General Ticket (Lottery)." Selected applicants will be confirmed upon approval via Luma (applications close at 17:00 on Nov 18).

Please note that unapproved tickets will be considered unsuccessful. Personal Information Handling The information provided at the time of registration will be used solely for communications related to WBH, Atarashii Keizai, and Kudasai. It will be managed appropriately in accordance with applicable laws and internal policies. About Web3 Business Hub (WBH) WBH is a corporate Web3 community jointly operated by Atarashii Keizai and KudasaiJP.

We provide the following member-exclusive offerings: - Monthly events (online/offline) - Quarterly networking events (offline) - Monthly spot consulting opportunities - Monthly member-only reports - Priority access to Atarashii Keizai initiatives (articles, podcasts, YouTube) - Priority access to KudasaiJP initiatives ▶ Learn more / Join WBH: https://www.neweconomy.jp/wbh ▶ Past events and reports: https://www.neweconomy.

## REWIRED: A Forum on Stablecoins and Agentic Payments

- Record: `luma-crypto-79xnpm1WrGGSqxH`
- Source: [luma-crypto-events.json](sources/luma-crypto-events.json)
- Starts: 2026-11-19T04:30:00.000Z
- Description: Source-backed
- Original page: <https://luma.com/rewired-sff>

### About the event

19 November 2026 - 12:30-17:00 SGT - Lunch provided - Approval within 24 hours Feeling lucky? Several Fitbit Air trackers are up for grabs, plus the new Fitbit Edge, launched just weeks ago. Intro This year's Singapore FinTech Festival looks at the forces rewiring global finance. Payments is where that rewiring is most visible: AI agents are starting to spend real money, more of it settles in stablecoins, and the rails are arriving faster than the controls. REWIRED brings together the people building and running payments to work out what comes next: - Who authorises an agent to pay? - What stops the payment when the agent is compromised?

- Where does the margin sit when software pays software? Speakers Featuring speakers from AWS, Visa, Mastercard, BVNK, BlockSec, FXC Intelligence, Sunrate and Cobo You make the calls - Run the incident. MAS's SAFR framework proposes that no agent action executes until it has been declared, authorised and assessed. Test that idea on a live case: an agent with payment authority has been manipulated and transfers are queued. Vote on what stops the money, then put the panel on the spot. - Pick the rails. Card networks are piloting agent checkout across APAC, and Visa already settles in stablecoins at a US$7 billion annualised run rate.

Cards, stablecoins or both: argue who owns checkout when the buyer is software. - Settle the bank question. Everyone agrees you need a bank to cash out. Beyond that, decide whether banks still own anything when agents pay: programmable money, accountability for the agent, or 24/7 settlement. Ask in English or Chinese on Slido at any time. Who should attend Anyone building, running or investing in payments, stablecoins or AI-driven commerce. Agenda (SGT) - 12:30 - Check-in, lunch and networking - 13:30 - Opening remarks, Cobo - 13:35 - Keynote: Agents Can Hold Wallets. Who Holds the Keys?

- 13:55 - Keynote: From Operator to Supervisor: How AI Agents and Stablecoins Are Rewiring the B2B Treasury - 14:15 - Keynote: Secure Agents, Smart Payment - 14:35 - Panel 1, Live Wire: An Agent Goes Rogue Mid-Payment. Who Pulls the Plug? - 15:05 - Panel 2, Crossed Wires: Cards or Stablecoins? Which Rails Will Agents Pay On? - 15:35 - Panel 3, Utility: Are Banks Becoming Just the Off-Ramp? - 16:05 - Networking - 16:45 - Lucky draw (must be present to win) - 17:00 - Close More speakers to be announced. Programme subject to change.

Venue - Where: AWS Office Event Space, Level 5, IOI Central Boulevard Towers, 2 Central Blvd, Singapore 018916 - Entry: Show your Luma ticket and photo ID at building security, then go directly to Level 5 Registration Space is limited and subject to host approval. Requests are usually approved within 24 hours. Request to join, and bring a question worth debating. About Cobo Founded in 2017 and headquartered in Singapore, Cobo builds trusted infrastructure for wallets and payments, serving humans and AI agents. Cobo has completed a SOC 2 Type II audit by a Big Four firm, is ISO 27001 certified, and has secured billions in client assets with zero security incidents since 2017.

Learn more at www.cobo.com (https://www.cobo.com). About Sunrate Sunrate is a leading global payment and treasury management platform for businesses worldwide. Founded in 2016, Sunrate has enabled companies to operate and scale both locally and globally in 190+ countries and regions with its cutting-edge infrastructure, global network, and unified solutions. About AWS Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the cloud platform of Amazon, providing the infrastructure, data and AI services on which banks, asset managers and hedge funds build and run their research, trading and risk workloads. Financial institutions use AWS to train and deploy AI models securely and at scale.

Tokenize North is designed to bring that overlap together.

Tokenize North is being curated for founders, executives, institutional leaders and senior decision-makers across: - Financial institutions + fintech - Asset managers, investors + family offices - Digital-asset + tokenization infrastructure - Payments, stablecoins + custody - Legal, accounting, regulatory + advisory - Select founders, operators + ecosystem leaders A Different Kind of Event Networking first. Content second. Quality over volume. No sprawling expo floor. No day-long agenda. No pressure to fill the room with arbitrary attendance. ### About the event

As quantum computing accelerates toward cryptographically relevant milestones, the digital asset ecosystem faces an architectural reckoning. Public blockchains like Ethereum are charting multi-year post-quantum cryptography (PQC) roadmaps and custody providers are testing PQC in practice, but protecting distributed ledgers, critical infrastructure and cross-border digital economies requires coordinated action across industry, regulators and government agencies. This afternoon brings them into one room.

We open with Project Eagle, a live PQC pilot co-led by Safeheron and the Responsible Fintech Institute, in which banks and regulators across multiple jurisdictions test quantum-resistant multi-party computation (MPC) signing on a public testnet. A panel of leaders from law, law enforcement technology, smart-city jurisdictions and quantum security then examines signature scheme migration, systemic risks to custody and key management, and the public-private standards needed before Q-Day. We close with Ethereum's post-quantum roadmap and what it means for institutions, followed by networking.

EVENT AGENDA 12:30 PM - 1:00 PM | Registration & Networking 1:00 PM - 1:10 PM | Welcome & Introduction - Chia Hock Lai - Responsible Fintech Institute (RFI) 1:10 PM - 1:30 PM | Keynote 1: Project Eagle - Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) Pilot with Banks and Regulators - Jag Foo - Chief Security & Policy Officer, Safeheron 1:30 PM - 2:15 PM | Panel Discussion: From Protocol to Protection - Hardening Digital Assets Against Quantum Threats - Josh Klayman - Firm-Wide Co-Lead of Digital Assets, Blockchain & Custody, Ashurst Perkins Coie - Joel Teo - Deputy Director, Digital & Information Forensics, Home Team Science and Technology Agency (HTX) - Carol Zhang - Chief Investment Officer, Alatau City Authority - Dr.

## Designing Trust in the Digital Economy

- Record: `luma-crypto-CNZg5fqDLOWqAgl`
- Source: [luma-crypto-events.json](sources/luma-crypto-events.json)
- Starts: 2026-11-20T10:00:00.000Z
- Description: Source-backed
- Original page: <https://luma.com/xk2rbumg>

### About the event

## Introduction As AI reshapes how we build, create, and transact, trust has become the currency that matters most. Join us for an event on using AI to build trust across the new money era, content, and AI itself with keynotes, a hands-on AI skills challenge, and networking to wrap up the evening. ## What to expect Keynote talks from industry voices Live Q&A with speakers Community networking ## Speakers Peter Zheng is Head of Design at OKX, where his team designs the products more than 120 million customers use to trade, pay and save.

Over 20 years, his career has taken him from East to West, through agencies including W+K, TBWA\Media Arts Lab and Ogilvy, and in-house at Google, Samsung and Meta. Working across cultures has taught him that good ideas start with listening. As AI changes how products get made, he is helping his team move from designing screens to designing systems, with people at the center. Topic Intro: More of our financial lives now happen on a phone, at any hour, and soon with AI doing some of the work for us. None of that matters if people don't feel safe enough to use it. Crypto gave us new ways to prove things.

Anyone can check a transaction on a blockchain, and exchanges publish reports showing they hold customers' funds. Yet people still hesitate before they hit "confirm." Proof and protection are different things, and design has to close the distance between them. In this session, Peter shares how OKX designs for trust, from showing people how they're protected to helping them understand what they're agreeing to before it's final. He'll also look at what changes when we start handing some of those decisions to an AI agent. Pearly Tan is Content Systems Director at OKX, where she is leading the shift from content design as a service to content as a scalable system for global digital products.

She previously led Global Content Design at OKX and led the build of award-winning experiences across Meta Reality Labs, TikTok Shop and Bank of Singapore. Topic intro: As digital products expand, users face more opportunities, choices and information. They also face more uncertainty, emotion and risk. Trust must be built throughout the experience, especially when people are deciding whether to explore, act, or ask for help. Doing this at scale requires a shift from relying on specialists for every decision to building systems that make trustworthy choices easier across the organisation.

This session explores how content systems can: - Give users the information they need, when they need it - Build trust with transparency that is relevant and proportionate - Direct expertise to moments where uncertainty carries real consequences - Help every team make sound, responsible decisions at scale Pearly will discuss OKX's content transformation and how AI-enabled systems can help more people become responsible trust builders. Ben Bowes is the Director of Product Design at Open Government Products (OGP), where he helps teams make government products effective, enjoyable and worthy of people's trust.

He thinks public service is where the best designers belong, making everyday life better for the people around them. As AI reshapes how we build and create, Ben believes people must remain at the heart of what we design and why. Topic intro: When AI can make almost anything look and sound convincing, how do we know what's real and who to trust? From everyday encounters to government services, design shapes how trust is built, tested and sometimes exploited. With so much uncertainty, how can public institutions earn our trust? Maybe a little doubt is part of what makes trust possible.

## Who should attend - Designers who are curious about how AI is reshaping trust in technology ## Event info - Registration: RSVP required (limited capacity) - Location: 12 Marina Boulevard, Marina Bay Financial Centre #13, Singapore 018982. - On arrival: Please make your way to the concierge to sign in as a guest and obtain a Ticket to enter the office premises on Level 13. - Nearest MRT: Downtown MRT, about a 5-minute walk.
