很多真正重要的东西，刚开始的时候，可能连怎么跟人讲清楚都还在摸索，没有漂亮的 Deck，没有宏大的叙事，甚至在正式场合里都没有一个位置。 但它确实已经有了真实的需求、真实的用户。 所以我们搭了一个【草台】：讲一个真实判断、一个正在做的东西、一个踩过的坑、一个你觉得别人还没意识到的机会。不用讲完，不用讲对。 讲真就行！ 本期【草台开放麦】围绕 Agentic Economy，邀请正在探索 Agentic 商业实践、Stable Payment、Onchain Finance 乃至做 GEO 和 Growth 的小伙伴都聚到一起。 上麦分享，台下畅聊。 你也可以来听听别人为什么这样做，交换一个视角，认识几个不同方向的同行。正在构建的东西可以在这里得到新的反馈。 下一次合作，甚至一个还没开始的项目，也可能从这里的一段聊天开始。 欢迎自荐上麦，也欢迎推荐你觉得应该被听见的人。 选择你的参与方式： > Speaker Ticket： 分享你的业务、产品、想法，以及背后的经历、选择和吐槽。 > Audience Ticket： 来听故事、聊业务、交换想法、认识同行。台下的交流，同样是这场聚会的重要部分。 带上你的 Backstory，也来认识下一段故事里的同行的小伙伴。 【草台开放麦】由 MoneyinMotion (https://x.com/moneyinmotion26) × ACTUALLY YOU KNOW (https://x.com/ActuallyUKnow) 联合主办，感谢 WIDTH (https://x.com/WidthGRC)与 DogPay (https://x.com/DogPay_) 对新加坡专场的鼎力支持。 Where Builders Take The Mic.

Some of the things that matter most are hard to explain at first. No polished deck. No grand narrative. And no place for them on the usual stages. But the demand is real. And so are the users. So we're setting up a stage of our own: 草台 (Caotai). Share an honest take, something you're building, a lesson learned the hard way, or an opportunity you think others haven't spotted yet. You don't have to tell the whole story. You don't have to have it all figured out. Just keep it real. This edition of 草台 Open Mic explores the Agentic Economy, bringing together people working on agentic business applications, Stable Payment, Onchain Finance, and GEO and Growth.

Come share the business or product you're working on, along with a story behind it: a key decision, an unexpected discovery, some trial and error, or something you still want to vent about. Share onstage. Chat offstage. You're also welcome to come and listen, hear why others made the choices they did, swap perspectives, and meet people working in different fields.You (https://fields.You) can get fresh feedback on what you're building. Your next collaboration - or a project you haven't started yet - could begin with a conversation here. Put yourself forward to speak, or recommend someone you think deserves to be heard.

Choose how you'd like to join > Speaker Ticket: Tell us about your business, product, or ideas, and the experiences, choices, and frustrations behind them. > Audience Ticket: Come to hear stories, talk business, exchange ideas, and meet peers. Conversations offstage are just as much a part of the gathering. Bring your Backstory. Meet the people who could be part of what comes next. Hosted by MoneyinMotion (https://x.com/moneyinmotion26) × ACTUALLY YOU KNOW (https://x.com/ActuallyUKnow), with generous support from WIDTH (https://x.com/WidthGRC)and DogPay (https://x.com/DogPay_).

### About the event

Wie is Satoshi Nakamoto? Het is een van de grootste onopgeloste raadsels van onze tijd, en op zaterdag 21 november duiken we er samen in. De Dutch Bitcoin Embassy nodigt je uit voor een besloten vertoning van Finding Satoshi in Flora Filmtheater in Den Haag, met popcorn bij de film en een borrel na afloop. ## Over de film Finding Satoshi (2026) volgt onderzoeksjournalist William D. Cohan en privédetective Tyler Maroney tijdens een forensisch onderzoek van vier jaar naar de herkomst van Bitcoin. Onderweg spreken ze mensen uit het hart van de sector, onder wie Michael Saylor en Joseph Lubin. De film gaat net zo goed over de ideeën achter Bitcoin als over de vraag wie het heeft bedacht.

Regie: Matthew Miele en Tucker Tooley - 101 minuten - Engels gesproken ## Wat is inbegrepen Toegang tot de besloten vertoning in de filmzaal van Flora Popcorn bij de film Borrel na afloop met twee drankjes Een middag met Bitcoiners, ondernemers en nieuwsgierigen Popcorn en drankjes worden je aangeboden door onze sponsor Blockrise. ## Programma 13.30 uur: inloop 14.00 uur: welkom en start film Rond 15.45 uur: einde film Aansluitend: borrel bij Flora, tot ongeveer 17.30 uur ## Voor wie Voor iedereen: of je al jaren in Bitcoin zit, net begint of gewoon nieuwsgierig bent. Na de aftiteling praten we verder tijdens de borrel. Neem gerust iemand mee.

## Praktisch Flora Filmtheater, De Constant Rebecquestraat 55, Den Haag (Regentessekwartier). Openbaar vervoer: RandstadRail 3 en tram 11 op vijf minuten lopen, RandstadRail 4 op tien minuten. Parkeren kan in de wijk en je fiets zet je voor de deur. De film start stipt om 14.00 uur, dus kom op tijd. ## Tickets Early Bird €35 - Regulier €42 Inclusief film, popcorn en twee drankjes. ## Trust Infrastructure for the Tokenization Era : Travel Rule and AML

- Record: `luma-crypto-2Bki5QkhXLyiKsg`
- Source: [luma-crypto-events.json](sources/luma-crypto-events.json)
- Starts: 2026-11-24T05:00:00.000Z
- Description: Source-backed
- Original page: <https://luma.com/9szg4i77>

### About the event

As digital assets transition from pilot experiments (STOs and RWAs) into institutional finance, KYC and AML compliance are no longer merely back-office burdens - they are the core trust infrastructure and prerequisites for new business. Ahead of South Korea's full implementation of the Travel Rule (effective February 2027) - which lowers exemption thresholds and tightens rules on unhosted wallets and cross-border transfers - this seminar brings together regulators, law enforcement, financial institutions, and global tech leaders to bridge statutory requirements with operational industry practice. Event Highlights - Legislative Challenges & Risk Control - Legal issues in the full implementation of the Travel Rule and risk-based control practices for strengthening financial governance - Global Infrastructure & Tech Demonstration - Sumsub's compliance model supporting 2,000+ global clients and a remittance PoC case study integrating foreign national KYC - Public-Private Joint Panel Discussion - Strategies for operationalizing regulatory requirements into industry practice, featuring regulatory authorities, law enforcement, Korean financial institutions, and global experts

## CyberSwaraj: Nostr, Cryptography Basics & How It Actually Works

- Record: `luma-crypto-wfBZ2uBmgRlbIab`
- Source: [luma-crypto-events.json](sources/luma-crypto-events.json)
- Starts: 2026-11-29T06:30:00.000Z
- Description: Source-backed
- Original page: <https://luma.com/42jg53zj>

### About the event

A beginner-to-intermediate friendly workshop for anyone curious about real digital privacy. Tired of platforms that own your data, shadow-ban your voice, or can disappear overnight? This hands-on session pulls back the curtain on Nostr - a simple, open protocol for decentralized social networking - and the cryptography that makes it possible. No prior technical background required; just curiosity. ## What You'll Learn Part 1 - Cryptography Basics (Demystified) - Why privacy isn't "having something to hide" - it's about control - Public vs.

private keys: the foundation of digital identity - Hashing, signatures, and encryption - what they do and when to use each - How you already use this technology everyday without realizing it - Common myths about anonymity and what actually protects you Part 2 - What Is Nostr? - The problem Nostr solves: platform lock-in, censorship, and identity fragility - How Nostr works: events, relays, keys, and clients - Your keys = your identity.

Your data = portable across apps - Practical setup: create your first identity and post your first note Part 3 - Nostr Technicals (Made Approachable) - Event structure and kinds - the grammar of the protocol - Relays: what they are, how to choose them, and why many is better than one - NIPs (Nostr Implementation Possibilities) - the standards that keep the network compatible - Zap (Lightning payments) basics and why they matter for creators - Security habits: key storage, signing devices, and avoiding common pitfalls ## Who This Is For - Beginners curious about privacy and decentralized tech - Builders, writers, and creators wanting platform independence - Intermediates who've "heard of Nostr" but never really understood it - Anyone who's lost an account, been shadow-banned, or worries about data ownership ## What You'll Walk Away With - A working Nostr identity and your first published note - A clear mental model of cryptography fundamentals - The confidence to evaluate privacy tools critically - Resources and a community to continue learning ## Format Interactive mini-lecture + live demos + guided setup time + Q&A. Bring a laptop or phone.

No coding required to participate; code examples available for the curious. Privacy isn't a feature you buy - it's a skill you build. Come learn it with us. ## Privacy is not about hiding. Most conversations about privacy start by making you feel paranoid. This one won't. Privacy is something ordinary and human. It's the ability to decide what parts of your life get shared, when they get shared, and with whom. In the physical world this feels obvious. You close the door when you change clothes. You lower your voice in a crowded room. You don't hand your diary to a stranger. Online, we've slowly given up all of that, usually without realising we were giving anything up.

Each app asks for a small permission. Each service collects a small piece of information. Individually, none of it feels like much. Put together, it forms a surprisingly complete picture of how you live, think, move, and talk to people you love. ## What is the 'CyberSwaraj' event series about CyberSwaraj is a gathering for anyone interested in digital privacy, open-source tools, and taking back some control over their digital life. We run sessions for beginners, workshops for people ready to go deeper, and occasional deep-dives for the technically curious. Developers, privacy advocates, and people who've simply had enough of being tracked are all welcome.

## Stay Connected - Join us on YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@CyberSwaraj ## Venue Partner Bitshala Bitspace (https://x.com/bitshala?utm_source=luma), HSR Layout Sector 6, Bengaluru. - Join Our Community: http://discord.gg/atjEPVTdsQ - Subscribe to our Calendar: https://lu.ma/bitspace - Contact: 9118592188 (https://wa.me/919118592188?

### About the event

The Big Whale (https://www.thebigwhale.io/) is the leading Market Intelligence provider on Digital Assets, serving 150+ banks, asset managers, fintechs and digital asset companies. Join TBW (https://www.thebigwhale.io/), Morgan Stanley (https://www.morganstanley.com/), and other leading players for an exclusive Corporate After Bell event in New York City. Tokenized stocks, funds and bonds are now live, and issuance is no longer the bottleneck. The harder question is what happens after: where these assets trade, who provides liquidity, and how they move through custody, settlement and reporting. Most issuers earn their revenue at issuance and have little reason to build the secondary market.

That leaves the job to venues, broker-dealers and banks. Some will plug tokenized assets into the desks and systems they already run. Others will build new ones. ## L’écosystème fintech montréalais à l’heure de la tokenisation

- Record: `luma-crypto-EQlii8wBJKCDZbJ`
- Source: [luma-crypto-events.json](sources/luma-crypto-events.json)

### About the event

La tokenisation n'est plus une promesse technologique. Les cadres réglementaires convergent aux États-Unis, en Europe, à Hong Kong et au Canada. Les institutions financières s'organisent en consortiums, et les stablecoins s'imposent progressivement comme de véritables rails de paiement. Montréal possède de solides atouts pour prendre part à cette transformation : un écosystème fintech mature, des talents spécialisés en finance et en technologies numériques, ainsi qu'une expertise reconnue en intelligence artificielle.

La métropole bénéficie également d'un savoir-faire concret dans les domaines de la chaîne de blocs, du Web3 et de la DeFi, avec des entreprises et des équipes capables de mener des projets d'envergure au Québec comme à l'international.

Lors de cet événement de la communauté CFI, Finance Montréal et T-RIZE présenteront les grandes tendances qui façonnent l'avenir de la finance numérique et discuteront du rôle que le Québec peut jouer dans le développement de l'économie tokenisée. À partir des faits saillants du Rapport Fintech Québec 2026 et d'une analyse des avancées récentes en matière de tokenisation, nous verrons pourquoi Montréal offre un environnement particulièrement favorable aux initiatives liées aux actifs numériques et aux infrastructures financières de nouvelle génération. Programme 1. Accueil et dîner 2. Présentation du Rapport Fintech Québec 2026 et portrait de l'écosystème fintech montréalais 3.

L'écosystème montréalais de la tokenisation 4. Période de questions et échanges entre pairs Présentateurs - Bruno Séguin, directeur principal, Comptes stratégiques, Finance Montréal - Jean-Luc Pellerin, directeur, Écosystème et partenariats stratégiques, T-RIZE Ce que vous allez retirer de cet événement - Un portrait à jour de l'écosystème fintech montréalais, tiré du Rapport Fintech Québec 2026; - Un tour d'horizon des acteurs qui bâtissent l'infrastructure de tokenisation à Montréal. Un dîner sera servi sur place. L'événement est gratuit, mais les places sont limitées.

English below ## ビットコインをきっかけに集まる、持ち込みスタイルのカジュアルな交流会 【イベント概要】 日時： 12月4日（金）18:30〜20:30 場所： Tokyo Bitcoin Base 2階 参加費： 無料 予約定員数：30名 ※途中入退場自由です ## イベントの楽しみ方 First Fridayはビットコインを軸に集まった参加者たちが、自由気ままに交流するイベントです。気楽にご参加ください。 - トーク内容は自由！ - 難しい講義やステージでの発表は一切ありません。初心者の方も、ベテランの方も、輪になって会話を楽しむだけ。ビットコインの最新ニュースから、そもそもビットコインって何？という素朴な疑問まで、どんな話題も大歓迎です。 - お気に入りの一杯を持って集合！ - このイベントは持ち込みスタイルです。自分の好きなドリンクやおつまみを片手に、リラックスしてご参加ください。 TBBから徒歩1分圏内にあるコモレ四谷にあるコンビニやスーパーで買ってきていただくのがおすすめです - 初めての方、大歓迎！ - 「ビットコインとか詳しいことはわからないけど、ちょっと興味がある」「周りに話せる人がいない...

」そんな方こそ、ぜひ足を運んでみてください。 - 画面の中の数字や情報では得られない、ビットコインを取り巻くリアルな空気感に触れることができます。四谷から広がるビットコインコミュニティの温かさを、ぜひ肌で感じてみてください。 ## A casual, BYOB meetup where people come together over Bitcoin 【Event Details】Date & Time: Friday, December 4th, 18:30 - 20:30Location: Tokyo Bitcoin Base, 2nd FloorEntry: FreeCapacity: 30 people Note: Feel free to come and go as you please! What to Expect First Friday is a laid-back event where people gather around a shared interest in Bitcoin to mingle freely. Just drop by and enjoy the relaxed atmosphere! Open Discussions! There are no complicated lectures or stage presentations.

Whether you're a total beginner or a Bitcoin veteran, it's all about chatting and enjoying each other's company. From the latest Bitcoin news to basic questions like "What exactly is Bitcoin anyway?", all topics are completely welcome! BYOB & Snacks! This is a "bring your own" style event. Grab your favorite drinks and snacks, and come relax with us. Pro tip: We highly recommend grabbing what you need at the convenience store or supermarket inside COMORE Yotsuya, just a 1-minute walk from TBB. First-timers are warmly welcomed! If you're thinking, "I don't know much about the technical stuff, but I'm curious," or "I don't have anyone to talk to about Bitcoin," this event is exactly for you!

This is a great chance to experience the real-world culture of Bitcoin that you just can't get from staring at charts and screens. Come down and feel the warmth of the growing Bitcoin community right here in Yotsuya.

## CORGEAR Night vol.

33 ～仮想NISHIと振り返る2026年のWeb3 - コーギアナイト忘年会～ 昨年の年末回で大好評だった「仮想NISHIと振り返るWeb3」を、今年も開催します！ 今回も暗号資産アナリストの仮想NISHI氏をお迎えし、2026年のWeb3・暗号資産市場を振り返ります。 暗号資産の制度整備や税制見直しに向けた動きが進み、ステーブルコインやRWAなど、既存金融との接点が広がった2026年。一方で、ビットコインをはじめとする暗号資産市場は大きく揺れ動き、期待と現実が交錯する一年となりました。 昨年に引き続き、チャートをもとに2026年の相場を振り返りながら、制度、技術、資金の流れ、そしてコミュニティの変化を読み解きます。 大幅な下落から夏場の反発まで、相場が大きく揺れた2026年。その一方で、ETFを通じた資金の流れや金融政策が市場を左右し、予測市場や資産のトークン化など、新たな動きも広がりました。相場の裏側では何が起きていたのか。仮想NISHI氏のチャート解説とともに一年を振り返り、2027年の暗号資産市場を展望します。 2026年を締めくくるこの夜は、年末恒例のコーギアナイト忘年会でもあります。 今年も少し早い乾杯とともに、クリプトの一年を振り返りましょう！ ## 開催概要 日時：2026年12月7日（月） 開催場所：浜松町 開催時間：18:30 受付開始 19:00前後 イベント開始予定 ※受付開始後、イベント開始までは交流時間となります 参加費：無料 定員：50名 申込方法：Lumaページより参加申込 補足： 応募人数が定員を超えた場合は、ウェイトリストを開放します。 CORGEAR Nightは、交流会がメインのイベントとなっています。 参加登録いただいた方には、後日メールマガジンを送信する可能性があります。 本イベントで運営や他の参加者に迷惑となる行為があった場合、参加をお断りすることがあります。 Event Information Date: Monday, December 7, 2026 Venue: Hamamatsucho (details will be shared with registered participants) Schedule: - 18:30 Doors open / Registration - Around 19:00 Event starts (Prior to the start, the time will be reserved for casual communication and networking.)

Fee: Free Capacity: 50 participants How to register: Please sign up via this Luma event page. Additional Information: - If the number of registrations exceeds the venue capacity, a waitlist will be opened. - CORGEAR Night is primarily a networking event. - Registered participants may receive email newsletters from us after the event. - Participants who engage in behavior that disrupts the event or causes inconvenience to the organizers or other attendees may be denied entry or asked to leave.

CORGEAR Night CORGEAR Nightは、Web3業界で注目を集めるゲストをお迎えしつつ、参加者どうしが気軽に語り合う交流会です。ここでの議論や出会いが、次の取り組みのきっかけになるような場を目指しています。 コーギア株式会社 コーギア株式会社は、テクノロジーとエンタメで社会課題を解く、ソニーグループ発のスタートアップです。人が関わりたくなる設計が、技術を社会に根づかせる。これを原点に、自社プロダクトを開発しながら、企業の事業開発を支援しています。新規事業開発、地域創生、海外事業者の日本展開など、領域を問わず、構想から実装までを見通した事業づくりを、パートナーとともに進めます。 コーギア（株）：https://www.corgear.co.

### About the event

Join us on Thursday, December 10 from 6pm onwards for a relaxed evening of drinks and conversation with the Hong Kong Crypto Compliance & Legal Community.

This informal meetup is all about bringing together compliance, legal, policy, financial crime and regulatory professionals working across the digital asset ecosystem. It's a chance to connect with peers, exchange ideas, share experiences and build meaningful relationships; and this time you want to add some pre Halloween vibes lol

There's no agenda, no panels - just good conversations and a welcoming crowd.

Expect:

- A friendly and relaxed atmosphere
- Conversations on crypto compliance, legal and regulatory developments
- Opportunities to connect with professionals from across the digital asset ecosystem
- A chance to unwind after work over a glass of wine or a beer

Whether you're working at a crypto company, bank, law firm, regulator or advisory firm, we'd love to have you join us.

Drinks are pay-as-you-go. Come by, bring a colleague, and let's continue growing the Hong Kong Crypto Compliance & Legal Community together.

### About the Crypto Compliance & Legal Community

The Crypto Compliance & Legal Community brings together compliance, legal, policy and regulatory professionals from across the digital asset industry.

Our ambition is simple: bring together the right people in the room to have honest conversations, share experiences and build meaningful relationships. ## CWC x Sosoul: A Breathwork Evening

- Record: `luma-crypto-PNXMX9kWym4sARo`
- Source: [luma-crypto-events.json](sources/luma-crypto-events.json)
- Starts: 2026-12-10T18:30:00.000Z

- Original page: <https://luma.com/tcj68hdu>

### About the event

CWC x Sosoul: A Breathwork Evening Two hours, no agenda, just space to breathe, slow down, and reset with the Crypto Women Collective community. About this event: When the week fills up, the first thing we drop is never the deadline. It's the twenty minutes we promised ourselves, the ones that don't belong to a client, a to-do list, or anyone but us. We thought this would be something for our members: a breathwork session hosted at the beautiful Sosoul Amsterdam (https://www.instagram.com/sosoul.nl/). No crypto talk, no networking pressure, just space to reset and be with other women from the community without an agenda attached. Never done breathwork before?

It's a guided practice using conscious breathing patterns to shift your nervous system out of fight-or-flight and into actual rest. No experience needed, you just show up and breathe. What to expect: Walk in between 19:30 and 20:00, doors close right at 20:00 when the breathwork starts. From there, our guide takes the group through a full breathwork practice designed to release tension you didn't even know you were holding, the kind that sitting still never quite reaches. Come as you are; loose, comfortable clothing helps. Mats and props are provided.

Afterward, there's a few quiet minutes to notice how you feel, and time to talk with the person next to you or whoever's in the room, before we close out around 22:00. Your guide: Marieke Lintz (https://www.instagram.com/marieke.breathes/) is a breathwork coach and a CWC member herself. She'll lead the group through the practice and hold space for whatever comes up in the room. Details Thursday 10 December 19:30 doors - 20:00 breathwork starts - 22:00 end Sosoul, Anjeliersstraat 46-H, Amsterdam (https://www.instagram.com/sosoul.nl/) €27,50 for CWC members (usually €55) Max 12 spots Not yet part of the Crypto Women Collective?

Crypto Women Collective is a growing community of 300+, from complete beginners to people already building careers in the space. This is a community of peers and women who want to know more, learn together and network, all around the topic of crypto and beyond. Become a member (https://tally.so/r/yPYd46) today. FAQ: Do I need any experience with breathwork? No. This session works whether you've never tried it or you do it every week. What should I bring or wear? Comfortable, loose-fitting clothing. Mats and props are provided at the venue. Can I arrive a little later than 19:30?

Please don't leave it too late, doors close at 20:00 sharp when the breathwork begins, and once the practice starts we can't let latecomers in without disrupting the group. Good to know Photo & Video: We may take photos and video at this event for our website and social media. Prefer not to be photographed? Just let our team know on arrival. More on how we handle your data in our Privacy & Cookie Policy (https://cryptowomencollective.com/privacy-cookie-policy?utm_source=luma). Refunds: Plans change, we get it. You can cancel for a full refund until 2 December (7 days before the event). After that, we can't refund your ticket.

We book and pay for the venue in advance, and with only 12 spots, every seat counts. Can't make it after all? You're welcome to pass your spot on to a friend, just let us know who's coming in your place. If we ever need to cancel, you'll get a full refund. As tickets are for a specific date, the 14-day withdrawal right doesn't apply. Staying in touch: With your ticket, you'll also receive occasional updates about upcoming CWC events. Not for you? Just unsubscribe in any email. By getting a ticket, you agree to our Terms & Conditions. Questions? Reach out at contact@cryptowomencollective.com, we're happy to help.

### About the event

Join the Bitcoin District Book Club! We meet every month to explore new rabbit holes by reading books that are popular with bitcoiners.

This December, we're reading Resistance Money: A Philosophical Case for Bitcoin by Andrew Bailey, Bradley Rettler, and Craig Warmke. We'll be joined by one of the authors, Andrew Bailey, for a live discussion.

The authors argue that bitcoin is "resistance money," a form of money that resists censorship, confiscation, and inflation. They make the case from philosophy, drawing on ideas about money, freedom, and justice.

Bring your questions for Andrew, whether you're a skeptic, a maximalist, or somewhere in between.

Get the book here: https://www.resistance.money/

Event Notes:

Discussion Starters: We'll open with a few key questions on the book's central arguments, then turn to Q&A with Andrew.

Future Reads: Have a book recommendation? Let us know and we'll add it to the list on our website.

Afterwards: Stick around to hang out, continue the conversation, and grab some food.

Location: PubKey DC

## Workshop: Navigating Cyber Threats Across the Onchain Ecosystem

- Record: `luma-crypto-6pCYONZWHKPcQyZ`
- Source: [luma-crypto-events.json](sources/luma-crypto-events.json)

### About the event

Welcome to The Studio Workshop Series: sessions designed for founders who are building right now. Each workshop takes one skill that directly affects how you fundraise, grow, or ship, and breaks it down into concrete steps you can apply to your own startup. Schedule: 5:00 PM: Doors open 5:30 PM: Workshop 6:30 PM: Networking ## About the workshop Every team building onchain is a target. Attackers move fast, from wallet drainers and fake tokens to exploits that trick users into signing something different from what they saw. The better you understand how these attacks work, the better you can design against them. Join Meg Yodfat and Noah Newfield from Blockaid (https://www.blockaid.

io/) to break down the threats hitting builders today and how to stop them. We'll walk through real attack patterns, map them to a security lifecycle for building dApps, from threat modeling and audits to deployment, and show how teams use real-time monitoring and transaction validation to protect protocols and users once they're live. Bring your questions and a product or flow you'd like pressure-tested. We'll use teams in the room as live case studies, and you'll leave with a practical security checklist for your own build. ## About the speakers ## Meg Yodfat (https://il.linkedin.

com/in/megal-yodfat) Meg is Director of Customer Success at Blockaid, where she partners with every customer, from leading wallets and exchanges to chains and onchain protocols, to shape their security strategy and defend against threats ranging from wallet drainers and phishing to protocol exploits. She brings over a decade of experience in business development, partnerships, and revenue leadership. Before Blockaid, she was Head of Revenue at Infront Lab, led business development and partnerships at the blockchain startup Leeway, co-founded the startup Bobe. ## Noah Newfield (https://www.linkedin.com/in/noah-newfield-208a40129) Noah's been in crypto for 9+ years.

He's worked on GTM at companies like Uniswap, Share, and Conduit. Prior to Blockaid he built a Stablecoin consumer company in YCombinator. He's now on the Customer Success team at Blockaid where he helps clients solve their most pressing security and business problem ## About Blockaid Blockaid (https://www.blockaid.io/) is the security layer behind the world's leading crypto platforms, protecting users, assets, and business operations from fraud, exploits, and malicious activity at scale. ## About The Studio The Studio (https://thestudio.monad.xyz/?utm_source=luma)is Monad Foundation's founder workspace in the heart of Manhattan, where early-stage teams building on Monad work side by side.

It is 100% equity-free: zero equity, zero fees. Teams get dedicated desks, hands-on support on pitch, GTM, and fundraising, and direct access to the VCs, angels, and mentors who work from the space alongside them. Interested in building on Monad and want in? Learn more and apply at https://thestudio.monad.xyz/ ## About Monad Foundation The Monad Foundation (https://www.monad.foundation/?utm_source=luma)is an independent organization dedicated to encouraging the development and adoption of the Monad blockchain protocol, an ultra-high-performant EVM L1 blockchain.

Monad offers the best of both worlds: unrivaled performance (10,000 transactions per second) and portability (full-compatibility for Ethereum smart contracts). ## Disclaimer By attending an event organized by Monad Foundation, you are entering an area where photography, audio and video live-streaming and/or recording may occur. Your entry and presence at such an event constitutes your consent to be photographed, filmed (including live-streamed), and/or otherwise recorded and to the release, publication, exhibition, or reproduction of any and all recorded media of your appearance, voice, and name for any purpose whatsoever in connection with Monad Foundation and its initiatives.

By attending the event, you waive and release any claims you may have related to the use of such media of you at the event.

### About the event

🇦🇪 The Wealth Tech Executive Forum (https://wealthtech-executiveforum.com/?utm_source=luma): Dubai Edition is an exclusive, invite-only event tailored for senior executives who are driving the future of digital assets, institutional infrastructure, and capital allocation. ## ACTIONABLE INSIGHTS & LATEST TRENDS & HIGH-CLASS NETWORK As global financial markets undergo significant transformation, institutions are actively redefining their strategies concerning digital asset products, tokenization, custody solutions, market infrastructure, and institutional access.

🇦🇪 The UAE, a major financial center and one of the global leaders in digital asset innovation, offers the ideal environment for this critical dialogue. The event series is brought to you by CV VC (https://www.cvvc.com/?utm_source=luma), with SCRYPT (https://www.scrypt.swiss/?utm_source=luma) as the main partner, and in partnership with DMCC (https://dmcc.ae/ecosystems/wealth-hub). ## Who is attending?

This edition is designed to convene a select cohort of senior decision-makers, including executives from: - Banks and Private Banking - Asset Managers and Institutional Allocators - Family Office Principals (focused on digital assets) - Custody and Digital Asset Banking - Tokenization and Digital Securities Platforms - Institutional Trading and Market Infrastructure Providers - Hedge Fund Portfolio Managers ## Core Themes for Discussion The focused content will explore the following key areas: - Allocator perspectives on digital asset exposure - Market structure, trading access, and execution - The pivotal role of wealth and private banking in the digital asset economy - Institutional digital asset infrastructure - Tokenization and digital securities - Custody and banking for digital assets ## Event Format: Efficient and Focused The event format is intentionally compact and highly time-efficient.

It is structured to combine focused keynote perspectives, panel discussions, audience Q&A, and exclusive, curated networking. This design allows participants to gain relevant insights and forge meaningful connections in a high-caliber setting without requiring a full day away from the office. ## Attendance Note Attendance is strictly limited and subject to approval to ensure a high-quality, peer-level exchange. Chatham rules apply. ## Other Editions in the Series: - Zurich (Concluded) (https://wealthtech-executiveforum.com/insights/zurich-edition) - Geneva (https://luma.com/4ppsu496) - Frankfurt (https://luma.

com/icv7e9eu) - London (To be Confirmed) - Monaco (To Be Confirmed) Find out more on our website: https://wealthtech-executiveforum.com/ ## What Comes Next? The Next Disruption in Asset Management? Asset management has evolved in distinct waves, each driven by structural innovation and enabled by technology: 1770s: Closed-End Funds 1920s: Open-End Mutual Funds 1970s: Index Funds 1990s: ETFs 2020s: A new paradigm emerging: Vaults? Technological innovations in digital trading and programmatic trading gave rise to ETFs in the 1990s, which now account for around $20 trillion in AUM. Technology continues to evolve, and with it comes the next major disruption in asset management.

Is the next reinvention of asset management already unfolding before us? The real question is not whether asset management will continue to be reinvented, but which investors will identify the next structural change early enough to benefit from it? This forum will explore exactly that.

### About the event

the/Garage Cohort 2 | Housing

Hospedagem para builders de fora de São Paulo

O the/Garage é presencial, e sabemos que nem todo builder de fora de São Paulo tem condições de bancar hospedagem por duas semanas. Por isso, a Superteam Brasil oferece apoio com hospedagem durante o programa.

Leia com atenção antes de solicitar:

As vagas são muito limitadas. Bem menos vagas do que o número de participantes do programa.

O apoio de hospedagem é destinado a quem atende os dois critérios ao mesmo tempo:

Necessidade real: builders que não têm condições de pagar a própria hospedagem em São Paulo. Se você pode arcar com sua estadia, deixe a vaga para quem precisa;

Nível do builder: entre os que precisam, priorizaremos os melhores builders e os times com maior potencial, seguindo os mesmos critérios de seleção do programa.

Solicitar hospedagem aqui não garante a vaga. As solicitações serão analisadas junto com a aplicação do coworking, e os aprovados receberão confirmação por e-mail.

Datas de entrada e saída: seja preciso

Cada cama liberada abre espaço para outro builder entrar. Por isso, precisamos saber exatamente quando você chega e quando sai, e pedimos que marque as datas conforme sua necessidade real, não "por garantia".

Check-in mais cedo: 27 de setembro (véspera do início do programa);

Check-out mais tarde: 11 de outubro (dia seguinte ao encerramento);

O programa acontece de 28 de setembro a 10 de outubro de 2026.

Se seus planos mudarem e você for sair antes, avise o time o quanto antes: sua vaga pode ser a chance de outro builder participar.

Importante

A solicitação de hospedagem é separada da inscrição no coworking. Você precisa aplicar nos dois;

Vagas sujeitas à disponibilidade e à análise do time da Superteam Brasil;

Detalhes do local e regras de convivência serão enviados aos aprovados.

Ainda não aplicou pro coworking?

https://luma.com/the-garage2

Datas do programa: 28 de setembro a 10 de outubro de 2026

Local: Solana House, São Paulo

### About the event

Belem Capital, EY, the Blockchain Student Association (BSA), and the Swiss Risk Association are pleased to invite you to a private morning event dedicated to asset allocators, private wealth managers, family offices, and professional investors.

As digital assets become an increasingly established part of the financial landscape, two questions are becoming central for investment professionals: how should the risks and regulatory considerations associated with this asset class be addressed, and how can digital assets be incorporated into a broader portfolio construction and asset allocation framework?

This event will bring together asset managers, risk specialists, regulatory experts, and allocators with a clear objective: to provide practical perspectives on the regulatory, risk-management, and investment frameworks that matter most to professional investors, while confronting these frameworks with the experience of market participants.

Through three keynotes and two panel discussions, we will explore the evolving regulatory environment in Switzerland and Europe, risk management in digital assets, the development of tokenisation and stablecoins, and the role of digital assets within professional investment portfolios.

### Programme

08:30 | Welcome & Networking Breakfast

08:45 | Welcome Remarks - Stanislas de Maistre (CEO, Belem Capital), Jean-Noël Ardouin (Partner Financial Services, EY), and Jules Delforge (President, Blockchain Student Association)

08:55 | EY Keynote: Introduction to the Regulatory Landscape and Digital Assets

09:05 | Panel 1: Overview of Emerging Swiss and European Digital Asset Regulations

09:35 | Belem Capital Keynote: From Tokenisation to Stablecoins: Building the Future of Capital Markets

09:45 | Panel 2: Asset Allocation in the Digital Asset Universe

10:15 | BSA Keynote: Introduction to the Blockchain Student Association (BSA)

10:25 | Closing Networking Session

### Speakers

Meet and exchange with senior professionals and specialists from asset management, compliance, regulatory advisory, institutional investment, risk management, and asset allocation.

Welcome Remarks: Stanislas de Maistre (CEO, Belem Capital), Jean-Noël Ardouin (Partner, Financial Services, EY), Jules Delforge (President, Blockchain Student Association)

EY Keynote: Maxime Ochrymowicz (Senior Consultant EY)

Panel 1 - Regulation: Biba Homsy (Founder & Partner, Homsy Legal)

Panel 2 - Asset Allocation: Nassim Alexandre (GP & CIO, Belem Capital), Lutz Preussler (Head of Asset Management Business Development, Sygnum),

BSA Keynote: Jules Delforge (President, Blockchain Student Association)

Belem Capital - EY - Blockchain Student Association (BSA) - Swiss Risk Association

Pont-Rouge district, Geneva

### About the event

U-Hackathon

U-Hackathon runs inside Flow Summit, a two-day summit on the future of finance and the future of community. You get a hall of your own, 24 hours on the clock, mentors on the floor. Get the best out of your allocated time. Then you demo on the stage.

The format: Hack → Mentor→ Present → Judge

Hack : 2 days hack, 10:00 Thursday to Friday. No filler panels, no keynote before you're allowed to open your laptop. Sleep is a personal choice.

Mentor : product, engineering and design mentors on the floor the entire time. Make the most out of your allocated slot, plus people walking the room looking mildly concerned about your architecture.

Present : Qualified Project demo on the stage Friday afternoon.

Judge : judges pick six finalists on merit. Then the U-Center DAO Community votes live to choose the grand prize.

Bring your AI squad

Cursor, Claude, ChatGPT, whatever agent stack you've quietly assembled. All fair game, on both tracks. There is no "Did you write this by hand" inquisition. It's 2026. Ship something good. Solving meaningful problem is the way.

Two rules, though:

Your teammates are humans. Up to 3 of them excluding you. Solo builder? You can ask for in event teammate. (Only team leader have to register).

Existing Project is NOT allowed. Pre-research is acceptable.

Time

Thursday, 15 October: 10:00 AM - 6:00 PM

Friday, 16 October: 10:00 AM - 9:00 PM

Registration PeriodDeadline : 1 Oct 2026 23:59 Gmt+7

Track 1 : AI

Build any application using AI tooling, solving real problem delivering value.

No Web3 experience needed for this track.

Track 2 : Web3

Build anything deployable on-chain.

### Prizes

Prize pool worth 1,000,000 THB

Trophy for the top 3 teams on each track

Certificate for all participants

Surprise bounty from partner on the brief

What you get either way

Mentors from product and engineering for the full two days

Exposure to partners, funds and press

Meals throughout ; this is Bangkok, the food is not a formality

Event Souvenirs

The room: builders, chains, funds, and the community

## DC Privacy Summit

- Record: `luma-batch-evtzs8RDf9CsVEHu`
- Source: [luma-batch-events.json](sources/luma-batch-events.json)
- Starts: 2026-10-15T16:00:00.000Z

### About the event

The Third Annual DC Privacy Summit will take place on October 15, 2026, at the National Union Building in Washington, D.C.

The DC Privacy Summit is a unique forum for urgent conversations about converging technological trends. Zero-knowledge proofs and other powerful cryptographic tools are raising novel questions about the law, and about the relationship between the US government and its citizens. Policymakers across the country (and around the world) are rushing to introduce digital identification credentials and age verification mandates. Sophisticated cyberattackers are turning consumer data security into a matter of national security. And the rise of AI is supercharging it all.

We organize this event because the people building these technologies and the people writing the rules governing them too rarely talk directly. If favorable privacy, security, and policy outcomes are to be achieved, this must change. That is our aim.

This year we have refined the format to help maximize the event's impact. We'll kick things off on the night of the 14th with the Cypherpunk Policy Dinner (separate admission required). The main event on the 15th is designed as a pop-up think tank, and will feature focused, invite-only roundtables as well as talks, firesides, and panels in front of an audience of up to 200 people. (For a sense of how this will look and feel, please see videos of the 2025 DC Privacy Summit and April's Stablecoin Privacy Summit.) We'll close out the day with a reception to give our high-signal audience an opportunity to mingle.

Here are some of the key questions we'll address throughout the day:

How can the public and private sectors improve their coordination to achieve better outcomes against cyberattackers like North Korea's Lazarus Group?

Is there a realistic path to privacy-preserving digital identification?

What do privacy-minded policymakers need from technologists working on the frontier of digital privacy and identity? What do technologists need from policymakers?

What are the implications of tools like zero-knowledge proofs beyond blockchains and cryptocurrencies?

What does AI mean for privacy, security, and freedom?

For more information, see dcprivacysummit.org.

### About the event

Welcome to The Studio's Investor Fireside Chat series, where we put founders in the room with investors who've been on the other side of the table. Join us for a conversation about what investors actually look for, how they make decisions, and what founders get wrong.

### Schedule

5:00 PM: Doors open

5:30 PM: Fireside chat

6:00 PM: Networking

### About the speaker

Winnie Lau (https://strobe.fund/team/winnie-lau) is a Partner at Strobe Ventures (https://strobe.fund/). She began her career as a strategy consultant and, prior to co-founding Strobe, was a Principal at BlockTower Capital, a crypto-native asset management firm. At Strobe, she covers everything across DeFi, stablecoin infrastructure, onchain applications, and AI. Growing up in Hong Kong and Guangzhou during the early days of the internet, Winnie saw firsthand the ability of technology and innovation to transform not only the socioeconomic landscape in China but also the consumer behaviors and culture of society.

As such, she spent most of her early career exploring new consumer technologies and primitives.

### About The Studio

The Studio (https://thestudio.monad.xyz/?utm_source=luma)is Monad Foundation's founder workspace in the heart of Manhattan, where early-stage teams building on Monad work side by side. It is 100% equity-free: zero equity, zero fees. Teams get dedicated desks, hands-on support on pitch, GTM, and fundraising, and direct access to the VCs, angels, and mentors who work from the space alongside them. Interested in building on Monad and want in? Learn more and apply at https://thestudio.monad.xyz/

### About Monad Foundation

The Monad Foundation (https://www.monad.foundation/?utm_source=luma)is an independent organization dedicated to encouraging the development and adoption of the Monad blockchain protocol, an ultra-high-performant EVM L1 blockchain. Monad will offer the best of both worlds: unrivaled performance (10,000 transactions per second) and portability (full-compatibility for Ethereum smart contracts).

Learn the system you're about to inherit.

DeFi Then, Now and Moving Forward

Policy 101: Who Sets the Rules for DeFi?

Curriculum 2.0: What Should Universities Teach About the Future of Finance?

Everything, Tokenized: What Happens When Assets Move Onchain?

### About the event

Stablecoins Grow Up: From Crypto Rails to Real-World Money

Stablecoins have been part of crypto for years.

But increasingly, the interesting question isn't what they are - it's what happens next.

Once primarily used to move money around crypto markets, stablecoins are increasingly becoming infrastructure for payments, cross-border transfers and the growing intersection between traditional finance and digital assets.

So are stablecoins finally moving beyond crypto? Could they become part of how we pay and move money every day? And as fintechs, payment companies and governments take them more seriously, what still stands in the way?

We'll explore real-world adoption, payments and cross-border use cases, the evolving UK regulatory landscape, and what comes next - including whether stablecoins could provide the payment rails for an increasingly AI-driven economy.

Speakers coming soon.

### Agenda

6:30pm - Doors open, drinks, networking

7:15pm - Panel discussion + audience Q&A

8:15pm - Drinks, pizza, & networking

9:30pm - Close

Powered by our sponsors

CoinDepo is a crypto investment platform designed to help users put their digital assets to work. With flexible earning and borrowing solutions, community-driven governance, and institutional-grade security infrastructure, CoinDepo makes it easier to generate passive income from crypto while maintaining greater flexibility and control over digital assets.

Huge shoutout to our venue partner ReedSmith for hosting us! Reed Smith is a global law firm with deep expertise in emerging tech, digital assets, and fintech regulation. We're grateful for their support in helping us bring the crypto community together IRL.

### Merkle Science Meet Las Vegas 2026 🇺🇸

October 20, 2026 | Caesars Palace, Las Vegas | During Money20/20 USA (Room Augustus III)

Join us at Caesars Palace during Money20/20 USA for the Merkle Science Meet Las Vegas 2026, brought to you by Merkle Science in collaboration with Duane Morris LLP.

This exclusive gathering will bring together leaders from financial institutions, fintechs, payment providers, and digital asset companies for an afternoon of focused discussions on enterprise compliance, stablecoins, programmable money, and the future of financial infrastructure.

Hosted with Merkle Science & Duane Morris LLP, the event will feature expert-led panels, product demonstrations, and networking opportunities with industry leaders shaping the next generation of financial services.

### Our Sponsors & Partners

Merkle Science - Blockchain Intelligence & Compliance

Helping businesses investigate digital assets, monitor transactions, and manage financial crime risk.

Duane Morris LLP - Host & Lead Sponsor

An international law firm advising on legal, regulatory, and commercial matters, including financial services, fintech, and digital assets.

Aleo - Privacy-First Blockchain

A blockchain platform using zero-knowledge cryptography to enable programmable applications while protecting sensitive information.

Stablecon - Stablecoin Ecosystem Partner

An industry event and community platform connecting leaders across stablecoins, payments, banking, and digital assets.

nSure.ai (https://nSure.ai) - AI-Powered Fraud Prevention

An AI-powered platform helping businesses detect payment fraud and strengthen transaction risk management.

Movantis - Cross-Border Payments Infrastructure

Helping businesses streamline international payments, currency conversion, and settlement.

Fiat Republic - Banking Infrastructure for Digital Assets

Connecting crypto and Web3 businesses with fiat banking and payment services.

BlindPay - Global Stablecoin Payments

API-based infrastructure enabling businesses to integrate stablecoin payments and cross-border transfers.

Range - Treasury, Risk & Compliance

Digital asset infrastructure supporting transaction monitoring, risk assessment, and compliance operations.

### What to Expect

- Expert-led panels featuring leaders across banking, payments, fintech, compliance, and digital assets
- Practical discussions on regulation, fraud prevention, transaction monitoring, and risk management
- Insights into stablecoins, programmable money, and cross-border payments
- Product demonstrations from Merkle Science, Range, and BlindPay
- Networking with speakers, sponsors, and fellow industry professionals

### Event Agenda

1:30 PM - 1:50 PM | Arrival & Networking

Arrive, meet fellow attendees, and enjoy informal networking before the programme begins.

1:50 PM - 2:00 PM | Welcome Remarks

Opening remarks from Merkle Science leadership to introduce the event and the key themes shaping the digital asset compliance landscape.

2:00 PM - 2:20 PM | Merkle Science Product Demo

Discover how Merkle Science supports blockchain intelligence, transaction monitoring, digital asset investigations, and compliance programmes.

2:20 PM - 3:00 PM | Panel 1: Crypto Payments in the Age of Programmable Money

Stablecoins and tokenized deposits are increasingly entering the payments stack alongside card networks, ACH, and wire transfers. This panel explores how compliance programmes must adapt to programmable settlement, blockchain-native transactions, on/off-ramp activity, and evolving money-transmission requirements.

3:20 PM - 4:00 PM | Panel 2: AI, Risk & the Future of Stablecoin Infrastructure

As stablecoins become more integrated into mainstream financial infrastructure, institutions face growing challenges around fraud, financial crime, and transaction risk. This panel explores how blockchain analytics, transaction monitoring, and AI-driven tools can strengthen risk management and support scalable compliance.

Panelists

Banks are reassessing their approach to crypto custody, stablecoin issuance, and digital asset lending. This panel examines how traditional financial institutions are engaging with digital assets, adapting risk frameworks, and competing for institutional customers.

## 金融機構數位資產實務轉型 Presented by TAAS - 年度系列講座 (五) 從 API 到操作流程：金融機構如何串接數位資產基礎設施

- Record: `luma-batch-evtGMos7F0qQNyQF`
- Source: [luma-batch-events.json](sources/luma-batch-events.json)
- Starts: 2026-10-21T06:00:00.000Z

### About the event

【金融機構數位資產實務轉型】系列講座

Practical Transformation of Digital Assets for Financial Institutions Presented by TAAS

系列講座（五）Forum 05｜從 API 到操作流程：金融機構如何串接數位資產基礎設施

### About This Forum

當安全架構確立後，金融機構下一步需要面對的是系統與流程的整合：數位資產基礎設施應如何與既有金融系統接軌。

數位資產並非獨立運作，而是需要與核心銀行系統、風控系統、帳務系統與內部流程整合。從 API 串接、交易流程設計、權限控管，到跨部門協作，都是導入過程中的關鍵挑戰。

本場將從實務角度出發，說明金融機構在導入數位資產時，如何設計系統串接與操作流程，並整理導入過程中常見的整合問題與解決方式，協助機構建立可實際運作的架構。

Key Topics

數位資產基礎設施的系統架構

API 串接與核心系統整合

交易流程與操作流程設計

跨部門協作與內部流程整合

What You'll Gain

系統整合與流程設計的基本理解

API 與內部系統串接的關鍵考量

可用於內部導入討論的實務架構

Suggested Audience

銀行（IT / Security / Risk / Digital Banking）

金控與資產管理機構

金融科技與系統整合商

企業 treasury / 財務相關部門

### Speakers

Host / Opening Remarks

楊曜陽 - TAAS 踏實數位 共同創辦人

Featured Speakers

TBD

TBD

TBD

Panel / Discussion Guests

TBD

TBD

*講者資訊將陸續公布。

### Agenda

14:00 - 14:30｜報到 Registration & Networking

14:30 - 14:35｜開場 Opening Remarks

14:35 - 15:05｜Session 1

15:05 - 15:25｜Session 2 Case Sharing

15:25 - 15:55｜Discussion Q&A

15:55 - 17:00｜Networking

*實際流程將依講者與議程安排調整。

Organizer

TAAS

TAAS（Treasury as a Service）致力於構建數位資產時代的企業級財庫管理基礎設施。透過深度整合資產託管（Custody）、穩定幣支付結算（Settlement）、跨境資金流管理（Cross-border）與即時數據審計，我們為全球企業與金融機構提供一套合規、安全且具備高度擴展性的資本運作系統 。 TAAS 不僅是連接傳統金融與區塊鏈網路的戰略中樞 ， 更賦能企業在變動的數位環境中，建立穩健且可持續的數位資產戰略儲備與財務管理能力 。

### Partners

BitGo

BitGo 是首屈一指的數位資產解決方案基礎設施供應商，自 2013 年成立以來深受各大機構信賴。提供機構級託管、安全與錢包架構相關專業支援，參與託管、MPC、多重簽名、資產隔離等議題分享，提供金融機構可理解的基礎設施與落地觀點，並支援後續技術與架構層交流。

Capital Layer

Capital Layer 是亞洲機構金融的穩定幣基礎設施層，為銀行、系統整合商與金融機構提供合規穩定幣營運所需的模組化平台。將託管、合規、私鑰管理與結算協調整合於單一層級，讓機構不用重建底層工程，就能合法合規地向企業客戶推出數位資產服務。

敦陽科技

敦陽科技股份有限公司 (Stark Technology, Inc., STI) 是台灣最大的國內系統整合商，我們為超過 2,000 家客戶提供完整的資訊與通訊技術 (ICT) 產品系統整合服務。身為台灣 500 大服務企業之一，我們透過代理和經銷全球頂尖的產品，為各種產業規劃及提供完整的 ICT 解決方案。我們是台灣的公共系統整合商中最穩健且財力最雄厚的公司之一，也是眾人眼中的典範。

紅樓資本

紅樓資本（Red Building Capital）是台灣首家深耕區塊鏈技術與 Web3.0 的風險投資公司，以 Venture Studio 為核心定位，除了佈局 Sui 生態系、DeFi 及鏈上金融等前瞻領域，更深度參與項目的早期構思與國際募資。紅樓不僅提供股權與代幣投資，更整合法律諮詢、營銷策略及全球資源，透過資源協同效應協助團隊從在地走向國際，全方位提升項目的商業價值。

### About the Program

隨著台灣數位資產相關專法與監管架構逐步發展，金融機構面對的已不只是新市場機會，而是如何在既有法遵、風控與內控制度下，重新理解數位資產在金融體系中的定位與可行性。

數位資產的影響，已逐步從市場與投資層面，延伸到制度、託管、安全、支付清算、資產儲備、合規監控與金融產品設計等實務層面。對金融機構而言，真正需要面對的問題包括：

專法與制度發展將如何影響金融機構進入數位資產市場的方式

機構應如何在既有法遵、風控與內控制度下承接數位資產

穩定幣是否將改變未來支付與清算模式

託管、安全與資產隔離應採取何種機構級架構

DAT 與資產代幣化是否會成為未來金融機構資產配置與產品設計的一部分

因此，本系列以一年期規劃，透過四大主題、十二場論壇，建立一條從制度理解、基礎設施設計、支付清算應用，到資產儲備與產品延伸的完整路徑，讓金融機構不只理解趨勢，更能在一年內形成實際的評估與導入框架。

Program Purpose

本系列講座的目的包括：

協助台灣金融機構系統性理解數位資產實務轉型的完整架構，從制度、基礎設施到應用層建立整體認知

結合台灣數位資產相關法規與專法發展方向，協助金融機構在既有監管與內控制度下，理解數位資產業務的可行範圍與導入條件

讓參與機構掌握專法、合規、託管、安全、穩定幣、DAT 與資產代幣化等議題的實際導入邏輯，而非僅停留於市場概念

建立金融機構跨部門共同語言，作為策略、法遵、風控、產品與 IT 部門之間的討論基礎

以年度系列講座形式，作為金融機構內部教育訓練與產業知識普及的一環，降低組織導入新型金融基礎設施時的認知落差

提供金融機構從理解、評估到實務規劃的持續交流平台

為後續顧問導入、基礎設施合作、產品設計與商務延伸建立基礎

Program Positioning

本系列論壇並非泛市場型的加密活動，而是專為金融機構設計的年度實務轉型企劃，同時定位為一套結合台灣金融監管脈絡之教育訓練與產業知識普及機制。

整體內容圍繞三條主線展開：

DAT｜數位資產儲備與配置策略

回應金融機構與企業財務在資產負債表、儲備資產與配置策略上的新需求。

Stablecoin｜支付、清算與資金流轉

回應穩定幣對跨境支付、清算效率與資金管理所帶來的改變。

Custody｜機構級託管與安全基礎設施

回應金融機構在導入數位資產時，對託管、安全、合規與操作流程的需求。

Series Structure

本系列共分為四大主題、十二場論壇：

主題一｜制度與專法

聚焦制度位置、專法發展、責任邊界與合規要求，建立進場前判斷框架。

Forum 01｜專法上路前後：金融機構如何理解數位資產的制度位置

Forum 02｜合格託管的角色：金融機構應自建、外包，還是混合架構

Forum 03｜KYC、AML 與鏈上合規：數位資產風控如何落地

主題二｜託管與安全底層

聚焦託管、安全、授權與系統整合，建立機構級安全與操作架構。

Forum 04｜MPC、多重簽名與機構級數位資產安全架構

Forum 05｜從 API 到操作流程：金融機構如何串接數位資產基礎設施

Forum 06｜資產隔離、保險與法律保護：機構級託管的風險結構

主題三｜DAT、RWA 與導入路徑

聚焦資產配置、產品設計與實際導入，讓全年內容收斂為可執行方向。

Forum 07｜DAT：金融機構與企業財務的數位資產儲備策略

Forum 08｜資產代幣化（RWA）與金融產品設計

Forum 09｜從理解到導入：金融機構數位資產轉型的下一步

主題四｜穩定幣、支付與清算實務

聚焦穩定幣如何從概念進入支付、跨境資金流與清算實務。

Forum 10｜穩定幣發行架構：金融機構可以扮演什麼角色

Forum 11｜跨境支付與 24/7 清算：穩定幣如何改變資金流動

Forum 12｜儲備機制、透明度與市場信任：穩定幣如何被金融機構接受

*本頁為系列第四場，屬於 主題二｜託管與安全底層。

## My First Bitcoin: Education Is Freedom

- Record: `luma-batch-evtmWdmu40qCxBTk`
- Source: [luma-batch-events.json](sources/luma-batch-events.json)
- Starts: 2026-10-22T22:00:00.000Z
- Description: Source-backed
- Original page: <https://luma.com/hsodwfgy>

### About the event

Join My First Bitcoin at PubKey for an evening exploring how grassroots Bitcoin education is growing into a global movement for freedom, opportunity, and self-sovereignty.

At the heart of the evening is the exclusive premiere of our new documentary, filmed across Indonesia in August 2026. No one has seen the film before.

The documentary follows our journey from Jakarta to Bandung, Surabaya, and finally Bali, capturing the different Bitcoin communities we encountered along the way and the stories of the people building them. We traveled together with Dimas, the leader of Bitcoin Indonesia, meeting local educators, community leaders, and Bitcoiners to understand what adoption looks like on the ground across one of the world's most diverse countries.

Through their stories, the film explores how grassroots, open-source education is helping people better understand money, Bitcoin, and their own financial agency - and how very different local communities are turning that knowledge into action.

Following the screening, My First Bitcoin founder John Dennehy, members of the organization, and special guests will share the story behind My First Bitcoin, how the movement has grown from its roots in El Salvador into a global network of independent educators and communities, and why education sits at the heart of meaningful Bitcoin adoption.

We'll discuss the connection between Bitcoin, education, freedom, and self-sovereignty - and what it takes to build a movement that empowers people to think independently, take greater ownership of their financial lives, and bring that knowledge back to their own communities.

Whether you already know My First Bitcoin, are deeply involved in Bitcoin, or are simply curious about the role education can play in expanding access and understanding, we'd love to have you join us.

Be among the first to see the film. Stay for the conversation. Meet the people helping build the global Bitcoin education movement.

## Encode London Hackathon

- Record: `luma-batch-7iIJgmckKWYczPb`
- Source: [luma-batch-events.json](sources/luma-batch-events.json)
- Starts: 2026-10-23T10:00:00.000Z

### About the event

We're excited to return to London for another year of hands-on creation, learning, and community building. Encode London 2026 brings together developers, founders, researchers, students, and innovators for a dual-track experience: a high-energy hackathon!

This year's event continues our mission of fostering world-class builders while creating a space to explore new technologies, collaborate with peers, and bring ambitious ideas to life.

### Hackathon Overview

A full 3 days of non-stop hacking, where teams will build projects aligned with emerging AI and Web3 themes. Participants can expect challenges, bounties, mentorship, and the chance to showcase their work to a panel of judges.

This year there are two open challenges, plus a Saint bounty (below). Prize categories and judges will be announced soon.

### Challenges

The Real World: AI that understands the world around us

Build software that makes sense of the physical world from photos, audio, maps and open data. Some ideas to get you started:

- An accessibility guide that describes a street or venue from photos
- A "what's happening near me" explorer built on live open data
- A trip or hike conditions planner
- Wildlife and plant ID from photos or recordings
- A city noise or air-quality map built from public datasets
- A tool that spots potholes or fly-tipping in a photo and drafts the council report

Agents That Ship

Build an AI agent that does a real job end to end, not just a chatbot. Pick a task someone does by hand today and have your agent see it through: using real tools, recovering when things go wrong and checking with a human before the risky steps. Some ideas:

- Small-business operations: chasing invoices, reconciling payments, booking suppliers
- Research briefs and competitor reports that check their own sources
- A developer agent that takes an issue and opens a tested pull request
- Agents that hand work to each other, or pay and get paid for it

Saint Bounty: Best Use of Saint

Saint is a personal AI assistant: an AI colleague that works inside your own email, calendar, documents and browser. Give it a job in plain English and it does the work - research, outreach, admin, building and shipping small apps - then tells you what it changed and asks before anything risky. Put one to work on something real over the weekend, or build something that makes a Saint more useful. A small number of Saints will be available for teams that want one.

- Give it a job: a workflow it runs end to end for your project or your team
- Build for it: a tool, integration or interface that makes a Saint more useful
- Give it to someone: a Saint solving a real problem for a person or business you know

Prize: £200 in cash for the winning team (one prize, not a pool), a Saint each for the team members, and 3 months of Saint free for the team.

The winning team also gets a set-up call to get their Saints running. If your team wants a Saint before the hackathon, you can sign up at saint.work (https://saint.work) or ask us at the event.

### Event Timeline

A full weekend of hacking, learning, and community.

The exact schedule - including the opening ceremony, workshops, conference sessions, judging, and the finale - will be released ahead of the event.

### Partners & Prizes

Encode London 2026 is supported by:

- Google DeepMind
- MongoDB
- Arc
- Saint

More partners, prizes and judges will be announced soon.

### Venue: The Encode Hub

http://hub.encode.club/

The event will once again take place at the Encode Hub - our community space for AI and Web3 builders in the heart of Shoreditch.

### Partnership & Sponsorship

Interested in sponsoring, partnering, or getting involved?

Contact katerina@encode.club for more details.

### About the event

We look forward to welcoming you to our Swell 2026 Demo Day, hosted in Ripple's New York office. Doors open at 1:45 PM, with the program beginning at 2:30 PM and a networking reception with light bites to follow.

Demo Day Agenda

1:45 - 2:30 PM - Doors open & arrival

2:30 - 2:55 PM - Welcome, keynote & program overviews

2:55 - 3:30 PM - Startup pitches (12 startups, 3 minutes each)

3:30 - 4:00 PM - Group Q&A with all founders

4:00 - 5:30 PM - Networking reception + light bites

Featured Startups

Blockpeer: End-to-end digital trade platform for issuing, financing, and managing MLETR-compliant electronic trade documents (like eBLs), with tokenized trade assets and stablecoin payments.

BlockVault: Financial infrastructure that lets XRP holders earn yield and access liquidity on their assets without selling them.

C9: Brazilian Web3 platform bringing tokenization, wallets, and crypto cards to everyday users and businesses on the XRPL.

Circles: Social feed-first investing app that lets people make micro-loans to local ventures and follow their progress like posts.

Exfil: Intelligence-led security platform that detects and disrupts scams, fraud, and threat infrastructure across the web and on-chain.

Mandla Money: WhatsApp-based stablecoin wallet enabling low-cost cross-border payments and remittances for underserved communities in emerging markets.

Mobile Wallet: Modular crypto on/off-ramp infrastructure connecting blockchains to local payment rails for the unbanked.

Regolda: Institutional-grade dashboard for tokenized recycled physical gold on the XRPL, with real-time ESG impact metrics and tax reporting.

Riskx: On-chain risk-scoring engine that writes live, machine-readable risk signals for DeFi protocols.

Straid: Decentralized credit-markets and leverage protocol on the XRPL enabling undercollateralized lending via on-chain risk scoring.

VS1: Institutional DeFi and tokenized capital-markets infrastructure on the XRPL, spanning compliant lending, swaps, and asset tokenization.

Zuvia - Crypto-as-a-Service and tokenization platform helping companies adopt Web3 and blockchain on the XRPL.

### About the event

The regulatory landscape for digital assets continues to evolve. With CARF and DAC8, crypto businesses and financial institutions face a new set of tax transparency, due diligence, data, and reporting requirements.

Together with PwC Netherlands, BCNL and VBNL are organizing an exclusive and highly interactive session focused entirely on what CARF and DAC8 mean in practice.

Date: 28-10-26

15:30 - 19:00

PwC Netherlands

Limited & curated attendance

### From regulation to implementation

The session will be led by PwC's team of operational tax experts, specializing in areas including FATCA/CRS, CESOP and Digital Services Taxes. The team includes a former OECD member who contributed to the development of CARF, complemented by operational tax professionals with more than 10 years of experience in the financial sector.

Rather than focusing solely on the technical regulation, this session is designed to answer the practical questions:

What does CARF/DAC8 actually mean for your organization? What do you need to prepare? Where are the known pitfalls? And what challenges are other organizations already encountering?

### The 5 Building Blocks of CARF

During the roundtable, PwC will take participants through five key areas:

1. Entity Management

Determining whether your organization falls within the scope of the regulation.

2. Product Analysis

Identifying which products and services are in scope.

3. Due Diligence

Understanding the requirements, how to implement them, and how they align with existing AML/KYC processes.

4. Reporting

What needs to be reported, where and when, which data points are required, and what this means for your organization and systems.

5. Governance Set-up

Establishing the right policies, procedures, responsibilities, and internal governance.

For each building block, we'll connect the regulatory requirements with real-world implementation, known pitfalls, and challenges PwC is seeing across the market.

### An interactive roundtable

This is deliberately a small-scale and interactive session, not a traditional conference.

The core roundtable will last approximately two hours, with plenty of room for discussion, practical cases, and questions from participants. Attendees will also have the opportunity to submit questions and topics in advance, allowing the PwC team to tailor the conversation to the challenges organizations are actually facing.

Following the session, we'll continue with drinks and networking, giving participants the opportunity to exchange experiences and connect with peers.

### Who should attend?

The session is particularly relevant for finance, tax, compliance and operational professionals working at:

Crypto exchanges - Brokers - Payment providers & PSPs - E-money institutions - Market makers - Banks & financial institutions - Other organizations active in or expanding into digital assets

Professionals from traditional financial institutions exploring or expanding their crypto activities are also very welcome.

### About PwC Netherlands

PwC Netherlands supports crypto businesses in navigating evolving tax transparency and reporting requirements, including CARF, CESOP, DAC7, and relevant domestic obligations. By combining tax, regulatory, and technology capabilities, PwC helps organizations assess their scope and build the data, systems, processes, and governance required for sustainable compliance.

### About BCNL Foundation

BCNL Foundation connects and strengthens the Dutch digital asset ecosystem by bringing together companies, financial institutions, policymakers, investors, and industry professionals through events, education, advocacy, and strategic collaboration.

About NVC (VBNL)

NVC is the Dutch CASP Association, formerly known as VBNL. Founded in 2014, NVC has a long history advocating for the interests of bitcoin- and crypto companies, promoting self-regulation, coordination with stakeholders such as legislators, regulators and law enforcement, and maintaining the highest standards of reputation and integrity. Members are: Bitvavo, MoonPay, Coinmerce, zerohash, Blockrise, BTC Direct, Bitmymoney, Blox, Fiat Republic, Acheron Trading & Finst.

Capacity is limited and registrations will be curated.

If CARF/DAC8 could impact your organization, this is an opportunity to discuss the implications directly with experts and peers before the requirements become part of day-to-day operations.

### About the event

Launchnodes and GSR Foundation co-host The Yield Layer of Social Impact on November 4, 2026, from 10:00 to 16:00 IST at IFBE, 10-12 Calicut Road, Ballard Estate, Fort, Mumbai. The organizer describes it as a half-day Devcon side event for donors, foundations, impact organizations, onchain capital providers and the protocols supporting onchain yield.

The central discussion is how staking and stablecoin yield could support social and environmental work while donors retain their principal. Sessions will examine infrastructure already built, the sources of donor capital, applications being developed on top of that infrastructure and the next steps for adoption. The planned format combines fireside conversations with yield protocols, an impact keynote and panels involving donors, foundations and builders.

The discussion includes Launchnodes' Lido Impact Staking and its Aave-based Stablecoin for Impact. These products form Impactstake.com, which connects donor capital with vetted impact organizations. The organizer describes a model in which yield goes to those organizations while principal remains staked and withdrawable. A further question is how institutions outside crypto can use this infrastructure and measure the resulting impact.

### Confirmed speakers

- Jaydeep Korde, Launchnodes.
- Christopher Fabian, UNICEF.
- James Newell, GSR Foundation.
- Aleksandra Gusakova, Lido Labs.

Registration is free and requires host approval. The organizer is selecting an audience that includes Indian corporate philanthropy teams, onchain capital providers, and impact organizations already using or considering onchain tools.

## Onchain Legal Summit :: Devcon India 2026

- Record: `luma-batch-kBSIe7BSMtDFldg`
- Source: [luma-batch-events.json](sources/luma-batch-events.json)
- Starts: 2026-11-04T05:30:00.000Z

### About the event

Entity's third Onchain Legal Summit takes place during Devcon India on November 4, 2026, from 11:00 to 17:00 IST. The Legal & Governance Hub hosts this working summit for founders, lawyers, protocol designers and governance specialists examining the legal status of onchain entities, DAOs, AI agents and autonomous systems.

### Questions on the program

The announced subjects include:

- How DAO governance and compliance tools fit together, and how legal text can become computable contracts.
- Agent personhood, ERC-8004 and Know Your Agent, including the legal status of autonomous protocols and whether AI agents can hold voting rights in a DAO.
- Decentralized justice and AI arbitration for real-world disputes, and the use of onchain courts to resolve disagreements within DAOs.
- Legal recognition of onchain entities, whether they can operate across borders, and the compliance obligations involved in forming and running them.
- Registry infrastructure and the design of legal entities in Solidity and other programming environments.
- Liability for autonomous code and the use of onchain civil records for marriages, death certificates and notarization.
- How lawyers might express legal processes through APIs.

The India edition also examines online dispute resolution, digital public infrastructure and what national registries can learn from open registries. The organizer has published these themes but has not yet released a detailed agenda or session timetable. Speaker and partnership inquiries can be submitted through the form linked on the event page.

### Admission

Participation in the summit is free for Devcon 8 attendees. A separate valid Devcon ticket is required to enter the conference venue; registering on Luma or another external site does not provide Devcon admission. The public listing gives Mumbai as the location and requires registration to see the exact event address.

## MONEY MAKER

- Record: `luma-batch-cFXe8eT3nFr409n`
- Source: [luma-batch-events.json](sources/luma-batch-events.json)
- Starts: 2026-11-06T07:30:00.000Z

### About the event

MONEY MAKER, hosted by namic, takes place at IFBE in Mumbai on November 6, 2026, from 13:00 IST until 01:00 on November 7. The event examines the history and design of money, how it is created, who controls it, why people trust it and how monetary systems influence economies, institutions and behavior.

The announced subjects include fiat currencies, central banking, monetary policy, stablecoins, incentive design, security, privacy and artificial intelligence. The speaker brief compares physical and digital money, centralized and decentralized systems, and the tradeoffs and unresolved problems of existing models.

The organizer invites original research, practical case studies, historical analysis, technical talks and proposals for alternative monetary models. These are requested contributions rather than a published list of confirmed sessions. Talks are followed by dinner, drinks and an after-party with live DJs and performers. Speaking and sponsorship inquiries go to [@daonamic on X](https://x.com/daonamic).

Registration is free and the listed ticket does not require host approval. IFBE is at 10-12 Calicut Road, Ballard Estate, Fort, Mumbai, Maharashtra 400001.

### About the event

Blockstories Horizon: London Summit - 09 November 2026

120 seats. Invitation-only. Co-hosted with Aon. Horizon Summits are unlike most other conferences:

Every guest is vetted.

We only feature keynotes. Each capped at 7 minutes.

No panels. No sales booths.

After the event, each guest leaves with a personalized strategy debrief.

You can think of Horizon as a strategy offsite for the industry. Our mission is to help digital asset teams see what is coming, make better strategic decisions and build the network to execute.

London Summit

Co-hosted with Aon, the London Summit will bring together 130 senior leaders responsible for digital asset strategies and products.

Across a series of seven-minute keynotes, the companies closest to the industry's most important shifts will explain what they see on the ground, what they are building and how institutions should prepare for the next 12 to 18 months. A preview of the program:

Banking Circle: Where stablecoin settlement is already transforming cross-border payments today

Utila: What it takes for a bank to become stablecoin ready

Digital Asset: Real-time treasury management and the advent of tokenized MMFs.

Talos: Tokenized Equities, perpetuals, prediction markets. Crypto is becoming more like TradFi and vice versa.

Steakhouse Financial: Vaults already power fintechs. Traditional asset management is next.

Aon: Pricing risk in institutional DeFi and onchain markets

Zama: Onchain privacy has arrived on public blockchains. What comes next?

The Evening

17:00-18:00 Welcome reception

18:00-20:00 Seven-minute keynote presentations

20:00-22:30 Networking over food and drinks

Attendance

Attendance is complimentary and limited to 120 approved guests.

If you received a personal invitation from Blockstories, Aon or one of our speakers, please select Invited Guest.

If you have not received a personal invitation but are responsible for digital asset strategy, products or infrastructure at a financial institution, you may Apply to Attend.

All applications are reviewed.

For questions, please contact: mail@blockstories.io

## Kundenschutz und Kryptowährungen

- Record: `luma-batch-evtzJSbBU29gOHYb`
- Source: [luma-batch-events.json](sources/luma-batch-events.json)
- Starts: 2026-11-26T11:00:00.000Z
- Description: Source-backed
- Original page: <https://luma.com/5xp9r8xd>

### About the event

Die Funktion von Kryptowährungen hat sich in den letzten Jahren gewandelt. Ursprünglich als Zahlungsmittel konzipiert, werden sie heute vorwiegend zu Anlagezwecken eingesetzt. Investitionen in Kryptowährungen sind mit vielfältigen Risiken verbunden: Neben der hohen Volatilität können Sicherheitsvorfälle oder Konkurse von Dienstleistern sowie Formen des Marktmissbrauchs zu erheblichen Verlusten führen. Angesichts dieser Risiken stellt sich die Frage, wie bei Dienstleistungen mit Kryptowährungen ein angemessener Schutz von Investoren, insbesondere von Retail-Anlegern, gewährleistet werden kann.

Die beiden Referenten zeigen anhand ausgewählter Aspekte auf, wie der Kundenschutz nach geltendem Recht ausgestaltet ist und welche Weiterentwicklungen im Rahmen der geplanten Änderung des Finanzinstitutsgesetzes vorgesehen sind.

12.15 Einführung

Ass.-Prof. Dr. Claude Humbel, ZIBR

12.20 Kundenschutz de lege lata

Dr. Stefan Härtner, Finma

12.35 Kundenschutz de lege ferenda

Dr. Fabrice Eckert, Homburger AG

12.50 Diskussion / Q&A

Moderation: Ass.-Prof. Dr. Claude Humbel, ZIBR

### About the event

WEB FLEA

Sunday, June 13, 2027. One day. One immersive flea market experience powered by Web3, in the heart of NYC.

The city's designers, artists, collectors, and creatives all in one room. If you've been onchain for years or you've never touched a crypto wallet in your life, you belong here.

This is the cultural exchange the city & crypto have been waiting for!

Attendance is free. RSVP required. Grab your pass above.

Happening at Web FLEA:

Huge immersive layout for shopping and exploring

Top DJs spinning all day

White glove crypto wallet onboarding

Every vendor accepts CRYPTO, card, and cash

Food from the city's top restaurants

Handpicked beverages flowing all day

Curated digital art gallery

NYC's top flea market vendors and brands

Zines & print media

Partner activations

Tons of surprises and goodies throughout the day

Enjoy a full day of culture, community, and discovery, then join us for curated night vibes starting at 8pm.

Web Flea is Day 0 of ETHConf NYC. The conference takes over the Javits Center June 14 through 16, and the day before it starts, we set the tone for the week. Come in early, get your bearings in the city, and spend a Sunday with the people who actually make New York look and feel like New York.

The full lineup, vendors, and partners drop on the microsite: www.webflea.xyz

Event Photo Release: By attending, you agree to be included in photographs or footage that may be used by Web Flea and partners for documentation and promotion.

## Crypto World's Fair Hackathon by Colosseum

- Record: `w3v-crypto-worlds-fair-hackathon-by-colosseum`
- Source: [events-cache.json](sources/events-cache.json)
- Starts: 2026-09-14T06:00:00.000Z
- Description: Source-backed
- Original page: <https://colosseum.com/worldsfair>

### About the event

An online hackathon bringing together builders and founders across all crypto ecosystems to launch breakout startups.

### Crypto World's Fair

Crypto World's Fair is an open competition of the ideas, technologies, and communities shaping the blockchain ecosystem. Builders and founders exhibit the products and innovations driving the next wave of crypto startups that bring the world's markets onchain. Submissions are due October 12, 2026.

### Awards and opportunities

Teams compete for $840,000 in prizes and $2.5 million in seed funding, including a $30,000 grand prize and $300,000 shared across the next 20 best projects. All hackathon winners are interviewed and considered for Colosseum's accelerator program with pre-seed funding, founder network access and mentorship.

### Tracks

Ecosystem tracks with dedicated prize pools include Solana, Ethereum, Hyperliquid, Base, Tempo, Arbitrum, Zcash and Robinhood Chain, each judged with builders, investors and operators from those ecosystems.

### Judges

The Colosseum team reviews all submissions, joined by track judges including Clay Robbins, Matty Taylor and Nate Levine alongside builders and investors from Phantom, Base, Arcium, MetaDAO and Ellipsis Labs.

### Accelerator

All hackathon winners are interviewed and considered for the Colosseum accelerator program with pre-seed funding, founder network access and mentorship, including a residency collaborating directly with the Colosseum team.

### Livestream workshops

All workshops stream live on Discord, including the kickoff with the Colosseum founders. Participants can watch live, ask questions and follow the program through the event.
